q_en: Which are 'special hazardous diving operations' requiring extra equipment and hazard briefing?
a_en: Surface floating, snorkel photography, boat-side entry, shoreline wading
b_en: Underwater cutting/welding, wreck or cave entry, night or low-visibility water, strong currents
c_en: Shallow shore shellfish gathering, seaweed picking, beach cleanup, tidal observation
d_en: Swimming pool cleaning, water quality testing, floor scrubbing, filter media changing
explain_zh: 第42條列舉：水下爆破、水下切割及熔接、進出沈船洞穴佈設海底管線、寒冷或高溫水域、海域探測、遭受污染水域、夜間及低能見度水域、高速水流或渦流水域、特殊海洋生物危害等潛水作業。
explain_en: Article 42: underwater blasting, cutting and welding, wrecks/caves/pipelines, cold or hot water, ocean surveys, polluted water, night or low visibility, strong currents or eddies, dangerous marine life.

law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
q_zh: 於海拔多少公尺以上高海拔地區從事潛水作業，應依附表四之四、四之五規定辦理？
a_zh: 一千公尺（三千呎）
b_zh: 二千公尺（六千呎）
c_zh: 九十一點五公尺（三百呎）
d_zh: 三百零五公尺（一千呎）
q_en: Diving at altitudes above what elevation must follow Tables 4-4 and 4-5?
explain_zh: 第45條：於九十一點五公尺（三百呎）以上高海拔地區潛水應依附表四之四、四之五辦理；作業後離開據點高程壓力差超過三百零五公尺（一千呎）者，應依附表四之六完成水面上休息並記錄保存五年。
explain_en: Article 45: above 91.5 m (300 ft); leaving to a site with over 305 m (1,000 ft) elevation difference requires a surface interval per Table 4-6, recorded and kept 5 years.

law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
q_zh: 使用水肺供氣（緊急用氣瓶外）潛水時，單人潛水應如何？二人共潛應如何？
a_zh: 單人及二人共潛均無須繩索或視線之要求
b_zh: 單人無需繩索繫著；二人得於水下各自分開作業
c_zh: 單人需配置連絡員；二人共潛則無須任何規定
d_zh: 單人需有繩索繫著；二人需隨時在互相視線可及之處
q_en: For scuba diving, a solo diver must be, and buddy divers must be:
a_en: No line or sight requirement for solo or buddy divers
b_en: Untethered; free to work apart underwater as they wish
c_en: Given a tender; buddy pairs are under no requirement
d_en: Tethered by a line; within each other's sight at all times
explain_zh: 第51條：潛水前告知氣瓶供氣能力；設置潛水作業主管全程掌握；單人潛水需有繩索繫著，二人共潛需隨時在互相視線可及之處。
explain_en: Article 51: brief the diver on cylinder capacity, assign a supervisor, tether solo divers, and keep buddy pairs within sight.

law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
q_zh: 潛水作業供下潛或上浮使用之安全索，應如何標記？
a_zh: 自水面起每一公尺打一個繩結作為記號
b_zh: 將整條安全索以紅色油漆均勻塗布標示
c_zh: 依潛水深度以油漆每五公尺標示一次
d_zh: 依減壓站之停留深度以木標或布條作記錄
q_en: The descent/ascent safety line must be marked:
a_en: With a knot tied every meter from the surface down
b_en: By coating the whole safety line evenly in red paint
c_en: With paint at every five meters of dive depth
d_en: At decompression stop depths with wooden tags or cloth strips
explain_zh: 第53條：應供給下潛或上浮使用之安全索並監督確實使用；安全索應依減壓站之停留深度以木標或布條作記錄。
explain_en: Article 53: provide and enforce use of the safety line, marked at decompression stop depths with wooden markers or cloth strips.

law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
q_zh: 使用水面供氣設備潛水時，空氣壓縮機或手動氣泵應多久檢點一次？流量計應多久檢點一次？
a_zh: 每週；每半年
b_zh: 每月；每季
c_zh: 每季；每年
d_zh: 每日；每月
q_en: For surface-supplied diving, the compressor or hand pump is inspected how often, and the flow meter how often?
a_en: Weekly; every six months
b_en: Monthly; every quarter
c_en: Quarterly; every year
d_en: Daily; every month
explain_zh: 第54條第1款：每週檢點空氣壓縮機或手動氣泵；每月檢點空氣清淨裝置及深度表；每季檢點水中計時器；每半年檢點流量計。紀錄保存五年。
explain_en: Article 54(1): compressor weekly; air cleaner and depth gauge monthly; dive timer quarterly; flow meter every six months; records 5 years.

law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
q_zh: 使用水肺供氣潛水者，其氣瓶應多久檢點一次？
a_zh: 每一週
b_zh: 每一年
c_zh: 每半年
d_zh: 每一個月
q_en: For scuba diving, cylinders must be inspected every:
a_en: One week
b_en: One year
c_en: Six months
d_en: One month
explain_zh: 第54條第2款：使用緊急用氣瓶外之水肺供氣者，每月檢點深度表、每季檢點水中計時器、每半年檢點氣瓶。
explain_en: Article 54(2): depth gauge monthly, dive timer quarterly, cylinders every six months.

law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
q_zh: 實施高壓室內作業時應設再壓室；再壓室應避免接近何種場所？
a_zh: 機具停車場、材料堆置區及臨時倉庫等場所
b_zh: 危險物、火藥類或大量易燃性物質儲存場所，及有出水、土砂崩塌之虞場所
c_zh: 員工餐廳、茶水間及休息室等供膳食使用之場所
d_zh: 工地辦公室、監工休息室及會議室等一般行政管理用房舍場所
q_en: A recompression chamber for hyperbaric work must be kept away from:
a_en: Equipment parking areas, material stacking yards and temporary storerooms
b_en: Storage of dangerous goods, explosives or bulk flammables, and places at risk of flooding or collapse
c_en: Staff canteens, tea rooms and rest rooms used for meals and refreshments
d_en: Site offices, supervisor rest rooms, meeting rooms and other general administrative buildings
explain_zh: 第62條：應設再壓室或採取可隨時利用再壓室之措施；再壓室應避免接近危險物火藥類或大量易燃性物質之處置儲存場所，及有出水、土砂崩塌之虞之場所。
explain_en: Article 62: keep away from dangerous goods, explosives or bulk flammables storage, and from places prone to water ingress or earth collapse.

law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
q_zh: 再壓室應設置主再壓室及副再壓室，但何者不在此限？
a_zh: 新購置者
b_zh: 固定型者
c_zh: 室外設置者
d_zh: 移動型者
q_en: A recompression chamber needs main and auxiliary compartments, except for:
a_en: Newly bought chambers
b_en: Fixed chambers
c_en: Outdoor chambers
d_en: Mobile chambers
explain_zh: 第66條：再壓室應設置主再壓室及副再壓室，但移動型者不在此限。第67條：兩室之門應保持氣密，壓力相等時可易於開啟；第68條：均應設置可自外面觀察之視窗。
explain_en: Article 66: mobile chambers are exempt; Articles 67–68: airtight doors that open easily when pressures are equal, and viewing windows on both compartments.

law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
q_zh: 再壓室內應置滅火所必要之水、砂或其他物品，但下列何者不在此限？
a_zh: 再壓室內全面禁菸並設有煙霧偵測警報器者
b_zh: 室內備有乾粉滅火器及防火毯者
c_zh: 室外配置值班人員全程監視者
d_zh: 設有防火用灑水裝置、軟質水管或移動型再壓室者
q_en: Water, sand or similar firefighting items must be inside a recompression chamber, except when:
a_en: Smoking is fully banned and smoke detectors and alarms are fitted
b_en: Dry powder extinguishers and a fire blanket are kept inside
c_en: A duty attendant outside keeps watch throughout the operation
d_en: It has a sprinkler system, a soft water hose, or is a mobile chamber
explain_zh: 第77條：再壓室內應置滅火所必要之水、砂或其他物品，但設有防火用灑水裝置、軟質水管或移動型再壓室者不在此限。第93條減壓艙亦同。
explain_en: Article 77: exempt if equipped with sprinklers or a soft water hose, or if mobile; Article 93 applies the same to decompression chambers.

law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
q_zh: 下列何者屬減壓艙應具備之設備？
a_zh: 內外雙向通話系統、可調節式氧氣呼吸口罩、視窗、深度表、計時表、安全閥
b_zh: 冷氣機、除濕機、空氣清淨機、電風扇、暖氣機、排油煙機及照明燈
c_zh: 電視機、收音機、音響設備、投影機、遊戲機及網路設備
d_zh: 冰箱、飲水機、微波爐、電磁爐、烘碗機及製冰機
q_en: Which are required decompression chamber equipment?
a_en: Two-way intercom, adjustable oxygen masks, viewports, depth gauge, timer, safety valve
b_en: Air conditioner, dehumidifier, air purifier, fan, heater, range hood and lamps
c_en: Television, radio, stereo system, projector, game console, network gear
d_en: Refrigerator, water dispenser, microwave, hotplate, dish dryer, ice maker
explain_zh: 第78條：內外雙向通話系統、可調節式氧氣呼吸口罩、內外控制供排氣系統、水砂桶等滅火器具、內部照明系統、視窗、供排氣之深度控制閥及深度表、計時表、安全閥；並應置於潛水工作船或工作站等安全處所。
explain_en: Article 78: intercom, adjustable oxygen masks, inside/outside supply and exhaust controls, water/sand fire kit, lighting, viewports, depth control valves and gauge, timer, safety valve; located in a safe place on the dive vessel or station.

law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
q_zh: 使潛水人員於減壓艙呼吸純氧減壓時，應先確認何事？
a_zh: 該潛水人員已於作業前連續休息滿八小時
b_zh: 該潛水人員曾通過耐氧試驗，並於執行前通知該人員
c_zh: 減壓艙內溫度及濕度均維持於規定範圍
d_zh: 該潛水人員已於下水前二小時內完成用餐進食
q_en: Before having a diver breathe pure oxygen for decompression in the chamber, the operator must confirm:
a_en: The diver has had eight straight hours of rest before the job
b_en: The diver has passed an oxygen tolerance test and is informed beforehand
c_en: The chamber temperature and humidity are within the set range
d_en: The diver finished a meal within two hours before entering the water
explain_zh: 第80條：由具資格之操作員操作；治療潛水病依醫師指示；使用前檢點；依減壓表執行；如醫療需要呼吸純氧減壓時應確定曾通過耐氧試驗並事前通知；持續監視；事先與最近潛水醫療單位連絡；記錄每次作業。
explain_en: Article 80: qualified operator; treatment per physician; pre-use check; follow tables; oxygen only for divers who passed the oxygen tolerance test and are notified; continuous monitoring; contact the nearest dive medical unit; record each session.

law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
q_zh: 減壓艙使用前，應事先與何單位連絡並保持通訊？
a_zh: 當地航政或港務機關
b_zh: 最近之潛水醫療單位
c_zh: 承保之產物保險公司
d_zh: 中央氣象主管機關
q_en: Before using a decompression chamber, the employer shall contact and stay in touch with:
a_en: The local port or shipping authority
b_en: The nearest diving medical unit
c_en: The underwriting insurance company
d_en: The central weather authority
explain_zh: 第80條第6款：減壓艙使用前，應事先與最近之潛水醫療單位連絡，並保持通訊，以利緊急支援。
explain_en: Article 80(6): contact the nearest diving medical unit in advance and maintain communication for emergency support.

law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
q_zh: 規則所稱「容器」，不包含下列何者？
a_zh: 盛裝化學品之袋、筒、瓶、箱及金屬罐
b_zh: 交通工具內之引擎、燃料槽或其他操作系統
c_zh: 製程用之反應器、儲槽及貯存容器
d_zh: 管路、軟管及其連接配件
q_en: The term 'container' under the Rules does NOT include:
a_en: Bags, drums, bottles, boxes and metal cans for chemicals
b_en: Engines, fuel tanks or operating systems of vehicles
c_en: Process reactors, storage tanks and holding vessels
d_en: Piping, hoses and their connecting fittings
explain_zh: 第3條第2款：容器指任何袋、筒、瓶、箱、罐、桶、反應器、儲槽、管路及其他可盛裝危害性化學品者，但不包含交通工具內之引擎、燃料槽或其他操作系統。
explain_en: Article 3(2): any bag, drum, bottle, box, can, barrel, reactor, tank, piping or other vessel, excluding vehicle engines, fuel tanks and operating systems.

law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
q_zh: 規則所稱「供應者」係指何者？
a_zh: 自國外輸入危害性化學品之廠商
b_zh: 製造危害性化學品供處置使用之廠商
c_zh: 使用危害性化學品之事業單位雇主
d_zh: 批發或零售危害性化學品之廠商
q_en: A 'supplier' under the Rules is:
a_en: A business that imports hazardous chemicals from abroad
b_en: A business that manufactures hazardous chemicals for use
c_en: An employer whose workplace uses hazardous chemicals
d_en: A business that wholesales or retails hazardous chemicals
explain_zh: 第3條：製造者指製造危害性化學品供批發零售處置或使用之廠商；輸入者指從國外進口之廠商；供應者指批發或零售危害性化學品之廠商。
explain_en: Article 3: manufacturer makes the chemicals; importer brings them in from abroad; supplier wholesales or retails them.

law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
q_zh: 容器內之危害性化學品為混合物者，其應標示之「危害成分」指何者？
a_zh: 混合物中任一含量超過百分之五之化學物質成分
b_zh: 符合 CNS 15030 分類具物理性或健康危害之所有成分
c_zh: 混合物中作為主要溶劑使用之單一有機溶劑成分
d_zh: 混合物中依重量百分比計算含量最高之單一化學物質成分
q_en: For a mixture, the 'hazardous ingredients' to be labeled are:
a_en: Any ingredient present in the mixture above five percent
b_en: All ingredients with physical or health hazards under CNS 15030 classification
c_en: Only the organic solvent used as the main solvent in the mixture
d_en: The single ingredient with the highest weight percent in the mixture
explain_zh: 第5條第2項：混合物之危害成分指混合物之危害性中符合CNS 15030分類，具有物理性危害或健康危害之所有危害物質成分。
explain_en: Article 5(2): all hazardous ingredients classified under CNS 15030 as having physical or health hazards.

law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
q_zh: 導管、化學設備等以公告板代替標示時，因製造者、輸入者或供應者名稱地址電話經常變更，在何條件下得免標示該事項？
a_zh: 每月定期更新者
b_zh: 經主管簽名確認者
c_zh: 任何情形均不得免標示
d_zh: 備有安全資料表者
q_en: When a notice board replaces labels on piping or chemical equipment, the supplier name/address/phone may be omitted if:
a_en: It is updated every month
b_en: A manager has signed it off
c_en: It can never be omitted at all
d_en: A safety data sheet is available
explain_zh: 第9條第2項：第2至5款之容器有公告板者，其製造者輸入者或供應者名稱地址電話經常變更，但備有安全資料表者，得免標示第5條第1項第2款第6目之事項。
explain_en: Article 9(2): where supplier details change frequently, they may be omitted if an SDS is kept available.

law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
q_zh: 同一種類之混合物濃度不同而危害成分、用途及危害性相同時，得否使用同一份安全資料表？
a_zh: 得，但應註明不同化學品名稱
b_zh: 得，且無須註明化學品名稱
c_zh: 僅實驗室試藥得共用資料表
d_zh: 不得，應分別製作安全資料表
q_en: May mixtures of the same type but different concentrations, with identical hazardous ingredients, use and hazards, share one SDS?
a_en: Yes, but the different product names must be noted
b_en: Yes, and no product names need be noted
c_en: Only laboratory reagents may share one sheet
d_en: No, a separate sheet must be made for each
explain_zh: 第14條：混合物屬同一種類之化學品，其濃度不同而危害成分、用途及危害性相同時，得使用同一份安全資料表，但應註明不同化學品名稱。
explain_en: Article 14: one SDS may be shared, provided the different chemical names are indicated.

law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
q_zh: 製造者提供之安全資料表有誤寫、缺漏等顯然錯誤時，主管機關應如何處理？
a_zh: 逕處新臺幣三百萬元罰鍰，並命令停工三個月
b_zh: 不經通知即直接吊銷其登記證照，並公告該事業單位名稱
c_zh: 不予處理，由製造者自行決定是否更正其內容
d_zh: 令其限期補正，屆期未補正者依職安法第44條第1項及第49條辦理
q_en: If an SDS contains obvious clerical errors or omissions, the authority shall:
a_en: Fine NT$3 million outright and order a three-month work stoppage
b_en: Revoke the registration licence without notice and publicly publish the firm's name
c_en: Take no action and let the manufacturer decide whether to revise it
d_en: Order correction within a deadline; failure is handled under OSH Act Articles 44(1) and 49
explain_zh: 第15條之1：安全資料表內容有誤寫、缺漏或其他類此顯然錯誤，主管機關或勞動檢查機構應令其限期補正；屆期未補正者，依本法第44條第1項及第49條規定辦理。
explain_en: Article 15-1: order correction by a deadline; if not corrected, apply Articles 44(1) and 49 of the OSH Act.

law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
q_zh: 危害性化學品清單之內容格式，應參照何附表？
a_zh: 附表四
b_zh: 附表一
c_zh: 附表五
d_zh: 附表三
q_en: The hazardous chemical inventory format follows which annex?
a_en: Annex 4
b_en: Annex 1
c_en: Annex 5
d_en: Annex 3
explain_zh: 第17條第1項第2款：製作危害性化學品清單，其內容、格式參照附表五。附表一為分類及標示要項，附表三為應提供SDS之化學品，附表四為SDS格式。
explain_en: Article 17(1)(2): inventory per Annex 5; Annex 1 covers classification and label elements, Annex 3 the chemicals needing SDSs, Annex 4 the SDS format.

law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
q_zh: 申請保留揭示安全資料表資訊，檢附文件不齊全時，應於補正通知後幾日內補正？補正次數以幾次為限？
a_zh: 十五日；一次
b_zh: 七日；不限
c_zh: 六十日；三次
d_zh: 三十日；二次
q_en: For a trade-secret withholding application with incomplete documents, the deadline and maximum number of corrections are:
a_en: 15 days; once
b_en: 7 days; unlimited
c_en: 60 days; three times
d_en: 30 days; twice
explain_zh: 第18條第2項：申請者應於收受補正通知後三十日內補正，補正次數以二次為限；逾期未補正者不予受理。核定後查有不實得撤銷或廢止。
explain_en: Article 18(2): correct within 30 days of notice, at most twice; otherwise not accepted. Approval may be revoked if information is false.

law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
q_zh: 裝有危害性化學品之船舶、航空器或運送車輛之標示，應依何規定辦理？
a_zh: 消防法有關危險物品之規定
b_zh: 本規則附表一之規定
c_zh: 交通法規有關運輸之規定
d_zh: 環境用藥管理法之規定
q_en: Labeling of ships, aircraft or vehicles carrying hazardous chemicals follows:
a_en: Dangerous goods provisions of the Fire Services Act
b_en: The provisions of Annex 1 of these Rules
c_en: Transport provisions of traffic regulations
d_en: The provisions of the Environmental Agents Control Act
explain_zh: 第20條：對裝有危害性化學品之船舶、航空器或運送車輛之標示，應依交通法規有關運輸之規定辦理。
explain_en: Article 20: per the transport provisions of traffic regulations.

law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
q_zh: 放射性物質及 CNS 15030 分類之環境危害性化學品之標示，應依何規定辦理？
a_zh: 游離輻射及環境保護相關法規
b_zh: 本規則第5條之標示規定
c_zh: 交通法規有關運輸之規定
d_zh: 農藥管理法及動物用藥品管理法
q_en: Labeling of radioactive substances and environmentally hazardous chemicals (CNS 15030) follows:
a_en: Ionizing radiation and environmental protection laws
b_en: The labeling provisions of Article 5 of these Rules
c_en: Transport provisions of traffic regulations
d_en: The Agro-pesticides and Veterinary Drugs Acts
explain_zh: 第21條：對放射性物質、CNS 15030分類之環境危害性化學品之標示，應依游離輻射及環境保護相關法規規定辦理。第22條：農藥及環境用藥依農藥及環境用藥相關法規。
explain_en: Article 21: ionizing radiation and environmental laws; Article 22: pesticides and environmental agents follow their own laws.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 職業安全衛生管理辦法係依職業安全衛生法第幾條規定訂定？
a_zh: 第二十三條第五項
b_zh: 第十九條第二項
c_zh: 第六條第三項
d_zh: 第三十二條第三項
q_en: The Regulations of OSH Management are enacted under which article of the OSH Act?
a_en: Article 23, paragraph 5
b_en: Article 19, paragraph 2
c_en: Article 6, paragraph 3
d_en: Article 32, paragraph 3
explain_zh: 第1條：本辦法依職業安全衛生法第二十三條第五項規定訂定之。第1條之1：雇主應依事業規模性質設置安全衛生組織及人員，建立管理制度，透過規劃、實施、評估及改善實現管理目標。
explain_en: Article 1: under Article 23(5); Article 1-1 requires employers to set up an OSH organization and management system with plan-do-check-act functions.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 職業安全衛生管理辦法依危害風險將事業分為幾類？第一類事業指何者？
a_zh: 五類；具特殊風險者
b_zh: 三類；具顯著風險者
c_zh: 四類；具低度風險者
d_zh: 二類；具中度風險者
q_en: How many risk categories of enterprises are there, and what is Category 1?
a_en: Five; enterprises with special risk
b_en: Three; enterprises with significant risk
c_en: Four; enterprises with the lowest risk
d_en: Two; enterprises with moderate risk
explain_zh: 第2條：第一類事業具顯著風險、第二類事業具中度風險、第三類事業具低度風險；各類事業例示如附表一。
explain_en: Article 2: Category 1 = significant risk, Category 2 = moderate risk, Category 3 = low risk, with examples in Annex 1.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業之事業單位勞工人數在幾人以上，應設直接隸屬雇主之專責一級管理單位？
a_zh: 三百人以上
b_zh: 五百人以上
c_zh: 一百人以上
d_zh: 三十人以上
q_en: A Category 1 enterprise with at least how many workers must set up a dedicated first-level OSH management unit directly under the employer?
explain_zh: 第2條之1：第一類事業勞工人數一百人以上應設直接隸屬雇主之專責一級管理單位；第二類事業三百人以上應設直接隸屬雇主之一級管理單位。
explain_en: Article 2-1: Category 1 with 100+ workers needs a dedicated first-level unit; Category 2 with 300+ needs a first-level unit directly under the employer.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第二類事業勞工人數在幾人以上，應設直接隸屬雇主之一級管理單位？
a_zh: 一千人以上
b_zh: 一百人以上
c_zh: 五十人以上
d_zh: 三百人以上
q_en: A Category 2 enterprise with at least how many workers must set up a first-level management unit directly under the employer?
explain_zh: 第2條之1第1項第2款：第二類事業勞工人數在三百人以上者，應設直接隸屬雇主之一級管理單位。
explain_en: Article 2-1(1)(2): Category 2 enterprises with 300 or more workers.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業之事業單位勞工人數在一百人以上者，所置管理人員應為專職；第二類事業三百人以上者，所置管理人員至少幾人為專職？
a_zh: 三人
b_zh: 全部
c_zh: 二人
d_zh: 一人
q_en: For Category 2 enterprises with 300+ workers, at least how many OSH management personnel must be full-time?
a_en: Three
b_en: All
c_en: Two
d_en: One
explain_zh: 第3條第2項：第一類事業勞工人數一百人以上者，所置管理人員應為專職；第二類事業三百人以上者，所置管理人員應至少一人為專職。專職人員應常駐廠場，不得兼任其他法令所定專責人員或從事無關工作。
explain_en: Article 3(2): Category 1 with 100+ workers: all management personnel full-time; Category 2 with 300+: at least one full-time. Full-time staff must be stationed on site and not hold other statutory posts.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 營造業之事業單位對於橋樑、道路、隧道或輸配電等距離較長之工程，應於每幾公里內增置營造業丙種職業安全衛生業務主管一人？
a_zh: 五公里
b_zh: 十公里
c_zh: 二十公里
d_zh: 三公里
q_en: For long linear construction projects such as bridges, roads, tunnels or power lines, one additional Class C construction OSH supervisor is required for every:
a_en: 5 km
b_en: 10 km
c_en: 20 km
d_en: 3 km
explain_zh: 第3條之1第2項：營造業對於橋樑、道路、隧道或輸配電等距離較長之工程，應於每十公里內增置營造業丙種職業安全衛生業務主管一人。
explain_en: Article 3-1(2): one additional Class C construction OSH business supervisor per 10 km.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業之事業單位對於所屬從事製造之一級單位，勞工人數在一百人以上未滿三百人者，應另置何人？
a_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管一人
b_zh: 丁種職業安全衛生業務主管一人
c_zh: 職業安全管理師一人
d_zh: 職業衛生管理師一人
q_en: In a Category 1 enterprise, a manufacturing first-level unit with 100 to under 300 workers must additionally have:
a_en: One Class A OSH business supervisor
b_en: One Class D OSH business supervisor
c_en: One occupational safety management specialist
d_en: One occupational hygiene management specialist
explain_zh: 第3條之1第1項：第一類事業對於所屬從事製造之一級單位，勞工人數一百人以上未滿三百人者應另置甲種職業安全衛生業務主管一人；三百人以上者應再至少增置專職職業安全衛生管理員一人。
explain_en: Article 3-1(1): a Class A OSH business supervisor for 100–299 workers; 300+ also requires at least one additional full-time OSH administrator.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 事業單位勞工人數之計算，是否包含承攬人、再承攬人之勞工？
a_zh: 包含，以同一期間同一工作場所作業之總人數計
b_zh: 由雇主自行認定，不受同一工作場所之限制
c_zh: 不包含，僅計算原事業單位自僱勞工之人數
d_zh: 僅包含承攬人，再承攬人之勞工不列入計算
q_en: Does the worker headcount include contractors' and subcontractors' workers?
a_en: Yes, the total working at the same time and place
b_en: At the employer's discretion for each workplace
c_en: No, only the enterprise's own hired workers
d_en: Contractors only; subcontractors are excluded
explain_zh: 第3條之2：勞工人數之計算，包含原事業單位及其承攬人、再承攬人之勞工及其他受工作場所負責人指揮或監督從事勞動之人員，於同一期間、同一工作場所作業時之總人數；設有總機構者包含各地區事業單位作業勞工人數。
explain_en: Article 3-2: includes the enterprise's own, contractors', subcontractors' workers and others under the workplace manager's direction, working in the same period at the same workplace.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 事業單位勞工人數未滿幾人者，雇主或其代理人經職業安全衛生業務主管教育訓練合格，得擔任該事業單位職業安全衛生業務主管？
a_zh: 五十人
b_zh: 五人
c_zh: 三十人
d_zh: 一百人
q_en: In enterprises with fewer than how many workers may the employer or a representative, having passed the OSH business supervisor training, act as the OSH business supervisor?
explain_zh: 第4條：勞工人數未滿三十人者，雇主或其代理人經業務主管教育訓練合格得擔任業務主管；第二類及第三類事業且勞工五人以下者，得由丁種業務主管訓練合格之雇主或代理人擔任。
explain_en: Article 4: fewer than 30 workers; for Category 2/3 enterprises with 5 or fewer workers, a Class D-trained employer or representative may serve.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第二類及第三類事業之事業單位，勞工人數在幾人以下者，得由丁種職業安全衛生業務主管教育訓練合格之雇主或其代理人擔任業務主管？
a_zh: 十人以下
b_zh: 五人以下
c_zh: 二十人以下
d_zh: 三十人以下
q_en: For Category 2 or 3 enterprises with how many workers or fewer may a Class D-trained employer or representative serve as OSH business supervisor?
a_en: 10 or fewer
b_en: 5 or fewer
c_en: 20 or fewer
d_en: 30 or fewer
explain_zh: 第4條但書：屬第二類及第三類事業之事業單位，且勞工人數在五人以下者，得由經丁種職業安全衛生業務主管教育訓練合格之雇主或其代理人擔任。
explain_en: Article 4 proviso: Category 2/3 enterprises with 5 or fewer workers.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 依職業安全衛生管理辦法，職業安全衛生委員會之職責為何？
a_zh: 查核安全衛生管理事項之執行，並代雇主簽署管理計畫及檢查紀錄
b_zh: 綜理及督導工作場所之安全衛生管理事項，並指揮所屬人員執行業務
c_zh: 擬訂、規劃、推動及督導安全衛生管理事項，並指導有關部門確實實施
d_zh: 對雇主擬訂之安全衛生政策提出建議，並審議、協調、考核及建議安全衛生相關事項
q_en: Under the Regulations, what is the duty of the OSH committee?
a_en: Audit the implementation of OSH matters and sign the management plan and inspection records
b_en: Oversee all OSH management matters of the workplace and direct subordinate staff in carrying them out
c_en: Draft, plan, promote and supervise OSH management matters and guide departments in implementing them
d_en: Advise on the employer's OSH policy and deliberate, coordinate, evaluate and recommend OSH matters
explain_zh: 第5條之1：管理單位擬訂規劃推動督導並指導部門實施；委員會對政策提出建議並審議協調考核建議；管理師／管理員擬訂規劃推動查核並指導實施；工作場所負責人綜理工作場所安全衛生管理事項；各級主管依職責指揮監督所屬執行。
explain_en: Article 5-1: management unit drafts/plans/promotes/supervises; committee advises on policy and deliberates/coordinates/evaluates; specialists and administrators draft/plan/promote/audit; the workplace manager oversees; line managers direct and supervise.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 事業單位未置有職業安全（衛生）管理師、職業安全衛生管理員者，其職業安全衛生業務主管之職責為何？
a_zh: 主管、督導及考核安全衛生管理事項
b_zh: 審議、協調及建議安全衛生相關事項
c_zh: 擬訂、規劃、推動及查核安全衛生管理事項
d_zh: 指揮、監督所屬執行安全衛生管理事項
q_en: If an enterprise has no OSH management specialist or administrator, the OSH business supervisor's duty is to:
a_en: Direct, supervise and evaluate OSH management matters
b_en: Deliberate, coordinate and recommend OSH-related matters
c_en: Draft, plan, promote and audit OSH management matters
d_en: Direct and supervise subordinates in OSH management work
explain_zh: 第5條之1第3款：置有管理師、管理員者，業務主管主管及督導安全衛生管理事項；未置有者，業務主管擬訂、規劃、推動及查核安全衛生管理事項。
explain_en: Article 5-1(3): with specialists/administrators the supervisor directs and oversees; without them the supervisor drafts, plans, promotes and audits.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 事業設有總機構者，第一類事業勞工人數在幾人以上，應於總機構設直接隸屬雇主之專責一級管理單位？第三類事業幾人以上應設管理單位？
a_zh: 五百人；三千人
b_zh: 一百人；五百人
c_zh: 三百人；一千人
d_zh: 一千人；五千人
q_en: For an enterprise with a head office, a Category 1 enterprise with how many workers needs a dedicated first-level unit at head office, and Category 3 with how many needs a management unit?
explain_zh: 第6條第2項：設有總機構者，第一類事業五百人以上應設直接隸屬雇主之專責一級管理單位；第二類事業五百人以上應設直接隸屬雇主之一級管理單位；第三類事業三千人以上應設管理單位；所置管理人員應為專職（第二、三類之業務主管除外）。
explain_en: Article 6(2): Category 1 with 500+ → dedicated first-level unit; Category 2 with 500+ → first-level unit; Category 3 with 3,000+ → management unit; personnel full-time except Category 2/3 business supervisors.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業單位已實施職業安全衛生管理系統，管理績效經中央主管機關審查通過者，得不受何種限制？
a_zh: 機械設備實施定期檢查及重點檢查之限制
b_zh: 管理人員應接受安全衛生教育訓練之限制
c_zh: 一級管理單位應為專責及業務主管應為專職之限制
d_zh: 設置職業安全衛生委員會及置勞工代表之限制
q_en: A Category 1 enterprise with an OSH management system whose performance has been approved by the central authority is exempt from:
a_en: The requirement to carry out periodic and focused inspections of machinery and equipment
b_en: The requirement that management personnel receive OSH education and training
c_en: The requirements that the first-level unit be dedicated and the business supervisor full-time
d_en: The requirement to establish an OSH committee with labor representatives on it
explain_zh: 第6條之1：第一類事業單位或其總機構已實施第12條之2管理系統相關管理制度，管理績效經中央主管機關審查通過者，得不受第2條之1、第3條及第6條有關一級管理單位應為專責及業務主管應為專職之限制。
explain_en: Article 6-1: exempt from the dedicated-unit and full-time-supervisor requirements of Articles 2-1, 3 and 6.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 下列何者為職業安全衛生管理員之資格之一？
a_zh: 領有職業安全衛生管理乙級技術士證照
b_zh: 具工業安全技師資格
c_zh: 高等考試職業安全衛生類科錄取
d_zh: 領有職業安全管理甲級技術士證照
q_en: Which is a qualification for an OSH administrator?
a_en: Class B technician certificate in OSH management
b_en: Industrial safety engineer (技師) license
c_en: Passing the senior civil service OSH exam
d_en: Class A technician certificate in occupational safety management
explain_zh: 第7條第2項第3款：職業安全衛生管理員資格：具管理師資格；領有職業安全衛生管理乙級技術士證照；曾任勞動檢查員具二年以上檢查經驗；普通考試職業安全衛生類科錄取（大專相關科系畢業之目自103年7月1日不再適用）。其他選項為管理師資格。
explain_en: Article 7(2)(3): administrator qualifications include a Class B OSH management technician certificate, 2+ years as a labor inspector, or passing the junior civil service exam; the other options are specialist-level qualifications.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 職業安全管理師之資格，曾任勞動檢查員者須具有職業安全檢查工作經驗幾年以上？
a_zh: 一年以上
b_zh: 五年以上
c_zh: 二年以上
d_zh: 三年以上
q_en: A former labor inspector qualifies as an occupational safety management specialist with how many years of safety inspection experience?
a_en: At least 1 year
b_en: At least 5 years
c_en: At least 2 years
d_en: At least 3 years
explain_zh: 第7條第2項第1款：職業安全管理師資格：高考職業安全衛生類科錄取或工業安全技師；職業安全管理甲級技術士；曾任勞動檢查員具職業安全檢查經驗三年以上。管理員則為二年以上。
explain_en: Article 7(2)(1): 3+ years for specialists; 2+ years for administrators.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 營造業之事業單位的職業安全衛生業務主管，應由何人選任？
a_zh: 領有職業安全衛生管理乙級技術士證照者
b_zh: 曾任勞動檢查員具二年以上檢查經驗者
c_zh: 曾受營造業職業安全衛生業務主管教育訓練者
d_zh: 曾受甲種職業安全衛生業務主管教育訓練者
q_en: In a construction enterprise, the OSH business supervisor must be selected from:
a_en: Persons holding a Class B technician certificate in OSH management
b_en: Persons with at least two years of experience as a labor inspector
c_en: Persons who have completed construction-industry OSH business supervisor training
d_en: Persons who have completed Class A OSH business supervisor training courses
explain_zh: 第7條第1項：業務主管應自事業之相關主管或辦理職業安全衛生事務者選任；但營造業之事業單位，應由曾受營造業職業安全衛生業務主管教育訓練者選任之。
explain_en: Article 7(1): construction enterprises must select someone trained as a construction-industry OSH business supervisor.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 職業安全衛生人員因故未能執行職務時，雇主應即指定代理人，其代理期間不得超過多久？
a_zh: 六個月
b_zh: 一個月
c_zh: 一年
d_zh: 三個月
q_en: When OSH personnel cannot perform their duties, the employer must appoint a deputy; the deputy period shall not exceed:
a_en: 6 months
b_en: 1 month
c_en: 1 year
d_en: 3 months
explain_zh: 第8條：雇主應即指定適當代理人，代理期間不得超過三個月；勞工人數三十人以上之事業單位，其職業安全衛生人員離職時應即報當地勞動檢查機構備查。
explain_en: Article 8: not more than three months; enterprises with 30+ workers must report the departure of OSH personnel to the labor inspection agency.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 勞工人數在幾人以上之事業單位，其職業安全衛生人員離職時應即報當地勞動檢查機構備查？
a_zh: 十人以上
b_zh: 三百人以上
c_zh: 三十人以上
d_zh: 一百人以上
q_en: Enterprises with at least how many workers must report the departure of OSH personnel to the local labor inspection agency?
explain_zh: 第8條第2項：勞工人數在三十人以上之事業單位，其職業安全衛生人員離職時，應即報當地勞動檢查機構備查。第86條：三十人以上設管理單位或置管理人員時亦應登錄報備。
explain_en: Article 8(2): 30 or more; Article 86 also requires such enterprises to register their management unit and personnel.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 職業安全衛生委員會置委員幾人以上？委員任期幾年？
a_zh: 七人以上；二年
b_zh: 三人以上；二年
c_zh: 五人以上；一年
d_zh: 九人以上；三年
q_en: An OSH committee has at least how many members, serving terms of how long?
a_en: 7; 2 years
b_en: 3; 2 years
c_en: 5; 1 year
d_en: 9; 3 years
explain_zh: 第11條：委員會置委員七人以上，除雇主為當然委員外由雇主指定勞工代表、各部門主管、職業安全衛生人員、勞工健康服務人員、其他專業人員組成；委員任期二年，雇主為主任委員綜理會務，並指定一人為秘書。
explain_en: Article 11: at least 7 members including the employer as ex-officio chair; 2-year terms; the chair appoints a secretary.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 職業安全衛生委員會之勞工代表應佔委員人數多少以上？
a_zh: 四分之一以上
b_zh: 二分之一以上
c_zh: 五分之一以上
d_zh: 三分之一以上
q_en: Labor representatives must make up at least what share of OSH committee members?
a_en: One quarter
b_en: One half
c_en: One fifth
d_en: One third
explain_zh: 第11條第4項：勞工代表應佔委員人數三分之一以上；設有工會者由工會推派，無工會而有勞資會議者由勞方代表推選，均無者由勞工共同推選。
explain_en: Article 11(4): at least one third, nominated by the union, or elected by labor representatives of the labor-management meeting, or elected by workers.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 職業安全衛生委員會應多久至少開會一次？其紀錄保存幾年？
a_zh: 每六個月；五年
b_zh: 每年；三年
c_zh: 每三個月；三年
d_zh: 每月；一年
q_en: The OSH committee must meet at least once every how long, and keep minutes for how many years?
a_en: 6 months; 5 years
b_en: Year; 3 years
c_en: 3 months; 3 years
d_en: Month; 1 year
explain_zh: 第12條：委員會應每三個月至少開會一次，審議政策建議、管理計畫、教育訓練計畫、環境監測、健康管理、提案、自動檢查、災害調查報告、承攬管理等；審議協調考核建議事項應作成紀錄保存三年；由主任委員擔任主席，必要時得召開臨時會議。
explain_en: Article 12: at least quarterly; records kept 3 years; the chair presides and may call extraordinary meetings.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 勞工人數未滿幾人之事業單位，得以安全衛生管理執行紀錄或文件代替職業安全衛生管理計畫？
a_zh: 十人
b_zh: 五十人
c_zh: 三十人
d_zh: 一百人
q_en: Enterprises with fewer than how many workers may replace the OSH management plan with execution records or documents?
explain_zh: 第12條之1第2項：雇主應依規模性質及風險評估結果訂定職業安全衛生管理計畫；勞工人數未滿三十人之事業單位得以執行紀錄或文件代替；一百人以上者應另訂定職業安全衛生管理規章。
explain_en: Article 12-1(2): fewer than 30; enterprises with 100+ workers must also formulate OSH management rules.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 勞工人數在幾人以上之事業單位，應另訂定職業安全衛生管理規章？
a_zh: 一百人以上
b_zh: 三十人以上
c_zh: 五百人以上
d_zh: 三百人以上
q_en: Enterprises with at least how many workers must additionally formulate OSH management rules (regulations)?
explain_zh: 第12條之1第3項：勞工人數在一百人以上之事業單位，應另訂定職業安全衛生管理規章。

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 下列何者為職業安全衛生管理計畫應包括之事項？
a_zh: 產品定價、通路折扣及成本分析
b_zh: 採購管理、承攬管理及變更管理
c_zh: 行銷策略、廣告預算及客戶關係管理
d_zh: 股東會議程、董事改選及股利分配
q_en: Which must be included in the OSH management plan?
a_en: Product pricing, discounts and cost analysis
b_en: Procurement, contractor and change management
c_en: Marketing strategy and advertising budget control
d_en: Shareholder meeting agenda and dividend distribution
explain_zh: 第12條之1第4項：管理計畫應包括機械設備器具管理、危害性化學品分類標示通識管理、有害作業環境採樣策略及監測、危險性工作場所製程或施工安全評估、採購承攬變更管理、安全衛生作業標準、定期檢查重點檢查作業檢點現場巡視、教育訓練、個人防護具管理、健康檢查管理促進、資訊蒐集分享、緊急應變、災害虛驚事故調查統計、稽核績效評估等。執行紀錄保存三年。
explain_en: Article 12-1(4): 15 items including equipment management, chemical hazard communication, environmental monitoring, process/construction safety assessment, procurement/contractor/change management, SOPs, inspections, training, PPE, health, information, emergency response, incident investigation and audits; records kept 3 years.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事工作前，應就工作場所之建築物、機械、設備、原料等或作業活動實施何事？
a_zh: 市場評估，並依結果調整產品產能及售價
b_zh: 財務評估，並依結果編列年度安全衛生預算
c_zh: 風險評估，並依結果採取必要之預防設備及措施
d_zh: 環境影響評估，並報請環保主管機關核定
q_en: Before assigning work, the employer shall carry out what on buildings, machinery, equipment, materials and activities?
a_en: A market assessment, then adjust product capacity and pricing accordingly
b_en: A financial assessment, then set the annual safety and health budget
c_en: A risk assessment, then take preventive equipment and measures per the results
d_en: An environmental impact assessment submitted to the environmental authority
explain_zh: 第12條之1第1項：雇主使勞工從事工作前，應就工作場所內之建築物、機械、設備、器具、原料、材料等或作業活動及其他可能引起之危害因素實施風險評估，並依評估結果採取必要之預防設備及措施。
explain_en: Article 12-1(1): a risk assessment of workplace hazards, with preventive equipment and measures based on the results.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 下列何種事業單位，雇主應依 CNS 45001 同等以上規定建置職業安全衛生管理系統？
a_zh: 第三類事業勞工人數在一百人以上者
b_zh: 所有第一類及第二類事業之事業單位
c_zh: 第一類事業勞工人數在二百人以上者
d_zh: 第一類事業勞工人數在三十人以上者
q_en: Which enterprises must establish an OSH management system equivalent to CNS 45001 or better?
a_en: Category 3 enterprises with 100+ workers
b_en: All Category 1 and Category 2 enterprises
c_en: Category 1 enterprises with 200+ workers
d_en: Category 1 enterprises with 30+ workers
explain_zh: 第12條之2：第一類事業二百人以上；第二類事業五百人以上；從事石油裂解之石化工業工作場所；製造處置使用危害性化學品達規定量之工作場所；其他指定者。執行紀錄保存三年。
explain_en: Article 12-2: Category 1 with 200+; Category 2 with 500+; petroleum cracking petrochemical workplaces; workplaces handling hazardous chemicals above threshold quantities; others designated. Records kept 3 years.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第二類事業勞工人數在幾人以上，應建置職業安全衛生管理系統？
a_zh: 二百人以上
b_zh: 五百人以上
c_zh: 三百人以上
d_zh: 一千人以上
q_en: Category 2 enterprises with at least how many workers must establish an OSH management system?
explain_zh: 第12條之2第1項第2款：第二類事業勞工人數在五百人以上者。

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 應建置管理系統之事業單位，於引進或修改製程、作業程序、材料及設備前，應如何？
a_zh: 依變更管理程序辨識危害、評估風險並採取預防措施，檢討更新文件並使勞工知悉及受訓
b_zh: 僅以口頭通知現場主管，並由承攬人自行判斷是否需要辨識危害及評估風險
c_zh: 先行施作，於作業完成後再檢討是否需要辨識危害及更新相關安全衛生文件
d_zh: 報請勞動檢查機構核准後施行，並於施行後三個月內補行風險評估及教育訓練
q_en: Before introducing or modifying processes, procedures, materials or equipment, enterprises required to have a management system shall:
a_en: Follow a management-of-change procedure: identify hazards, assess risk, take precautions, update documents, inform and train workers
b_en: Give verbal notice to the site supervisor and let the contractor decide whether hazards need to be identified and assessed
c_en: Implement the change directly and review afterwards whether hazard identification, risk assessment and document updates are needed
d_en: Obtain approval from the labor inspection agency first, then carry out the risk assessment and worker training within three months
explain_zh: 第12條之3：應建立變更管理程序，於引進或修改製程、作業程序、材料及設備前辨識可能危害及評估風險，依結果採取預防設備及措施；檢討更新相關安全衛生文件，使勞工充分知悉及接受教育訓練；紀錄保存三年。
explain_en: Article 12-3: management-of-change procedure with hazard identification, risk assessment, precautions, document updates, worker awareness and training; records 3 years.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 應建置管理系統之事業單位將營繕工程交付規劃、設計時，應如何？
a_zh: 僅就工程總價辦理比價及議價，由最低標廠商負責施工安全
b_zh: 將施工安全全權委由承攬人負責，原事業單位僅辦理竣工驗收
c_zh: 由監造單位於開工後補訂施工管理規範，不需納入契約履約要件
d_zh: 依工程特性實施風險評估、訂定施工管理規範並納入施工及監造履約要件
q_en: When such enterprises commission planning or design of construction works, they shall:
a_en: Merely compare and negotiate prices for the total project cost and let the lowest bidder take responsibility for construction safety on site
b_en: Leave construction safety entirely to the contractor, with the principal enterprise only handling final acceptance of the completed works
c_en: Let the supervising firm draw up construction management specifications after work starts, without including them in the contract requirements
d_en: Assess risks per project characteristics, set construction management specifications, and include them in construction and supervision contract terms
explain_zh: 第12條之4：應建立採購管理程序，採購租賃契約應有職業安全衛生具體規範並於驗收使用前確認；將營繕工程交付規劃設計時應依工程特性實施風險評估及訂定施工管理規範，納入施工及監造履約要件；紀錄保存三年。
explain_en: Article 12-4: procurement procedures with concrete OSH specifications; for construction works, risk assessment and construction management rules built into contract requirements; records 3 years.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 應建置管理系統之事業單位將營繕工程交付二個以上施工者施工時，應如何？
a_zh: 指定勞工人數最多之施工者辦理進場管制，不需實施風險評估
b_zh: 指定施工者之一實施整體工程施工風險評估及必要之統合管理
c_zh: 由業主自行進場施工，並將統合管理職責交由監造單位辦理
d_zh: 由各施工者各自實施風險評估，原事業單位不需另行統合管理
q_en: When construction works are awarded to two or more contractors, the enterprise shall:
a_en: Designate the contractor with the most workers to control site access, with no risk assessment
b_en: Designate one contractor to perform overall construction risk assessment and integrated management
c_en: Carry out the work itself and hand integrated management duties to the supervising firm
d_en: Let each contractor assess its own risks, with the principal enterprise doing no integrated management
explain_zh: 第12條之5：應訂定承攬管理計畫（承攬人管理能力、災害事故通報、危險作業管制、教育訓練、進場管制、緊急應變、績效評估）；交付二個以上施工者時應指定其一實施整體施工風險評估及統合管理；紀錄保存三年。
explain_en: Article 12-5: contractor management plan covering capability, incident reporting, hazardous-work control, training, site access, emergency response and performance; designate one contractor for overall risk assessment and coordination; records 3 years.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 緊急狀況預防、準備及應變計畫應包括下列何者？
a_zh: 產品開發時程、原料採購、生產排程、品質檢驗、包裝設計、與經銷商之議價機制
b_zh: 應變組織及職責、通報程序、處理程序、避難疏散、應變設備、與外部救援單位之聯繫機制
c_zh: 年度營運預算、部門人事編制、設備採購清單、員工績效考核、股東權益分配、產品行銷計畫
d_zh: 員工旅遊行程、住宿安排、交通接駁、保險投保、餐飲安排、與旅行社之聯繫窗口
q_en: An emergency prevention, preparedness and response plan must include:
a_en: Product development schedule, raw material purchasing, production scheduling, quality testing, packaging design, dealer price talks
b_en: Response organization and duties, reporting procedures, handling procedures, evacuation, response equipment, liaison with external rescue units
c_en: Annual operating budget, departmental staffing, equipment purchase lists, staff performance reviews, dividend allocation, marketing plans
d_en: Staff trip itinerary, lodging arrangements, shuttle transport, travel insurance, catering, liaison with the travel agency contact
explain_zh: 第12條之6：應評估潛在風險訂定緊急狀況預防準備及應變計畫，定期辦理教育訓練與演練並檢討修正；計畫包括應變組織及職責、通報程序、各項緊急狀況處理程序、避難疏散措施、必要應變設備、與外部救援單位之聯繫機制；紀錄保存三年。
explain_en: Article 12-6: the six elements listed, with periodic training and drills and plan revision; records 3 years.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對電氣機車、蓄電池機車、內燃機車、蒸汽機車等，應每幾年就整體定期實施檢查一次？
a_zh: 三年
b_zh: 一年
c_zh: 二年
d_zh: 五年
q_en: Electric, battery, internal-combustion and steam locomotives must undergo an overall periodic inspection every:
a_en: 3 years
b_en: 1 year
c_en: 2 years
d_en: 5 years
explain_zh: 第13條：電氣機車等應每三年就整體定期檢查一次，每年就電動機控制裝置制動器等檢查一次，每月就車體裝置項目檢查一次。
explain_en: Article 13: overall every 3 years, specified items yearly, and body-mounted items monthly.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對一般車輛，應每多久就車輛各項安全性能定期實施檢查一次？
a_zh: 每二個月
b_zh: 每六個月
c_zh: 每半個月
d_zh: 每三個月
q_en: General vehicles must have their safety performance inspected every:
a_en: 2 months
b_en: 6 months
c_en: 2 weeks
d_en: 3 months
explain_zh: 第14條：一般車輛應每三個月就各項安全性能定期檢查一次。第15條：車輛頂高機每三個月檢查一次以上。
explain_en: Article 14: every three months; Article 15: vehicle lifts at least every three months.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對高空工作車，應每年實施整體檢查一次外，每多久定期檢查制動裝置、作業裝置及安全裝置一次？
a_zh: 每月
b_zh: 每半年
c_zh: 每週
d_zh: 每三個月
q_en: Besides the annual inspection, aerial work platforms (boom lifts) must have brakes, work devices and safety devices inspected every:
a_en: Month
b_en: 6 months
c_en: Week
d_en: 3 months
explain_zh: 第15條之1：高空工作車每年就原動機、動力傳動、走行、操作、制動、作業、油壓、電氣、安全裝置等檢查一次；第15條之2：每月檢查制動裝置離合器操作裝置、作業裝置油壓裝置、安全裝置；第50條之1：每日作業前檢點。
explain_en: Article 15-1: annual items; Article 15-2: monthly brakes/clutch/controls, work and hydraulic devices, safety devices; Article 50-1: daily pre-use check.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對車輛系營建機械應每年整體檢查一次，並每月檢查何項目？
a_zh: 制動器離合器操作及作業裝置、鋼索及鏈、吊斗及鏟斗、倒車或旋轉警示燈及蜂鳴器
b_zh: 引擎機油油量及品質、冷卻水位、燃油濾清器、雨刷及車內空調出風口
c_zh: 輪胎胎壓及磨耗、備胎規格、輪圈螺絲扭力、車身鈑金及烤漆外觀狀況
d_zh: 車牌號碼及懸掛位置、行車執照效期、保險單、駕駛人駕照類別及有效期限
q_en: Vehicle-type construction machinery is inspected overall yearly and monthly for:
a_en: Brakes/clutch/controls/work devices, wire ropes and chains, buckets, reversing or slewing warning lights and buzzers
b_en: Engine oil level and quality, coolant level, fuel filter, wipers and the cabin air-conditioning vents
c_en: Tire pressure and wear, spare tire size, wheel nut torque, and the condition of body panels and paintwork
d_en: License plate and its mounting, vehicle licence validity, insurance policy, and the driver's licence class and expiry
explain_zh: 第16條：車輛系營建機械每年整體檢查一次；每月檢查制動器離合器操作裝置及作業裝置、鋼索及鏈有無損傷、吊斗及鏟斗有無損傷、倒車或旋轉警示燈及蜂鳴器有無異常。
explain_en: Article 16: monthly checks of brakes, clutch, controls and work devices, ropes and chains, buckets, and reversing/slewing warning lights and buzzers.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對堆高機，應每年整體檢查一次，並每月檢查何項目？
a_zh: 電瓶液位及端子腐蝕、充電器與電纜、車燈與方向燈之亮度
b_zh: 喇叭與倒車蜂鳴器音量、後視鏡角度、車身標示及銘板字跡
c_zh: 輪胎胎壓及磨耗狀況、備胎與輪圈螺絲、腳踏板及座椅安全帶
d_zh: 制動裝置離合器及方向裝置、積載裝置及油壓裝置、貨叉鍊條頂蓬及桅桿
q_en: Forklifts are inspected overall yearly and monthly for:
a_en: Battery fluid level and terminal corrosion; charger and cables; headlamp and indicator brightness
b_en: Horn and reversing buzzer volume; mirror angles; body markings and nameplate legibility
c_en: Tire pressure and wear; spare tire and wheel nuts; footboards and the operator's seat belt
d_en: Brakes, clutch and steering; load and hydraulic devices; forks, chains, overhead guard and mast
explain_zh: 第17條：堆高機每年就整體定期檢查一次；每月檢查制動裝置、離合器及方向裝置，積載裝置及油壓裝置，貨叉、鍊條、頂蓬及桅桿。
explain_en: Article 17: monthly brakes/clutch/steering, load and hydraulic systems, forks, chains, overhead guard and mast.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對固定式起重機應每年整體檢查一次、每月檢查安全裝置鋼索吊具等；於輻射區及高溫區停用超過多久者得免實施每月檢查？
a_zh: 一個月
b_zh: 一週
c_zh: 三個月
d_zh: 六個月
q_en: For overhead cranes in radiation or high-temperature zones, monthly inspection may be skipped if the crane is out of service for more than:
a_en: 1 month
b_en: 1 week
c_en: 3 months
d_en: 6 months
explain_zh: 第19條：固定式起重機每年整體檢查、每月檢查過捲預防裝置警報裝置制動器離合器安全裝置、鋼索吊鏈、吊鉤抓斗、配線集電裝置配電盤開關控制裝置、纜索固定式起重機之鋼纜絞車；於輻射區及高溫區停用超過一個月者得免每月檢查，再度使用時仍應為之。
explain_en: Article 19: monthly inspection may be omitted after over a month out of service in radiation or high-temperature areas, but must be done before reuse.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對移動式起重機每年定期檢查時，迴轉裝置應如何檢查？
a_zh: 有無異常並依原製造廠規定量測位移及螺栓扭力值
b_zh: 僅以目視檢查有無鏽蝕，並記錄於每月檢查表中
c_zh: 由操作人員每日試轉一次，無異音即可免予量測
d_zh: 依勞動檢查機構指定之週期，每三年量測一次即可
q_en: During the annual inspection of a mobile crane, the slewing device must be:
a_en: Checked for abnormality with displacement and bolt torque measured per the manufacturer's specifications
b_en: Checked visually for rust only, with the result recorded on the monthly inspection sheet
c_en: Test-rotated once a day by the operator, with no measurement needed if there is no abnormal noise
d_en: Measured once every three years on the cycle designated by the labor inspection agency
explain_zh: 第20條：移動式起重機每年檢查伸臂外伸撐座動力傳導裝置結構、迴轉裝置（含螺栓螺帽）有無異常並依原製造廠規定量測位移及螺栓扭力值、過捲預防警報制動離合器安全裝置、鋼索吊鏈吊具、配線集電配電盤開關等；每月檢查安全裝置鋼索吊具配線等。
explain_en: Article 20: annual check of boom, outriggers, drivetrain, slewing ring (bolts/nuts) with displacement and bolt torque measured per manufacturer, safety devices, ropes/chains/hooks and electrics; monthly checks of safety devices, ropes and electrics.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對升降機應每年整體檢查一次，每月檢查之項目不包括下列何者？
a_zh: 終點極限開關緊急停止裝置制動器控制裝置
b_zh: 車廂內裝飾
c_zh: 導軌之狀況
d_zh: 鋼索或吊鏈有無損傷
q_en: Which is NOT a monthly inspection item for elevators (lifts)?
a_en: Final limit switches, emergency stop, brakes and controls
b_en: Car interior decoration
c_en: Guide rails
d_en: Wire ropes or chains
explain_zh: 第22條：升降機每年整體檢查一次；每月檢查終點極限開關、緊急停止裝置、制動器、控制裝置及其他安全裝置，鋼索或吊鏈，導軌狀況，室外升降機之導索結頭。
explain_en: Article 22: monthly items are limit switches/emergency stop/brakes/controls and other safety devices, ropes or chains, guide rails, and rope terminations for outdoor lifts.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對吊籠應每多久定期檢查過捲預防裝置、制動器、吊臂伸臂工作台、升降裝置配線配電盤一次？
a_zh: 每季
b_zh: 每週
c_zh: 每年
d_zh: 每月
q_en: Gondolas (suspended platforms) must have safety devices, arms, platform and hoist electrics inspected every:
a_en: Quarter
b_en: Week
c_en: Year
d_en: Month
explain_zh: 第24條：吊籠應每月檢查過捲預防裝置制動器控制裝置及其他安全裝置、吊臂伸臂及工作台、升降裝置配線配電盤。第56條：每日作業前檢點，惡劣氣候後應實施第3至5款檢點。
explain_en: Article 24: monthly; Article 56: daily pre-use checks, with extra checks after severe weather.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對以動力驅動之衝剪機械，應每年就下列何項目定期檢查？
a_zh: 機台外觀有無鏽蝕、烤漆脫落、銘板字跡、防護罩顏色、地面油污及周邊照明亮度、操作人員服裝儀容
b_zh: 潤滑油油位及品質、油品更換日期、油桶標示、廢油回收紀錄、供油商合約及採購單價
c_zh: 離合器及制動裝置、曲柄軸飛輪滑塊連結螺栓連桿、一行程一停止機構及緊急制動器、電磁閥減壓閥壓力表、配線及開關
d_zh: 運轉噪音分貝值、振動頻率、機油氣味、廠房溫濕度、員工聽力保護具配戴情形及休息時間
q_en: Power presses and shears must be inspected annually for:
a_en: Rust on the machine exterior; peeling paint; nameplate legibility; guard colour; oil stains on the floor; ambient lighting levels; and the operators' clothing and grooming
b_en: Lubricant level and quality; oil change dates; drum labelling; waste oil recovery records; the supply contract with the oil vendor; and the unit purchase price
c_en: Clutch and brakes; crankshaft, flywheel, slide, bolts and connecting rods; single-stroke mechanism and emergency stop; solenoid valves, regulators and gauges; wiring and switches
d_en: Running noise in decibels; vibration frequency; oil smell; workshop temperature and humidity; whether workers wear hearing protection; and the length of rest breaks
explain_zh: 第26條：動力衝剪機械每年檢查離合器及制動裝置，曲柄軸飛輪滑塊連結螺栓及連桿，一行程一停止機構及緊急制動器，電磁閥減壓閥及壓力表，配線及開關。第59條：每日作業前檢點。
explain_en: Article 26: the listed items annually; Article 59: daily pre-use check.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對乾燥設備及以氣體或液體燃料為熱源之加熱設備，應每多久定期檢查一次？
a_zh: 每二年
b_zh: 每月
c_zh: 每三年
d_zh: 每年
q_en: Drying equipment and gas- or liquid-fuel heating equipment must be inspected every:
a_en: 2 years
b_en: Month
c_en: 3 years
d_en: Year
explain_zh: 第27條：乾燥設備、以氣體燃料或液體燃料為熱源之加熱設備及其附屬設備應每年檢查內外面損傷腐蝕、排出氣體蒸氣粉塵設備、換氣設備、開口部、溫度測定調整裝置、內部電氣器具配線、燃料供應系統控制閥電磁遮斷閥等安全遮斷裝置。
explain_en: Article 27: annually, covering corrosion, exhaust devices, ventilation, openings, temperature controls, internal electrics and fuel shut-off devices.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對高壓電氣設備及低壓電氣設備，應每多久定期檢查一次？
a_zh: 每季
b_zh: 每月
c_zh: 每年
d_zh: 每二年
q_en: High-voltage and low-voltage electrical equipment must be inspected every:
a_en: Quarter
b_en: Month
c_en: Year
d_en: 2 years
explain_zh: 第30條、第31條：高壓及低壓電氣設備應每年檢查受電盤及分電盤動作試驗、用電設備絕緣情形接地電阻及安全設備、自備屋外配電線路。第31條之1：防爆電氣設備應每月檢查。
explain_en: Articles 30–31: annually (switchboard tests, insulation, grounding resistance, outdoor lines); Article 31-1: explosion-proof electrical equipment monthly.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對於防爆電氣設備，應每多久定期檢查本體及配管配線有無損傷變形一次？
a_zh: 每週
b_zh: 每季
c_zh: 每年
d_zh: 每月
q_en: Explosion-proof electrical equipment must be inspected for damage or deformation of the body, conduits and wiring every:
a_en: Week
b_en: Quarter
c_en: Year
d_en: Month
explain_zh: 第31條之1：防爆電氣設備應每月檢查本體有無損傷變形、配管配線有無損傷變形及異常、其他保持防爆性能之必要事項。

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對鍋爐應每多久定期檢查本體、燃燒裝置、自動控制裝置及附屬裝置一次？
a_zh: 每季
b_zh: 每年
c_zh: 每月
d_zh: 每週
q_en: Boilers must have their body, combustion system, automatic controls and accessories inspected every:
a_en: Quarter
b_en: Year
c_en: Month
d_en: Week
explain_zh: 第32條：鍋爐應每月檢查本體損傷、燃燒裝置（油加熱器燃料輸送噴燃器過濾器爐壁加煤機煙道）、自動控制裝置（起動停止火焰檢出燃料切斷水位壓力調節）、附屬裝置（給水蒸汽管停止閥空氣預熱器水處理）。第34條：小型鍋爐每年檢查。
explain_en: Article 32: monthly; Article 34: small boilers annually.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對高壓氣體特定設備、高壓氣體容器及第一種壓力容器，應每多久定期檢查一次？
a_zh: 每月
b_zh: 每週
c_zh: 每二年
d_zh: 每年
q_en: High-pressure gas specific equipment, gas containers and Class 1 pressure vessels must be inspected every:
a_en: Month
b_en: Week
c_en: 2 years
d_en: Year
explain_zh: 第33條：高壓氣體特定設備、高壓氣體容器及第一種壓力容器每月檢查本體損傷變形、蓋板螺栓損耗、管凸緣閥旋塞損傷洩漏、壓力表溫度計安全裝置、平台支架腐蝕；有保溫部分或高游離輻射污染場所得免。第35條：第二種壓力容器每年；第36條：小型壓力容器每年。
explain_en: Article 33: monthly; Article 35: Class 2 pressure vessels yearly; Article 36: small pressure vessels yearly.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對高壓氣體儲存能力在多少以上之儲槽，應每年定期測定其沈陷狀況一次？
a_zh: 一百立方公尺或一公噸以上
b_zh: 一千立方公尺或十公噸以上
c_zh: 五百立方公尺或五公噸以上
d_zh: 十立方公尺或零點五公噸以上
q_en: High-pressure gas storage tanks with a capacity of at least what must have settlement measured yearly?
a_en: 100 m³ or 1 tonne
b_en: 1,000 m³ or 10 tonnes
c_en: 500 m³ or 5 tonnes
d_en: 10 m³ or 0.5 tonne
explain_zh: 第37條：高壓氣體儲存能力在一百立方公尺或一公噸以上之儲槽應注意有無沈陷現象，並應每年定期測定其沈陷狀況一次。
explain_en: Article 37: tanks of 100 m³ or 1 tonne or more, settlement measured once a year.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對特定化學設備或其附屬設備，及化學設備及其附屬設備，應每多久定期檢查一次？
a_zh: 每三年
b_zh: 每二年
c_zh: 每年
d_zh: 每月
q_en: Specified chemical equipment and chemical equipment with their accessories must be inspected every:
a_en: 3 years
b_en: 2 years
c_en: Year
d_en: Month
explain_zh: 第38條：特定化學設備或附屬設備每二年檢查內部物質、損傷變形腐蝕、蓋凸緣閥旋塞、安全閥緊急遮斷裝置警報裝置、冷卻攪拌壓縮計測控制性能、備用動力源、配管熔接接頭等。第39條：化學設備及附屬設備亦每二年。第49條：特定化學設備開始使用改造修理時應重點檢查。
explain_en: Articles 38–39: every two years; Article 49: focused inspection of specified chemical equipment at first use, modification or repair.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對局部排氣裝置、空氣清淨裝置及吹吸型換氣裝置，應每多久定期檢查一次？
a_zh: 每月
b_zh: 每二年
c_zh: 每週
d_zh: 每年
q_en: Local exhaust ventilation, air cleaning devices and push-pull ventilation must be inspected every:
a_en: Month
b_en: 2 years
c_en: Week
d_en: Year
explain_zh: 第40條：局部排氣裝置、空氣清淨裝置及吹吸型換氣裝置每年檢查氣罩導管排氣機之磨損腐蝕、塵埃聚積、注油潤滑、導管接觸部分、皮帶鬆弛、吸排氣能力、採樣設施等。第41條：局部排氣裝置內之空氣清淨裝置每年。第47條：開始使用拆卸改裝修理時重點檢查。
explain_en: Article 40: annually; Article 41: air cleaners in LEV annually; Article 47: focused inspection at first use, dismantling, modification or repair.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對異常氣壓之再壓室或減壓艙，應每多久定期檢查輸排氣設備、通話設備警報裝置、漏電、電器配線一次？
a_zh: 每二年
b_zh: 每半年
c_zh: 每個月
d_zh: 每三個月
q_en: Recompression chambers and decompression chambers must be inspected for supply/exhaust, communication/alarm, leakage current and wiring every:
a_en: 2 years
b_en: 6 months
c_en: Month
d_en: 3 months
explain_zh: 第42條：再壓室或減壓艙每個月檢查輸氣設備及排氣設備運作、通話設備及警報裝置運作、電路有無漏電、電器機械器具及配線有無損傷。

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對施工架及施工構臺，應每多久定期實施檢查一次？除定期外，何時亦應檢查？
a_zh: 每月；僅颱風警報解除後及每次停工超過一個月之復工前
b_zh: 每季；強風大雨等惡劣氣候後，並由勞動檢查機構每年檢查一次
c_zh: 每週；強風大雨等惡劣氣候、四級以上地震後及每次停工之復工前
d_zh: 每日；豪雨特報發布後及五級以上地震後，停工復工前免再檢查
q_en: Scaffolds and work platforms must be inspected how often, and additionally when?
a_en: Monthly; only after a typhoon warning is lifted, and before resuming work after a suspension of more than one month
b_en: Quarterly; after severe weather such as strong wind or heavy rain, with an additional annual check by the labor inspection agency
c_en: Weekly; after severe weather such as strong wind or heavy rain, after earthquakes of intensity 4 or above, and before resuming after any suspension
d_en: Daily; after a heavy rain advisory is issued and after earthquakes of intensity 5 or above, with no further check before resuming work again
explain_zh: 第43條：施工架及施工構臺每週檢查架材損傷安裝、固定部分鬆弛、固定材料腐蝕、扶手護欄拆卸脫落、基腳下沈滑動、補強材、壁連座間距等；強風大雨等惡劣氣候、四級以上地震襲擊後及每次停工之復工前亦應檢查。
explain_en: Article 43: weekly, plus after severe weather, intensity-4+ earthquakes and before resuming work after suspension.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對營造工程之模板支撐架，除每週檢查外，於何時亦應實施檢查？
a_zh: 工程完工時、拆模作業完成後及結構體驗收合格前各檢查一次
b_zh: 惡劣氣候、四級以上地震後、每次停工之復工前及混凝土澆置作業前
c_zh: 每月一次、由工地主任於月底彙整檢查表並報請監造單位備查
d_zh: 檢查機構要求時、混凝土澆置完成後及三級以上地震發生後
q_en: Formwork shoring must be inspected weekly and also:
a_en: At project completion, after formwork stripping, and before the structure passes acceptance inspection
b_en: After severe weather, intensity-4+ earthquakes, before resuming after suspension, and before concrete placement
c_en: Once a month, with the site manager compiling the checklists and filing them with the supervising firm
d_en: When the inspection agency asks, after concrete placement is finished, and after intensity-3 earthquakes
explain_zh: 第44條：模板支撐架每週檢查架材損傷安裝、支柱固定接觸搭接鬆弛、固定材料腐蝕、基腳沉陷滑動、斜撐水平繫條補強材；強風大雨等惡劣氣候、四級以上地震後、每次停工之復工前及混凝土澆置作業前亦應檢查。
explain_en: Article 44: additionally after severe weather, intensity-4+ earthquakes, before resuming work and before concrete pouring.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主發現機械、設備有腐蝕、劣化、損傷或堪用性之虞時，應如何？
a_zh: 報請勞動檢查機構核定後停止檢查
b_zh: 實施安全評估，並縮短其檢查期限
c_zh: 實施安全評估，並延長其檢查期限
d_zh: 俟下次定期檢查時一併記錄處理
q_en: If machinery or equipment shows corrosion, deterioration, damage or doubtful serviceability, the employer shall:
a_en: Report to the labor inspection agency and suspend inspections
b_en: Perform a safety assessment and shorten the inspection interval
c_en: Perform a safety assessment and extend the inspection interval
d_en: Simply record it and deal with it at the next periodic inspection
explain_zh: 第44條之1：雇主對機械設備應依規定實施定期檢查；但發現有腐蝕、劣化、損傷或堪用性之虞，應實施安全評估，並縮短其檢查期限。
explain_en: Article 44-1: conduct a safety assessment and shorten the inspection period.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對第二種壓力容器及減壓艙，應於何時實施重點檢查？
a_zh: 報廢前
b_zh: 初次使用前
c_zh: 每年檢查時
d_zh: 每月檢查時
q_en: Class 2 pressure vessels and decompression chambers require a focused inspection:
a_en: Before scrapping
b_en: Before first use
c_en: At the annual inspection
d_en: At the monthly inspection
explain_zh: 第45條：第二種壓力容器及減壓艙於初次使用前重點檢查胴體端板厚度是否符合製造廠資料、安全閥吹洩量、尺寸附屬品與明細表符合、耐壓試驗無膨出伸長洩漏等。
explain_en: Article 45: before first use, checking shell/head thickness against manufacturer data, relief valve capacity, dimensions and accessories, and pressure test results.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對捲揚裝置，應於何時實施重點檢查？
a_zh: 開始使用、拆卸、改裝或修理時
b_zh: 每日作業前及作業終了後各一次
c_zh: 每年一次，由製造廠派員實施
d_zh: 每月一次，並於年度歲修時複查
q_en: Winches (hoisting devices) require a focused inspection:
a_en: At first use, dismantling, modification or repair
b_en: Daily before work starts and after it ends
c_en: Yearly, carried out by the original manufacturer
d_en: Monthly, with a recheck at the annual overhaul
explain_zh: 第46條：捲揚裝置於開始使用、拆卸、改裝或修理時重點檢查安裝部位強度、結合元件結合良好及強度。第51條：每日作業前檢點制動安全控制裝置及鋼索通過部分。
explain_en: Article 46: at first use, dismantling, modification or repair (mounting strength and fasteners); Article 51: daily pre-use checks.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對異常氣壓之輸氣設備，停用多久以上擬再度使用時，應實施重點檢查？
a_zh: 一週以上
b_zh: 一個月以上
c_zh: 三個月以上
d_zh: 六個月以上
q_en: Air supply equipment for hyperbaric work must undergo a focused inspection before reuse after being out of service for at least:
a_en: 1 week
b_en: 1 month
c_en: 3 months
d_en: 6 months
explain_zh: 第48條：輸氣設備初次使用或予分解後加以改造、修理或停用一個月以上擬再度使用時，應實施重點檢查；發生故障出水等異常時應迅即使勞工撤離並檢點。
explain_en: Article 48: at first use, after modification or repair, or after one month or more out of service.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對車輛機械，應於何時就制動器、連結裝置、儀器、蓄電池配線控制裝置實施檢點？
a_zh: 每年一次
b_zh: 每週作業前
c_zh: 每月一次
d_zh: 每日作業前
q_en: Vehicle machinery must be checked for brakes, couplings, instruments, batteries, wiring and controls:
a_en: Once a year
b_en: Weekly before work
c_en: Once a month
d_en: Daily before work
explain_zh: 第50條：車輛機械應每日作業前檢點制動器連結裝置各種儀器、蓄電池配線控制裝置有無異常。

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 固定式起重機於瞬間風速可能超過每秒幾公尺或幾級以上地震後，應實施各部安全狀況之檢點？
a_zh: 十五公尺；四級
b_zh: 四十公尺；五級
c_zh: 二十公尺；三級
d_zh: 三十公尺；四級
q_en: Overhead cranes must have all parts checked after instantaneous wind speeds possibly exceeding, or earthquakes of intensity:
explain_zh: 第52條：固定式起重機每日作業前檢點過捲預防裝置制動器離合器控制裝置、軌道導軌、鋼索運行；置於瞬間風速可能超過每秒三十公尺或四級以上地震後應檢點各部安全狀況。第54條人字臂起重桿亦同（室外者）。
explain_en: Article 52: after possible gusts over 30 m/s or intensity-4+ earthquakes; Article 54 applies the same to outdoor derricks.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對起重機械使用之吊掛用鋼索、吊鏈、纖維索、吊鉤、吊索、鏈環等用具，應於何時實施檢點？
a_zh: 每月一次
b_zh: 每年一次
c_zh: 每次使用後
d_zh: 每日作業前
q_en: Lifting gear used with cranes (wire ropes, chains, fiber ropes, hooks, slings, links) must be checked:
a_en: Once a month
b_en: Once a year
c_en: After each use
d_en: Daily before work
explain_zh: 第58條：對起重機械使用之吊掛用鋼索、吊鏈、纖維索、吊鉤、吊索、鏈環等用具，應於每日作業前實施檢點。

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對工業用機器人每日作業前實施檢點時，應儘可能在何處為之？
a_zh: 僅控制室外
b_zh: 機器人手臂上方
c_zh: 可動範圍外
d_zh: 可動範圍內
q_en: When checking industrial robots daily before operation, the check should be done as far as possible:
a_en: Outside the control room only
b_en: On top of the robot's arm
c_en: Outside the robot's operating range
d_en: Inside the robot's operating range
explain_zh: 第60條：工業用機器人每日作業前檢點制動裝置、緊急停止裝置、接觸防止設施及連鎖裝置、相連機器連鎖、外部電線配管、電壓油壓空氣壓、動作、異常聲音振動；檢點時應儘可能在可動範圍外為之；協同作業機器人並應確認安全功能。
explain_en: Article 60: outside the movement range; items include brakes, emergency stop, guarding interlocks, wiring, power/hydraulic/pneumatic supply, motion and abnormal noise or vibration; collaborative robots also have safety functions confirmed.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對高壓氣體製造設備及消費設備，應於何時檢點有無異常？
a_zh: 每週一次，並於每月月底就動作狀況實施總檢點
b_zh: 每月一次，由設備管理人員就外觀及洩漏情形檢點
c_zh: 每年一次，於歲修停爐期間就動作狀況實施檢點
d_zh: 使用開始前及使用終了後，並一日一次以上就動作狀況檢點
q_en: High-pressure gas production and consumption equipment must be checked:
a_en: Once a week, plus a general check of operating condition at each month end
b_en: Once a month, by the equipment keeper, covering appearance and any leakage
c_en: Once a year, checking operating condition during the annual shutdown overhaul
d_en: Before start and after end of use, plus at least once a day for operating condition
explain_zh: 第61條、第62條：高壓氣體製造設備及消費設備應於使用開始前及使用終了後檢點有無異常，且一日一次以上就動作狀況實施檢點。
explain_en: Articles 61–62: before and after use, and at least once daily for operating status.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主對營建工程施工架、支撐架、擋土支撐、隧道開挖支撐、沉箱圍堰壓氣施工設備、打樁設備等，應於何時檢點有無異常或變形？
a_zh: 每日作業前及使用終了後
b_zh: 每週一次及惡劣氣候後
c_zh: 每月一次及地震發生後
d_zh: 每季一次及停工復工前
q_en: Construction scaffolds, shoring, excavation supports, tunnel supports, caissons, cofferdams and piling equipment must be checked for abnormality or deformation:
a_en: Daily before work and after use ends
b_en: Weekly and after severe weather
c_en: Monthly and after an earthquake
d_en: Quarterly and before resuming work
explain_zh: 第63條：營建工程施工架設備、施工構臺、支撐架設備、露天開挖擋土支撐設備、隧道或坑道開挖支撐設備、沉箱圍堰及壓氣施工設備、打樁設備等，應於每日作業前及使用終了後檢點有無異常或變形。
explain_en: Article 63: daily before operation and after the end of use.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事下列何種危險性設備作業時，應使該勞工就其作業有關事項實施檢點？
a_zh: 鍋爐、第一種壓力容器、高壓氣體特定設備、高壓氣體容器之操作作業
b_zh: 電話客服接聽、客訴案件登錄、售後服務派工及滿意度調查作業
c_zh: 辦公室文書處理、電腦資料建檔、會議記錄繕打及檔案歸檔作業
d_zh: 倉儲貨品盤點、料架標示更新、進出貨單據核對及庫存報表編製
q_en: Workers must perform work checks when operating which dangerous equipment?
a_en: Boilers, Class 1 pressure vessels, high-pressure gas specific equipment and gas containers
b_en: Answering customer calls, logging complaints, dispatching after-sales service and satisfaction surveys
c_en: Office paperwork, computer data entry, minute-taking and document filing duties
d_en: Warehouse stocktaking, rack label updates, checking delivery notes and preparing stock reports
explain_zh: 第64條：鍋爐之操作、第一種壓力容器之操作、高壓氣體特定設備之操作、高壓氣體容器之操作作業。第65條：高壓氣體灌裝、儲存、運輸、廢棄作業。
explain_en: Article 64: boiler, Class 1 pressure vessel, HP gas specific equipment and gas container operation; Article 65: HP gas filling, storage, transport and disposal.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事下列何種有害物作業時，應使勞工就其作業有關事項實施檢點？
a_zh: 有機溶劑、鉛、四烷基鉛、特定化學物質、粉塵作業
b_zh: 自用小客車駕駛、貨物配送、路線規劃、車輛保養送修作業
c_zh: 餐飲備料、烹調調味、餐具清洗、外場點餐與收銀作業
d_zh: 一般文書處理、電腦打字、資料建檔、會議記錄繕打作業
q_en: Workers must perform work checks for which harmful-substance operations?
a_en: Organic solvents, lead, tetraalkyl lead, specified chemicals and dust operations
b_en: Car driving, goods delivery, route planning and vehicle maintenance operations
c_en: Food preparation, cooking, dishwashing and front-of-house cashier operations
d_en: General paperwork, typing, data entry and minute-taking office operations
explain_zh: 第69條：有機溶劑作業、鉛作業、四烷基鉛作業、特定化學物質作業、粉塵作業。第68條：缺氧危險或局限空間作業；第70條：潛水高壓室內沈箱等異常氣壓作業；第72條：危害性化學品製造處置使用作業。
explain_en: Article 69: the five listed; Article 68: oxygen-deficiency and confined spaces; Article 70: abnormal pressure work; Article 72: hazardous chemical operations.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主實施各項作業檢點，其檢點對象、內容應如何訂定？
a_zh: 依實際需要訂定，以檢點手冊或檢點表等為之
b_zh: 依中央主管機關公告之範例，逐項照抄後實施
c_zh: 沿用同業他廠之檢點表，不需依實際需要調整
d_zh: 由勞工於作業中口頭記憶，不需製作書面紀錄
q_en: How should the subjects and contents of work checks be established?
a_en: Based on actual needs, using checklists or check manuals
b_en: Copied item by item from the central authority's published sample
c_en: Another factory's checklists reused without any local adjustment
d_en: Memorized verbally by workers during work, with no written record
explain_zh: 第78條：雇主依第50條至第56條及第58條至第77條實施之檢點，其檢點對象、內容應依實際需要訂定，以檢點手冊或檢點表等為之。
explain_en: Article 78: per actual needs, in the form of check manuals or checklists.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主依規定實施定期檢查、重點檢查及作業檢點（機械設備部分），應訂定何種計畫？
a_zh: 自動檢查計畫
b_zh: 年度營運及資本預算
c_zh: 行銷及廣告計畫
d_zh: 生產及交貨排程
q_en: For periodic inspections, focused inspections and equipment checks, the employer must draw up:
a_en: A self-inspection (automatic inspection) plan
b_en: An annual operating and capital budget
c_en: A marketing and advertising plan
d_en: A production and delivery schedule
explain_zh: 第79條：雇主依第13條至第63條規定實施之自動檢查，應訂定自動檢查計畫。
explain_en: Article 79: a self-inspection plan covering inspections under Articles 13–63.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 定期檢查及重點檢查之紀錄應記載哪些事項？保存幾年？
a_zh: 檢查日期及檢查方法、檢查者姓名；紀錄由各單位自行保存一年
b_zh: 實施檢查者姓名及所屬部門；紀錄應保存十年供查閱
c_zh: 檢查年月日、方法、部分、結果、實施檢查者姓名、改善措施內容；三年
d_zh: 檢查結果及改善措施內容；紀錄應保存五年並報備查
q_en: Periodic and focused inspection records must contain what, and be kept how long?
a_en: Date and method of inspection, inspector's name; kept by each unit for 1 year
b_en: Inspector's name and department; records kept 10 years for inspection on request
c_en: Date, method, parts inspected, results, inspector's name, corrective measures; 3 years
d_en: Results and corrective measures; records kept 5 years and filed with the authority
explain_zh: 第80條：定期檢查、重點檢查應記錄檢查年月日、檢查方法、檢查部分、檢查結果、實施檢查者之姓名、依檢查結果應採取改善措施之內容，並保存三年。第89條之2：紀錄應以紙本保存，但電子紀錄能隨時調閱者不在此限。
explain_en: Article 80: the six items, kept 3 years; Article 89-2: paper records unless electronic records can be retrieved at any time.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 勞工、主管人員及職業安全衛生管理人員實施檢查、檢點時，發現對勞工有危害之虞者，應如何？
a_zh: 應即報告上級主管；雇主發現異常應立即檢修及採取必要措施
b_zh: 先行記錄於檢點表即可；雇主應於三個月內完成改善
c_zh: 應即報告勞動檢查機構；雇主應俟檢查機構指示後檢修
d_zh: 俟下次定期檢查時再處理；雇主得於年度歲修時一併檢修
q_en: If an inspection or check reveals a possible hazard to workers, the person shall:
a_en: Report immediately to the superior; the employer must immediately repair and take measures
b_en: Simply note it on the checklist; the employer must complete improvements within three months
c_en: Report immediately to the labor inspection agency; the employer repairs only when instructed
d_en: Deal with it at the next periodic inspection; the employer may repair it at the annual overhaul
explain_zh: 第81條：實施檢查檢點發現對勞工有危害之虞者應即報告上級主管；雇主實施自動檢查發現有異常時，應立即檢修及採取必要措施。
explain_en: Article 81: report immediately; the employer must promptly repair and take necessary measures on any abnormality.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 雇主實施自動檢查，應指定何人為之？
a_zh: 不限資格由雇主隨機指定之人員
b_zh: 新進未滿三個月之現場作業人員
c_zh: 具專業知能或操作資格之適當人員
d_zh: 外部訪客或參觀之相關廠商人員
q_en: Self-inspections must be assigned to:
a_en: Any person the employer designates, with no qualification needed
b_en: New employees with less than three months of shop-floor experience
c_en: Suitable persons with professional knowledge or operating qualifications
d_en: External visitors or staff from firms touring the workplace
explain_zh: 第83條：自動檢查除依其他法令另有規定者外，應指定具專業知能或操作資格之適當人員為之。第82條：其他法令另有規定者依該規定。
explain_en: Article 83: qualified persons with professional competence or operating qualifications, unless other laws provide otherwise.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 事業單位交付承攬時，承攬人使用之機械設備係由原事業單位提供者，其定期檢查及重點檢查應由何人實施？
a_zh: 勞動檢查機構（原事業單位及承攬人均免實施定期及重點檢查）
b_zh: 機械設備之製造商（原事業單位僅需保存製造商出具之檢查紀錄）
c_zh: 原事業單位（必要時得會同承攬人；承攬人有能力時得書面約定由其為之）
d_zh: 承攬人（原事業單位僅需於契約中載明，不負實施檢查之責任）
q_en: When machinery provided by the principal enterprise is used by a contractor, who performs the periodic and focused inspections?
a_en: The labor inspection agency (both the principal enterprise and the contractor are exempt from periodic and focused inspections)
b_en: The equipment manufacturer (the principal enterprise need only keep the inspection records issued by the manufacturer)
c_en: The principal enterprise (jointly with the contractor if needed, or by written agreement delegated to a capable contractor)
d_en: The contractor alone (the principal enterprise need only state this in the contract and bears no inspection duty)
explain_zh: 第84條：承攬人使用之機械設備器具由原事業單位提供者，應由原事業單位實施定期檢查及重點檢查；必要時得由承攬人會同實施；承攬人具有能力時得以書面約定由承攬人為之。第85條：承租承借機械設備者應實施自動檢查，定期重點檢查得書面約定由出租出借人為之。
explain_en: Article 84: the principal enterprise, jointly if necessary, or by written agreement the contractor; Article 85: rented or borrowed equipment must be self-inspected, with periodic/focused inspection assignable in writing to the lessor.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 勞工人數在三十人以上之事業單位，設管理單位或置管理人員時應如何？
a_zh: 免依規定登錄，僅需於事業單位內部造冊備查；變更時亦不需辦理
b_zh: 依中央主管機關公告之方式登錄，並公告於事業單位公布欄即可
c_zh: 報請當地警察機關及消防機關備查，並副知勞動檢查機構即可
d_zh: 依中央主管機關公告之內容及方式登錄，報請勞動檢查機構備查；變更時亦同
q_en: Enterprises with 30+ workers that set up a management unit or appoint management personnel must:
a_en: No registration required; an internal roster kept at the enterprise suffices, and changes need not be reported
b_en: Register in the central authority's format and simply post it on the enterprise's notice board
c_en: Report to the local police and fire authorities, copying the labor inspection agency for information
d_en: Register per the central authority's format and report to the labor inspection agency, also on any change
explain_zh: 第86條：勞工人數三十人以上之事業單位設管理單位或置管理人員時，應依中央主管機關公告之內容及方式登錄，報請勞動檢查機構備查；變更時亦同。第87條：設委員會時應製作委員會名冊登錄報備。
explain_en: Article 86: register and report for record to the labor inspection agency, including changes; Article 87: the committee roster must also be registered.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 職業安全衛生管理辦法民國115年6月29日修正發布之條文，自何時施行？
q_en: The amendments to the Regulations promulgated on 29 June 2026 (ROC 115) take effect on:
a_en: 1 July 2026
b_en: 29 June 2026
c_en: 31 December 2026
d_en: 1 January 2027
explain_zh: 第90條末項：本辦法中華民國一百十五年六月二十九日修正發布之條文，自一百十五年七月一日施行。

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則係依職業安全衛生法第幾條規定訂定？
a_zh: 第二十三條第五項
b_zh: 第三十二條第三項
c_zh: 第二十條第三項
d_zh: 第六條第三項
q_en: The OSH Education and Training Rules are enacted under which OSH Act article?
a_en: Article 23, paragraph 5
b_en: Article 32, paragraph 3
c_en: Article 20, paragraph 3
d_en: Article 6, paragraph 3
explain_zh: 第1條：本規則依職業安全衛生法第三十二條第三項規定訂定之。
explain_en: Article 1: under Article 32(3) of the OSH Act.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 具下列何種資格者，得免接受職業安全衛生業務主管之安全衛生教育訓練？
a_zh: 領有堆高機操作人員技能檢定合格證照並實際操作滿五年者
b_zh: 具有職業安全衛生委員會委員身分並曾擔任急救人員者
c_zh: 具有職業安全管理師、職業衛生管理師或職業安全衛生管理員資格者
d_zh: 具有急救人員訓練結業證書及三年以上現場工作經驗者
q_en: Who is exempt from OSH business supervisor training?
a_en: Persons holding a forklift operator skills certificate with five years of operating experience
b_en: Persons serving as OSH committee members who have previously worked as first-aiders
c_en: Persons qualified as occupational safety/hygiene management specialists or OSH administrators
d_en: Persons holding a first-aid training certificate and three years of on-site work experience
explain_zh: 第3條：擔任業務主管應事前受訓，雇主或代理人擔任者亦同；具管理師、管理員資格者，經管理師管理員訓練合格領有結業證書者，或受訓期滿經測驗合格領有業務主管結業證書者，得免受訓。
explain_en: Article 3: those qualified as specialists or administrators, or holding the corresponding training certificates, are exempt.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 雇主對擔任職業安全管理師、職業衛生管理師及職業安全衛生管理員之勞工，應於何時使其接受安全衛生教育訓練？
a_zh: 不需訓練
b_zh: 到職後一年內
c_zh: 到職後三個月內
d_zh: 事前
q_en: Workers assigned as OSH management specialists or administrators must receive training:
a_en: Not required
b_en: Within a year of appointment
c_en: Within three months
d_en: Beforehand
explain_zh: 第5條：雇主對擔任職業安全管理師、職業衛生管理師、職業安全衛生管理員之勞工，應於事前使其接受職業安全衛生管理人員之安全衛生教育訓練；課程時數依附表三。
explain_en: Article 5: before taking up the post, per Annex 3 curricula.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 作業環境監測人員之安全衛生教育訓練分為哪些類別？
a_zh: 依營造業、製造業及服務業區分之作業環境監測人員
b_zh: 甲級、乙級、丙級之化學性因子作業環境監測人員
c_zh: 甲級、乙級之生物性因子及游離輻射作業環境監測人員
d_zh: 甲級、乙級之化學性因子及物理性因子作業環境監測人員
q_en: Workplace environmental monitoring personnel training covers which categories?
a_en: Divided by industry: construction, manufacturing and service monitoring personnel
b_en: Class A, Class B and Class C, all for chemical factors only
c_en: Class A and Class B, each for biological factors and ionizing radiation
d_en: Class A and Class B, each for chemical factors and physical factors
explain_zh: 第6條：甲級化學性因子、甲級物理性因子、乙級化學性因子、乙級物理性因子作業環境監測人員，應事前受訓；課程時數依附表四。
explain_en: Article 6: Class A/B chemical-factor and Class A/B physical-factor monitoring personnel, trained beforehand per Annex 4.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 下列何者屬高壓氣體作業主管之安全衛生教育訓練對象？
a_zh: 施工架組配作業主管、鋼構組配作業主管及模板支撐作業主管
b_zh: 高壓氣體製造安全主任、製造安全作業主管、供應及消費作業主管
c_zh: 屋頂作業主管、露天開挖作業主管及擋土支撐作業主管
d_zh: 缺氧作業主管、局限空間作業主管及通風換氣設備操作主管
q_en: Which are covered by high-pressure gas work supervisor training?
a_en: Scaffold assembly supervisors, steel erection supervisors and formwork support work supervisors
b_en: HP gas production safety chiefs, production safety work supervisors, supply and consumption work supervisors
c_en: Roof work supervisors, open excavation supervisors and earth-retaining support work supervisors
d_en: Oxygen-deficiency work supervisors, confined space work supervisors and ventilation equipment supervisors
explain_zh: 第9條：高壓氣體製造安全主任、高壓氣體製造安全作業主管、高壓氣體供應及消費作業主管，應事前受訓，課程時數依附表七。
explain_en: Article 9: the three HP gas supervisor types, trained beforehand per Annex 7.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 下列何者屬營造作業主管之安全衛生教育訓練對象？
a_zh: 擋土支撐、露天開挖、模板支撐、隧道挖掘、隧道襯砌、施工架組配、鋼構組配、屋頂作業主管
b_zh: 高壓氣體製造安全主任、高壓氣體供應及消費作業主管、缺氧作業主管、急救人員
c_zh: 有機溶劑、鉛、四烷基鉛、缺氧、特定化學物質、粉塵、高壓室內、潛水作業主管
d_zh: 鍋爐操作、第一種壓力容器操作、高壓氣體特定設備操作、高壓氣體容器操作人員
q_en: Which are construction work supervisors requiring training under Article 10?
a_en: Earth-retaining support, open excavation, formwork support, tunnel excavation, tunnel lining, scaffold assembly, steel erection and roof work supervisors
b_en: HP gas production safety chiefs, HP gas production safety work supervisors, HP gas supply and consumption work supervisors and first-aid personnel
c_en: Organic solvent, lead, tetraalkyl lead, oxygen-deficiency, specified chemical, dust, hyperbaric chamber and diving work supervisors
d_en: Boiler operators, Class 1 pressure vessel operators, HP gas specific equipment operators and HP gas container operators
explain_zh: 第10條：擋土支撐、露天開挖、模板支撐、隧道等挖掘、隧道等襯砌、施工架組配、鋼構組配、屋頂作業主管及其他指定人員，應事前受訓，課程時數依附表八。
explain_en: Article 10: the eight construction supervisor types plus others designated, per Annex 8.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
category: 教育訓練-有害作業主管
q_zh: 下列何者屬有害作業主管之安全衛生教育訓練對象？
a_zh: 鍋爐操作、堆高機操作、高空工作車操作、乙炔熔接裝置作業、油輪清艙作業人員
b_zh: 有機溶劑、鉛、四烷基鉛、缺氧、特定化學物質、粉塵、高壓室內、潛水作業主管
c_zh: 擋土支撐、露天開挖、模板支撐、隧道襯砌、施工架組配、鋼構組配、屋頂作業主管
d_zh: 高壓氣體製造安全主任、高壓氣體製造安全作業主管、高壓氣體供應及消費作業主管
q_en: Which are harmful-operation supervisors requiring training under Article 11?
a_en: Boiler operators, forklift operators, aerial work platform operators, acetylene welding workers and tanker cleaning workers
b_en: Organic solvent, lead, tetraalkyl lead, oxygen-deficiency, specified chemical, dust, hyperbaric chamber and diving work supervisors
c_en: Earth-retaining support, open excavation, formwork support, tunnel lining, scaffold assembly, steel erection and roof work supervisors
d_en: HP gas production safety chiefs, HP gas production safety work supervisors and HP gas supply and consumption work supervisors
explain_zh: 第11條：有機溶劑、鉛、四烷基鉛、缺氧、特定化學物質、粉塵、高壓室內、潛水作業主管及其他指定人員，應事前受訓，課程時數依附表九。
explain_en: Article 11: the eight harmful-operation supervisor types, per Annex 9.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 吊升荷重在幾公噸以上之固定式起重機操作人員，屬具有危險性之機械操作人員教育訓練對象？
a_zh: 一公噸以上
b_zh: 三公噸以上
c_zh: 零點五公噸以上
d_zh: 五公噸以上
q_en: Operators of overhead cranes with a lifting capacity of at least how much fall under dangerous machinery operator training?
a_en: 1 tonne
b_en: 3 tonnes
c_en: 0.5 tonne
d_en: 5 tonnes
explain_zh: 第12條：吊升荷重三公噸以上之固定式起重機或一公噸以上之斯達卡式起重機、三公噸以上之移動式起重機、三公噸以上之人字臂起重桿、導軌或升降路高度二十公尺以上之營建用提升機、吊籠操作人員，須經訓練或技能檢定取得資格；自營作業者亦應受訓。
explain_en: Article 12: overhead cranes 3 t+ (stacker cranes 1 t+), mobile cranes 3 t+, derricks 3 t+, construction hoists with rail height 20 m+, gondolas; qualification by training or skills test.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 導軌或升降路之高度在幾公尺以上之營建用提升機操作人員，屬具有危險性之機械操作人員？
a_zh: 二十公尺以上
b_zh: 三十公尺以上
c_zh: 五公尺以上
d_zh: 十公尺以上
q_en: Operators of construction hoists with guide rail or hoistway height of at least how much are dangerous machinery operators?
c_en: 5 m
explain_zh: 第12條第1項第4款：導軌或升降路之高度在二十公尺以上之營建用提升機操作人員。

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 下列何者屬具有危險性之設備操作人員之安全衛生教育訓練對象？
a_zh: 鍋爐、第一種壓力容器、高壓氣體特定設備、高壓氣體容器操作人員
b_zh: 堆高機、高空工作車、起重機具吊掛及乙炔熔接裝置作業人員
c_zh: 固定式起重機、移動式起重機、人字臂起重桿及營建用提升機操作人員
d_zh: 小型鍋爐、第二種壓力容器、簡易鍋爐及一般氣體鋼瓶操作人員
q_en: Which are dangerous equipment operators under Article 13?
a_en: Boiler, Class 1 pressure vessel, HP gas specific equipment and HP gas container operators
b_en: Forklift, aerial work platform, crane rigging and acetylene welding equipment operators
c_en: Overhead crane, mobile crane, derrick and construction hoist operators
d_en: Small boiler, Class 2 pressure vessel, simple boiler and ordinary gas cylinder operators
explain_zh: 第13條：鍋爐操作人員、第一種壓力容器操作人員、高壓氣體特定設備操作人員、高壓氣體容器操作人員，須經訓練或技能檢定取得資格；自營作業者亦應受訓；課程時數依附表十一。
explain_en: Article 13: the four dangerous-equipment operator types; the others are special-operation personnel under Article 14.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 荷重在幾公噸以上之堆高機操作人員，應接受特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練？
a_zh: 零點五公噸以上
b_zh: 三公噸以上
c_zh: 一公噸以上
d_zh: 二公噸以上
q_en: Forklift operators must receive special-operation training when the forklift's load capacity is at least:
a_en: 0.5 tonne
b_en: 3 tonnes
c_en: 1 tonne
d_en: 2 tonnes
explain_zh: 第14條：小型鍋爐操作、荷重一公噸以上堆高機操作、零點五公噸以上未滿三公噸之固定式移動式起重機及人字臂起重桿操作、高空工作車操作、起重機具吊掛作業、乙炔熔接裝置作業、火藥爆破、胸高直徑七十公分以上伐木、機械集材運材、高壓室內作業、潛水作業、油輪清艙作業人員等。
explain_en: Article 14: forklifts of 1 t+, plus small boilers, cranes 0.5–under 3 t, aerial work platforms, rigging, acetylene welding, blasting, felling trees over 70 cm, cable logging, hyperbaric, diving and tanker cleaning.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 吊升荷重在零點五公噸以上未滿三公噸之移動式起重機操作人員，屬何種教育訓練對象？
a_zh: 特殊作業人員
b_zh: 具有危險性之設備操作人員
c_zh: 營造作業主管
d_zh: 具有危險性之機械操作人員
q_en: Operators of mobile cranes with capacity 0.5 t to under 3 t fall under which training category?
a_en: Special-operation personnel
b_en: Dangerous equipment operators
c_en: Construction work supervisors
d_en: Dangerous machinery operators
explain_zh: 第14條第1項第4款：吊升荷重零點五公噸以上未滿三公噸之移動式起重機操作人員屬特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練對象；三公噸以上者則屬第12條危險性機械操作人員。
explain_en: Article 14(1)(4): special-operation training; 3 t and above falls under Article 12.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 胸高直徑幾公分以上之伐木作業人員，應接受特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練？
a_zh: 七十公分
b_zh: 三十公分
c_zh: 一百公分
d_zh: 五十公分
q_en: Tree-felling workers need special-operation training when the trees' diameter at breast height is at least:
a_en: 70 cm
b_en: 30 cm
c_en: 100 cm
d_en: 50 cm
explain_zh: 第14條第1項第10款：胸高直徑七十公分以上之伐木作業人員。第9款火藥爆破人員依爆破專業人員訓練辦法結業者得採認。
explain_en: Article 14(1)(10): 70 cm or more; blasting personnel trained under the explosives regulations may be recognized.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 雇主對工作場所急救人員應使其接受急救人員之安全衛生教育訓練，但下列何者不在此限？
a_zh: 工作場所負責人及緊急醫療救護法所定之救護車駕駛
b_zh: 曾接受紅十字會急救講習之各級主管及工會幹部
c_zh: 職業安全衛生管理人員及消防法所定之消防安全設備師
d_zh: 醫護人員及緊急醫療救護法所定之救護技術員
q_en: Workplace first-aiders must receive first-aid training, except:
a_en: Workplace managers and ambulance drivers under the Emergency Medical Services Act
b_en: Line supervisors and union officers who have attended Red Cross first-aid courses
c_en: OSH management personnel and fire safety equipment engineers under the Fire Services Act
d_en: Medical/nursing personnel and EMTs under the Emergency Medical Services Act
explain_zh: 第16條：雇主對工作場所急救人員應使其接受急救人員之安全衛生教育訓練，但醫護人員及緊急醫療救護法所定之救護技術員不在此限；課程時數依附表十三。
explain_en: Article 16: medical personnel and certified emergency medical technicians are exempt.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 雇主對新僱勞工或在職勞工於變更工作前，應使其接受何種訓練？在何種情形下得免？
a_zh: 職業安全衛生業務主管訓練；工作環境與變更前相當者仍不得免
b_zh: 適於各該工作必要之一般安全衛生教育訓練；工作環境、性質與變更前相當者免
c_zh: 適於各該工作必要之特殊作業安全衛生訓練；年資滿三年以上之在職勞工免
d_zh: 急救人員安全衛生教育訓練；已投保勞工保險之新僱勞工得免
q_en: New hires and workers changing jobs must receive what training, and when is it waived?
a_en: OSH business supervisor training; no waiver even when the work environment is equivalent to before
b_en: General OSH training suited to the work; waived when the environment and nature of work are equivalent to before
c_en: Special-operation OSH training suited to the work; waived for in-service workers with over three years of seniority
d_en: First-aid OSH training; waived for newly hired workers already covered by labor insurance
explain_zh: 第17條：新僱勞工或在職勞工變更工作前應接受適於各該工作必要之一般安全衛生教育訓練，但工作環境性質與變更前相當者不在此限；無一定雇主之勞工及受指揮監督從事勞動之人員亦應接受；網路教學課程至多採認二小時；經營造作業安全訓練合格者進入營繕工程場所得免。
explain_en: Article 17: general OSH training before starting or changing work, waived for equivalent work; also applies to workers without a fixed employer; approved online courses count for at most 2 hours.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 中央主管機關認可之職業安全衛生教育訓練網路教學課程，其時數至多得採認為一般安全衛生教育訓練幾小時？
a_zh: 二小時
b_zh: 三小時
c_zh: 六小時
d_zh: 一小時
q_en: Approved online OSH courses may count toward general OSH training for at most:
a_en: 2 hours
b_en: 3 hours
c_en: 6 hours
d_en: 1 hour
explain_zh: 第17條第4項：中央主管機關指定之網路教學課程取得認證時數後得採認為一般安全衛生教育訓練時數，但認可之網路教學課程至多採認二小時。

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 下列何者屬應接受安全衛生在職教育訓練之人員？
a_zh: 僅限已離職勞工及委外承攬廠商之財務會計人員
b_zh: 工作場所負責人及各級主管、職業安全衛生委員會成員
c_zh: 僅限進入工作場所參觀之訪客及其隨行接待人員
d_zh: 僅限新進未滿三個月且尚未取得結業證書之勞工
q_en: Who must receive in-service OSH training?
a_en: Only departing workers and the accounting staff of contractors
b_en: Workplace managers and line supervisors, and OSH committee members
c_en: Only visitors touring the workplace and their accompanying hosts
d_en: Only new hires of under three months without a certificate
explain_zh: 第18條：業務主管、管理人員、健康服務護理及相關人員、環測人員、施工及製程安全評估人員、各類作業主管、危險機械設備操作人員、特殊作業人員、急救人員、工作場所負責人及各級主管、委員會成員、營造車輛系營建機械吊掛缺氧局限空間氧乙炔危害性化學品作業人員、一般勞工等，均應依工作性質接受在職教育訓練。
explain_en: Article 18: a broad list including supervisors, management personnel, health service staff, monitoring and assessment personnel, work supervisors, operators, special-operation and first-aid personnel, workplace managers, committee members, specified operation workers and general workers.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 職業安全衛生業務主管之在職教育訓練時數為何？職業安全衛生管理人員為何？
a_zh: 每三年至少六小時；每三年至少十二小時
b_zh: 每二年至少六小時；每二年至少十二小時
c_zh: 每年至少三小時；每年至少六小時
d_zh: 每二年至少十二小時；每二年至少二十四小時
q_en: In-service training hours for OSH business supervisors and for OSH management personnel are:
a_en: At least 6 hours every 3 years; at least 12 hours every 3 years
b_en: At least 6 hours every 2 years; at least 12 hours every 2 years
c_en: At least 3 hours every year; at least 6 hours every year
d_en: At least 12 hours every 2 years; at least 24 hours every 2 years
explain_zh: 第19條：業務主管每二年至少六小時；管理人員每二年至少十二小時；健康服務護理及相關人員每三年至少十二小時；環測人員、安全評估人員、各類作業主管每三年至少六小時；危險機械設備操作、特殊作業、急救、工作場所負責人及主管、委員會成員、特定作業人員及一般勞工每三年至少三小時。
explain_en: Article 19: supervisors 6 h/2 yr; management personnel 12 h/2 yr; health service staff 12 h/3 yr; monitoring/assessment personnel and work supervisors 6 h/3 yr; operators, special-operation, first-aid, managers, committee members and general workers 3 h/3 yr.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 一般勞工及工作場所負責人、各級主管之安全衛生在職教育訓練時數為何？
a_zh: 每二年至少六小時
b_zh: 每三年至少六小時
c_zh: 每三年至少三小時
d_zh: 每年至少三小時
q_en: In-service training hours for general workers, workplace managers and line supervisors are:
a_en: At least 6 hours every 2 years
b_en: At least 6 hours every 3 years
c_en: At least 3 hours every 3 years
d_en: At least 3 hours yearly
explain_zh: 第19條第1項第5款：第七款至第十三款之勞工（危險機械設備操作人員、特殊作業人員、急救人員、工作場所負責人及各級主管、委員會成員、特定作業人員、一般勞工）每三年至少三小時。
explain_en: Article 19(1)(5): at least 3 hours every 3 years.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 勞工作業環境監測人員及各類作業主管之在職教育訓練時數為何？
a_zh: 每二年至少六小時
b_zh: 每三年至少三小時
c_zh: 每年至少六小時
d_zh: 每三年至少六小時
q_en: In-service training hours for environmental monitoring personnel and work supervisors are:
a_en: At least 6 hours every 2 years
b_en: At least 3 hours every 3 years
c_en: At least 6 hours yearly
d_en: At least 6 hours every 3 years
explain_zh: 第19條第1項第4款：第四款至第六款之勞工（環測人員、施工及製程安全評估人員、高壓氣體營造有害作業主管）每三年至少六小時。
explain_en: Article 19(1)(4): at least 6 hours every 3 years.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 事業單位作為安全衛生教育訓練之訓練單位，其辦理範圍為何？
a_zh: 得代替地方主管機關辦理訓練單位之認可及評鑑作業
b_zh: 以辦理其所屬勞工之技術士技能檢定及發證業務為限
c_zh: 得對外公開招訓並辦理各職類之安全衛生教育訓練
d_zh: 以辦理其勞工或相關承攬事業間之安全衛生教育訓練為限
q_en: An enterprise acting as a training unit may only conduct:
a_en: Approving and evaluating training units for the local authority
b_en: Skills certification and certificate issuance for its own workers
c_en: Public enrollment training in all OSH course categories
d_en: Training for its own workers or related contractor enterprises
explain_zh: 第20條：訓練單位包括勞工衛生主管機關、勞檢機構、目的事業主管機關、非營利法人、雇主團體、勞工團體、評鑑合格醫院或設有醫護科系之大專、急救訓練單位、設安全衛生相關科系之大專、事業單位等；事業單位以辦理其勞工或相關承攬事業間之訓練為限；非營利法人雇主勞工團體對外招訓應經中央主管機關認可。
explain_en: Article 20: enterprises may only train their own and related contractors' workers; non-profit legal persons, employer and labor groups need central approval for public enrollment.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 職業安全衛生教育訓練單位評鑑結果分為哪幾等？
a_zh: 特優、良等及普通
b_zh: 第一級、第二級及第三級
c_zh: 優等、甲等、乙等及丙等
d_zh: 甲等、乙等、丙等及丁等
q_en: Training unit evaluation results are graded as:
a_en: Outstanding, good and average
b_en: Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3
c_en: Excellent, A, B and C
d_en: Grade A, B, C and D
explain_zh: 第20條之3：認可訓練單位符合人才發展品質管理系統評核、近三年辦理達十班次、近五年未受撤銷廢止停訓者，得申請評鑑；結果分優等、甲等、乙等及丙等並公開。第21條：辦理管理人員、三公噸以上起重機、鍋爐第一種壓力容器、堆高機等訓練須甲等以上。
explain_en: Article 20-3: excellent (優等), A (甲等), B (乙等), C (丙等), published; Article 21 requires grade A or above for certain courses such as management personnel, cranes 3 t+, boilers and forklifts.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 訓練單位辦理第3條至第16條之教育訓練，應於幾日前報請地方主管機關備查？每日上課時數不得逾幾小時？
a_zh: 七日前；六小時
b_zh: 十五日前；八小時
c_zh: 三日前；四小時
d_zh: 三十日前；十小時
q_en: Training units must file training plans with the local authority how many days in advance, and daily class hours may not exceed:
a_en: 7 days; 6 hours
b_en: 15 days; 8 hours
c_en: 3 days; 4 hours
d_en: 30 days; 10 hours
explain_zh: 第25條：應於十五日前檢附教育訓練計畫報備書、課程表、講師概況、學員名冊、專責輔導員名單報請地方主管機關備查；學科術科每日上課不得逾八小時，術科實習應於日間，夜間上課以三小時為原則不得超過午後十時。
explain_en: Article 25: 15 days before, with plan, timetable, instructor profile, roster and counselor list; max 8 hours per day, practical sessions in daytime, evening classes about 3 hours and not past 10 p.m.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 訓練單位對於結訓測驗合格者，應於結訓後幾日內發給結業證書？測驗文字應為何？
a_zh: 六十日內；雙語
b_zh: 七日內；英文
c_zh: 三十日內；任意
d_zh: 十五日內；中文
q_en: Certificates of completion must be issued within how many days after passing the final test, and the test must be in which language?
