a_en: 60 days; bilingual
b_en: 7 days; English
c_en: 30 days; any
d_en: 15 days; Chinese
explain_zh: 第28條：應實施結訓測驗，合格者於結訓後十五日內發給結業證書；測驗文字及語文應為中文；公告職類之測驗應於認可之測驗試場辦理。第27條：技能檢定職類者於結訓後十五日內發給訓練期滿證明。
explain_en: Article 28: within 15 days; tests in Chinese; Article 27: certificates of course completion for skills-test categories also within 15 days.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 訓練單位對於第3條至第16條教育訓練之學員簽到、點名、成績冊、證書核發清冊等文件，應於訓練結束後幾日內做成電子檔？至少保存幾年？
a_zh: 七日內；一年
b_zh: 十日內；十年
c_zh: 十五日內；五年
d_zh: 三十日內；三年
q_en: Training records (sign-in, roll call, grades, certificate registers) must be digitized within how many days after training, and kept at least:
a_en: 7 days; 1 year
b_en: 10 days; 10 years
c_en: 15 days; 5 years
d_en: 30 days; 3 years
explain_zh: 第29條：應於教育訓練結束後十日內做成電子檔，至少保存十年。第31條：第17、18條之訓練資料保存三年。
explain_en: Article 29: within 10 days, kept at least 10 years; Article 31: general and in-service training records kept 3 years.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 訓練單位辦理一般安全衛生教育訓練及在職教育訓練之訓練教材、課程表、名冊、簽到紀錄等實施資料，應保存幾年？
a_zh: 十年
b_zh: 五年
c_zh: 三年
d_zh: 一年
q_en: Records of general and in-service OSH training (materials, timetables, rosters, sign-ins) must be kept for:
a_en: 10 years
b_en: 5 years
c_en: 3 years
d_en: 1 year
explain_zh: 第31條：辦理第17條及第18條之教育訓練，應將訓練教材、課程表相關訓練計畫、受訓人員名冊、簽到紀錄、課程內容等資料保存三年；並應於結業證書背面記錄或發給在職教育訓練紀錄。
explain_en: Article 31: three years; in-service training is recorded on the back of the certificate or on a training record form.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 受訓學員缺課時數達課程總時數多少以上者，訓練單位應通知其退訓？
a_zh: 十分之一
b_zh: 二分之一
c_zh: 三分之一
d_zh: 五分之一
q_en: A trainee absent for at least what fraction of total course hours must be withdrawn?
a_en: One tenth
b_en: One half
c_en: One third
d_en: One fifth
explain_zh: 第33條：訓練單位應指派專責輔導員（具管理員資格；急救訓練得由醫護人員或救護技術員擔任）、查核參訓資格簽到上課情形等；學員缺課達總時數五分之一以上應通知退訓，請假超過三小時或曠課者應補足全部課程；專責輔導員每二年至少接受六小時講習。
explain_en: Article 33: one fifth; leave over 3 hours or absence requires making up the full course; counselors must hold administrator qualification and attend 6 hours of briefing every 2 years.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 教育訓練教材之編撰原則，下列何者正確？
a_zh: 使用英文，輔以純文字敘述；使用英制單位；直式由右至左；免載明編輯委員
b_zh: 免使用中文敘述，得全篇引用外文；使用公噸為單位；橫式由右至左；載明審查委員
c_zh: 使用中文，得任意引用外文不加註；使用英制單位；直式由右至左；免設審查會
d_zh: 使用中文，輔以圖說實例或災害案例；使用公制單位；橫式由左至右；載明編輯委員
q_en: Which is a correct principle for compiling training materials?
a_en: English text with plain narrative only; imperial units; vertical right-to-left layout; editors need not be named
b_en: No Chinese narrative required, foreign text throughout; tonnage units; horizontal right-to-left layout; reviewers named
c_en: Chinese text quoting foreign sources freely without notes; imperial units; vertical right-to-left layout; no review committee
d_en: Chinese text with illustrations, examples or accident cases; metric units; horizontal left-to-right layout; editors named
explain_zh: 第37條：符合勞動法令及著作權法；使用中文敘述輔以圖說實例或職災案例，引用外文者加註中文；使用公制單位；編排橫式由左至右；載明編輯委員。第36條：教材應設編輯及審查會並報中央主管機關備查。
explain_en: Article 37: comply with labor and copyright law, Chinese with illustrations and case studies, metric units, horizontal left-to-right, editorial committee listed.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 訓練單位有下列何種情事，主管機關依職安法第48條處以罰鍰並令限期改正？
a_zh: 招訓廣告或簡章內容有虛偽不實
b_zh: 訓練單位每年辦理班次未達十班次
c_zh: 學員結訓測驗成績未達七十分以上
d_zh: 講師因故遲到致當日課程延後開始
q_en: Which situation leads to a fine and order to correct under OSH Act Article 48?
a_en: False or misleading enrollment advertisements or brochures
b_en: A training unit running fewer than ten classes in a year
c_en: Trainees scoring below 70 in the final completion test
d_en: An instructor arriving late so the day's class starts later
explain_zh: 第39條：訓練場所設備不良、招訓廣告虛偽不實、未於核備場所實施、訓練計畫未報備、資料不實、未辦結訓測驗、未依規定發證、未登錄指定文件、拒絕查核、未經認可對外招訓、未具甲等辦理指定訓練等，處以罰鍰並令限期改正。第38條為警告事由；第40條屆期未改或情節重大者撤銷廢止認可或停訓。
explain_en: Article 39: poor facilities, false advertising, training outside approved venues, unfiled plans, false records, no final test, improper certificates, no registration, refusing audits, unapproved public enrollment, etc.; Article 40: revocation or suspension for serious or uncorrected cases.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 事業單位以數位方式經營商品交易或運送，交付無僱傭關係之個人親自履行外送作業時，對新加入者應使其接受安全衛生教育訓練至少幾小時？
a_zh: 一小時
b_zh: 八小時
c_zh: 三小時
d_zh: 六小時
q_en: Digital platforms using self-employed delivery workers must give newcomers OSH training of at least:
a_en: 1 hour
b_en: 8 hours
c_en: 3 hours
d_en: 6 hours
explain_zh: 第42條之4：對新加入者應使其接受至少一小時之安全衛生教育訓練，課程為危害辨識及預防、安全衛生防護裝備使用、緊急事故應變處理；每年並應依相同時數及課程辦理在職訓練；講師應具職業安全衛生管理人員資格或三年以上相關工作經驗。
explain_en: Article 42-4: at least one hour on hazard identification, protective equipment and emergency response, repeated yearly as in-service training; instructors need OSH management qualification or 3 years' experience.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 職業安全衛生管理人員及三公噸以上起重機操作人員之教育訓練課程及時數，於幾年內已受相同種類之課程時數且有證明者，得抵充之？
a_zh: 二年內
b_zh: 五年內
c_zh: 一年內
d_zh: 三年內
q_en: Training for OSH management personnel and crane operators (3 t+) taken within how many years may be credited toward the same course?
a_en: 2 years
b_en: 5 years
c_en: 1 year
d_en: 3 years
explain_zh: 第42條：第5條、第12條第1項第1款及第2款規定之課程及時數，於二年內已受相同種類之教育訓練課程及時數相同且有證明者，得抵充之。
explain_en: Article 42: identical courses completed within two years, with proof, may be credited.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 勞工健康保護規則所稱「臨時性作業」，指正常作業以外之作業，其作業期間不超過多久且一年內不再重複者？
a_zh: 一年
b_zh: 三個月
c_zh: 一個月
d_zh: 六個月
q_en: 'Temporary work' under the Labor Health Protection Rules is non-routine work lasting no more than how long and not repeated within a year?
a_en: 1 year
b_en: 3 months
c_en: 1 month
d_en: 6 months
explain_zh: 第2條第3款：臨時性作業指正常作業以外之作業，其作業期間不超過三個月，且一年內不再重複者。
explain_en: Article 2(3): not exceeding three months and not repeated within one year.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 「長期夜間工作」指勞工前一年度於午後十時至翌晨六時期間工作三小時以上之工作日數達當月工作日數二分之一且累計達幾個月以上，或該時段工作時數累計達幾小時以上？
a_zh: 一個月；一百小時
b_zh: 三個月；五百小時
c_zh: 六個月；七百小時
d_zh: 十二個月；一千小時
q_en: 'Long-term night work' means, in the previous year, night work (10 p.m.–6 a.m.) of 3+ hours on half the working days of a month for at least how many months, or night hours totaling at least:
a_en: 1 month; 100 hours
b_en: 3 months; 500 hours
c_en: 6 months; 700 hours
d_en: 12 months; 1,000 hours
explain_zh: 第2條第4款：長期夜間工作指前一年度於午後十時至翌晨六時工作三小時以上之工作日數達當月工作日數二分之一且累計達六個月以上，或該期間工作時數累計達七百小時以上。第18條：應於當年度實施長期夜間工作健康檢查。
explain_en: Article 2(4): six months cumulative, or 700 hours cumulative; Article 18 requires a night-work health check that year.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 勞工健康服務人員包括下列何者？
a_zh: 職業安全管理師、職業衛生管理師、環境監測人員或急救人員
b_zh: 醫師、護理人員、心理師、物理治療師、職能治療師或公共衛生師
c_zh: 醫師、藥師、營養師、獸醫師、驗光師或呼吸治療師
d_zh: 護理人員、社會工作師、語言治療師、聽力師或助產師
q_en: Labor health service personnel include:
a_en: Occupational safety specialists, occupational hygiene specialists, monitoring personnel or first-aiders
b_en: Physicians, nurses, psychologists, physical therapists, occupational therapists or public health specialists
c_en: Physicians, pharmacists, dietitians, veterinarians, optometrists or respiratory therapists
d_en: Registered nurses, social workers, speech therapists, audiologists or midwives
explain_zh: 第2條第5款：勞工健康服務人員指從事勞工健康服務之醫師、護理人員、心理師、物理治療師、職能治療師或公共衛生師。

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 事業單位勞工人數在幾人以上，或從事特別危害健康作業之勞工人數在幾人以上者，應僱用或特約醫師及僱用護理人員辦理勞工健康服務？
a_zh: 三百人；五十人
b_zh: 一百人；三十人
c_zh: 五十人；十人
d_zh: 五百人；一百人
q_en: Enterprises with at least how many workers, or how many workers in specially hazardous work, must employ or contract physicians and employ nurses for health services?
explain_zh: 第3條：勞工人數三百人以上或從事特別危害健康作業勞工五十人以上者，應依附表二、三之人力配置及臨場服務頻率，僱用或特約醫師及僱用護理人員辦理勞工健康服務；經評估有需求者得僱用相關人員。
explain_en: Article 3: 300+ workers or 50+ in specially hazardous operations, per Annexes 2 and 3 for staffing and on-site frequency.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 事業單位勞工人數在五十人以上未達三百人者，應如何辦理勞工健康服務？
a_zh: 應僱用專職醫師一人及專職護理人員二人辦理
b_zh: 僅需置急救人員一人並免辦理臨場健康服務
c_zh: 依附表二所定專職醫師及護理人員之人力配置辦理
d_zh: 依附表四所定特約醫護人員臨場服務頻率辦理
q_en: Enterprises with 50 to under 300 workers must provide health services by:
a_en: Employing one full-time physician and two full-time nurses
b_en: Only one first-aider, with no on-site health service required
c_en: Employed full-time physicians and nurses at the staffing levels in Annex 2
d_en: Contracted medical and nursing personnel at the on-site frequencies in Annex 4
explain_zh: 第4條：勞工人數五十人以上未達三百人者，應依附表四所定特約醫護人員臨場服務頻率辦理；經評估得特約相關人員，但護理人員之總服務頻率應達二分之一以上。
explain_en: Article 4: contracted physicians and nurses at Annex 4 frequencies; nurses must provide at least half the total service frequency.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 依規則僱用之勞工健康服務人員，得否兼任其他法令所定專責人員？
a_zh: 僅得兼任職業安全衛生管理員
b_zh: 得兼任，但不得從事與勞工健康服務無關之工作
c_zh: 經勞工健康服務醫師同意者得兼任
d_zh: 不得兼任，也不得從事與勞工健康服務無關之工作
q_en: May employed labor health service personnel concurrently hold other statutory dedicated posts?
a_en: Yes, as OSH administrator only
b_en: Yes, but no unrelated work
c_en: Yes, with the physician's consent
d_en: No, nor do unrelated work
explain_zh: 第6條：僱用之勞工健康服務人員不得兼任其他法令所定專責（任）人員或從事其他與勞工健康服務無關之工作；請假超過三十日得委託專業機構指派人員代理；僱用人員應報請備查，變更亦同。
explain_en: Article 6: no concurrent statutory posts or unrelated work; leave over 30 days may be covered by an accredited institution; appointments must be reported.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 從事勞工健康服務之護理人員，除具護理師或護士資格外，須具實務工作經驗幾年以上並經課程訓練合格？
a_zh: 二年以上
b_zh: 一年以上
c_zh: 三年以上
d_zh: 五年以上
q_en: Nurses providing labor health services need nursing qualification plus how many years of practical experience and course training?
a_en: At least 2 years
b_en: At least 1 year
c_en: At least 3 years
d_en: At least 5 years
explain_zh: 第7條：從事勞工健康服務之醫師須為職業醫學科專科醫師或其他專科醫師經附表五課程訓練合格；護理人員及勞工健康服務相關人員須具資格且實務經驗二年以上並經附表六課程訓練合格。
explain_en: Article 7: physicians must be occupational medicine specialists or other specialists with Annex 5 training; nurses and related personnel need 2+ years' experience and Annex 6 training.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 勞工健康服務人員之在職教育訓練時數為每三年合計至少幾小時？其中數位學習課程時數採計不超過幾小時？
a_zh: 十二小時；六小時
b_zh: 六小時；三小時
c_zh: 二十四小時；十二小時
d_zh: 三小時；一小時
q_en: In-service training for labor health service personnel totals at least how many hours every 3 years, with e-learning counted up to:
a_en: 12 hours; 6 hours
b_en: 6 hours; 3 hours
c_en: 24 hours; 12 hours
d_en: 3 hours; 1 hour
explain_zh: 第8條：每三年合計至少十二小時，且職業安全衛生法規與職場健康風險評估管理實務每類至少二小時；職醫每三年至少二小時法規課程；數位學習採計不超過六小時。
explain_en: Article 8: 12 hours per 3 years with at least 2 hours per course category; occupational medicine specialists need 2 hours of legal courses; e-learning up to 6 hours.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 下列何者屬勞工健康服務人員應臨場辦理之事項？
a_zh: 產品品質之抽驗及檢驗紀錄保存；生產線效率分析；不合格品之退貨處理與客訴回覆
b_zh: 公司財務報表之查核簽證；員工出勤紀錄之統計；年度考績等第之評定與獎懲建議
c_zh: 體格健康檢查結果之分析評估、健康管理及資料保存；協助選配適當工作；異常者追蹤管理及健康指導
d_zh: 作業環境監測儀器之校正及採樣分析；核發勞工體格檢查合格證書；決定勞工之薪資等級
q_en: Which is an on-site duty of labor health service personnel?
a_en: Sampling and recording product quality tests; analyzing production line efficiency; handling returns and customer complaints
b_en: Auditing and certifying company financial statements; compiling attendance statistics; grading annual appraisals and rewards
c_en: Analyzing health exam results, health management and record keeping; helping assign suitable work; follow-up and guidance for abnormal results
d_en: Calibrating environmental monitoring instruments and analyzing samples; issuing fitness certificates to workers; setting workers' wage grades
explain_zh: 第9條：檢查結果分析評估健康管理資料保存、協助選配工作、異常者追蹤管理健康指導、未滿十八歲母性健康職業傷病高風險勞工評估及個案管理、職業衛生調查分析及紀錄保存、疾病預防健康促進諮詢急救、定期向雇主報告及建議等。
explain_en: Article 9: exam result analysis and management, job placement, follow-up of abnormalities, case management of minors, maternal-health, injured and high-risk workers, health surveys, health promotion and first aid, reporting to the employer.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 勞工健康服務人員配合職業安全衛生、人力資源等部門訪視現場時，應辦理何事？
a_zh: 查核公司財務帳冊並提出年度稽核報告、評估設備投資效益及折舊攤提、辦理保險理賠申請、提供股東權益變動之分析建議
b_zh: 辨識評估影響勞工身心健康之危害因子並建議改善、建議作業環境設施改善、調查健康與作業關連性、提供復工勞工職能評估及職務再設計建議
c_zh: 監督勞工出勤及請假紀錄並核算加班費、評核生產線效率、辦理員工升遷考核、提供年度績效獎金核發建議
d_zh: 檢驗產品原料成分並簽發品質證明、規劃生產排程、辦理設備採購驗收、提供客戶抱怨處理及退貨賠償建議
q_en: During site visits with OSH and HR staff, health service personnel shall:
a_en: Audit company financial books and issue annual audit reports, assess equipment investment returns and depreciation, process insurance claims, and advise on shareholder equity changes
b_en: Identify and assess hazards affecting physical and mental health, recommend improvements, study health–work links, and advise on return-to-work evaluation and job redesign
c_en: Check attendance and leave records and compute overtime pay, rate production line efficiency, run promotion reviews, and advise on annual bonus payments
d_en: Test raw material composition and issue quality certificates, plan production schedules, handle equipment procurement, and advise on complaints and returns
explain_zh: 第11條：辨識與評估工作場所環境作業及組織內部影響勞工身心健康之危害因子並建議改善；提出作業環境安全衛生設施改善規劃建議；調查勞工健康與作業關連性並採取預防及促進措施；提供復工勞工之職能評估、職務再設計或調整之諮詢建議。
explain_en: Article 11: hazard identification and assessment with improvement recommendations, facility improvement advice, health–work correlation studies, and return-to-work functional assessment and job redesign advice.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 依第3條僱用勞工健康服務人員辦理者，應訂定何種計畫並每年評估成效及檢討？
a_zh: 勞工健康服務計畫
b_zh: 緊急應變計畫
c_zh: 職業安全衛生管理計畫
d_zh: 承攬管理計畫
q_en: Enterprises employing health service personnel under Article 3 must formulate what plan, reviewed annually?
a_en: A labor health service plan
b_en: An emergency response plan
c_en: An OSH management plan
d_en: A contractor management plan
explain_zh: 第12條：依第3條僱用人員辦理者，應依作業環境特性訂定勞工健康服務計畫據以執行，每年評估成效及檢討；依第4條特約辦理者得以執行紀錄或文件代替。
explain_en: Article 12: a labor health service plan with annual evaluation; those using contracted personnel under Article 4 may substitute records.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 第二類或第三類事業且未具特別危害健康作業之雇主，勞務場所分布不同地區或非於雇主設施內者，得訂定何者以替代第3、4條之勞工健康服務規定？
a_zh: 工作場所健康促進計畫
b_zh: 工作場所風險評估報告
c_zh: 事業單位安全衛生管理規章
d_zh: 勞工健康管理方案
q_en: Category 2/3 enterprises without specially hazardous work, whose worksites are scattered or outside the employer's facilities, may adopt what instead of Articles 3–4 services?
a_en: A workplace health promotion plan
b_en: A workplace risk assessment report
c_en: Enterprise OSH management rules
d_en: A labor health management program
explain_zh: 第13條：得訂定勞工健康管理方案，內容包括工作環境危害性質、勞工作業型態及分布、高風險群健康檢查評估、安排醫師面談及健康指導、書面或遠端通訊評估建議諮詢，每年評估檢討；應僱用護理人員或委託專業機構並依附表七實施臨場服務。
explain_en: Article 13: a labor health management program covering hazards, work patterns, high-risk group evaluation, physician interviews and remote consultation, reviewed yearly, with nurses or an accredited institution per Annex 7.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 雇主執行勞工健康服務相關事項之紀錄表及採行措施文件，應保存幾年？
a_zh: 五年
b_zh: 七年
c_zh: 三年
d_zh: 一年
q_en: Records of labor health service activities and the measures taken must be kept for:
a_en: 5 years
b_en: 7 years
c_en: 3 years
d_en: 1 year
explain_zh: 第14條：執行第9條至第13條事項應依附表八填寫紀錄表並依建議採取措施；紀錄表及採行措施之文件應保存三年。
explain_en: Article 14: three years, using the Annex 8 record form.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 事業單位急救人員每一輪班次應至少置幾人？每一輪班次勞工人數超過五十人者，每增加幾人再置一人？
a_zh: 二人；一百人
b_zh: 一人；三十人
c_zh: 一人；五十人
d_zh: 三人；五十人
q_en: At least how many first-aiders per shift, and one more for every additional how many workers above 50?
explain_zh: 第15條：每一輪班次至少置急救人員一人，勞工超過五十人者每增加五十人再置一人；第一類事業每班僅一人作業或第二三類每班未達五人且有緊急連線通報監視措施者不在此限；急救人員未能執行職務時應即指定代理人。
explain_en: Article 15: at least one per shift, plus one per additional 50 workers; exemptions for single-worker shifts in Category 1 or shifts under 5 workers in Category 2/3 with emergency communication or monitoring.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 急救人員之資格，除醫護人員及救護技術員外，尚有何者？下列何種情形不得擔任？
a_zh: 經急救人員安全衛生教育訓練合格者；失聰、兩眼裸視或矯正視力均在零點六以下、失能及健康不良者不得
b_zh: 經職業安全衛生業務主管訓練合格者；色盲、身高未達一百六十公分、年滿六十五歲及女性勞工不得
c_zh: 經雇主指定並登記有案者；未參加勞工保險、無汽車駕照及未滿二十歲之勞工不得
d_zh: 經紅十字會急救講習結業者；兩眼矯正視力在一點零以下、體重過重及有慢性病者不得
q_en: Besides medical staff and EMTs, who may be a first-aider, and who is disqualified?
a_en: Those who passed first-aid OSH training; persons who are deaf, have vision of 0.6 or worse in both eyes even corrected, are disabled or in poor health are disqualified
b_en: Those who passed OSH business supervisor training; persons who are color-blind, under 160 cm tall, aged 65 or over, or female are disqualified
c_en: Those designated and registered by the employer; persons without labor insurance, without a driving licence, or under age 20 are disqualified
d_en: Those who completed a Red Cross first-aid course; persons with corrected vision of 1.0 or worse, who are overweight, or have a chronic illness are disqualified
explain_zh: 第15條第2項：急救人員應為醫護人員、經教育訓練規則所定急救人員訓練合格者或緊急醫療救護法所定救護技術員，且不得有失聰、兩眼裸視或矯正視力後均在零點六以下、失能及健康不良等足以妨礙急救情形。
explain_en: Article 15(2): trained first-aiders; excluded if hearing loss, corrected vision 0.6 or below in both eyes, disability or poor health would impede first aid.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 急救藥品與器材應置於適當固定處所並保持清潔，至少每多久定期檢查？
a_zh: 每六個月
b_zh: 每兩星期
c_zh: 每十二個月
d_zh: 每三個月
q_en: First-aid supplies and equipment must be kept in a fixed clean place and checked at least every:
a_en: 6 months
b_en: 2 weeks
c_en: 12 months
d_en: 3 months
explain_zh: 第15條第3項：急救藥品與器材應置於適當固定處所及保持清潔，至少每六個月定期檢查；被污染或失效之物品應隨時更換補充。
explain_en: Article 15(3): at least every six months, replacing contaminated or expired items at any time.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 雇主僱用勞工時，除一般體格檢查外，另應按作業類別實施何種檢查？何種情形得免一般體格檢查？
a_zh: 心理適性測驗；非繼續性之臨時性或短期性工作期間在三年以內者
b_zh: 職業病專科醫師面談；部分工時或派遣勞工一律免一般體格檢查
c_zh: 特殊健康檢查；已投保勞工保險且年資未滿一年之新僱勞工
d_zh: 特殊體格檢查；非繼續性之臨時性或短期性工作期間在六個月以內者
q_en: At hiring, besides a general physical exam, what must be done by job type, and when is the general exam waived?
a_en: A psychological aptitude test; non-continuous temporary or short-term work of three years or less
b_en: An interview with an occupational disease specialist; all part-time and dispatched workers exempt
c_en: A special health exam; newly hired workers with labor insurance and under one year of service
d_en: A special physical exam; non-continuous temporary or short-term work of six months or less
explain_zh: 第16條：僱用時應依附表九實施一般體格檢查，並按作業類別依附表十實施特殊體格檢查；非繼續性之臨時性或短期性工作在六個月以內、其他法規已有規定、經指定公告者得免一般體格檢查；距前次檢查未超過定期期限經提出證明者得免。
explain_en: Article 16: general exam per Annex 9 and special exam per Annex 10 by job type; waived for temporary work of six months or less, where other laws provide, or with proof of a recent exam within the periodic interval.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 在職勞工一般健康檢查之頻率為何？
a_zh: 年滿六十五歲每年一次；四十五歲以上未滿六十五歲每三年一次；未滿四十五歲每五年一次
b_zh: 年滿六十歲每二年一次；四十歲以上未滿六十歲每三年一次；未滿四十歲每五年一次
c_zh: 不分年齡一律每年一次；夜間工作者每半年一次；辦公室人員每五年一次
d_zh: 年滿六十歲每年一次；四十歲以上未滿六十歲每二年一次；未滿四十歲每三年一次
q_en: How often must in-service workers receive general health examinations?
a_en: Age 65+: yearly; 45 to under 65: every 3 years; under 45: every 5 years
b_en: Age 60+: every 2 years; 40 to under 60: every 3 years; under 40: every 5 years
c_en: Yearly for all ages; every 6 months for night workers; every 5 years for office staff
d_en: Age 60+: yearly; 40 to under 60: every 2 years; under 40: every 3 years
explain_zh: 第17條：年滿六十歲者每年檢查一次；四十歲以上未滿六十歲者每二年一次；未滿四十歲者每三年一次；項目依附表九，先天性辨色力異常者得免再檢查辨色力。
explain_en: Article 17: yearly at 60+, every two years at 40–59, every three years under 40.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事特別危害健康作業，應多久實施特殊健康檢查？並應將何資料交予醫師？
a_zh: 每三年或離職時；勞工薪資單、出勤紀錄及勞工保險投保資料
b_zh: 每二年或變更作業時；作業內容、最近三年考績紀錄及健康促進活動紀錄
c_zh: 每五年或屆滿六十歲時；學歷證明、專業證照及前次一般體格檢查報告
d_zh: 每年或變更作業時；作業內容、最近一次作業環境監測紀錄及危害暴露情形
q_en: Workers in specially hazardous operations must have special health exams how often, and what must be given to the physician?
a_en: Every 3 years or on resignation; pay slips, attendance records and labor insurance data
b_en: Every 2 years or on change of work; job content, three years of appraisals and health promotion records
c_en: Every 5 years or at age 60; diplomas, professional licences and the last general physical exam report
d_en: Yearly or on change of work; job content, latest environmental monitoring record and exposure data
explain_zh: 第19條：應每年或於變更其作業時依附表十實施特殊健康檢查；並將勞工作業內容、最近一次作業環境監測紀錄及危害暴露情形等作業經歷資料交予醫師；游離輻射作業依游離輻射防護法。
explain_en: Article 19: annually or when the job changes, with job content, latest monitoring records and exposure history provided to the physician.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 一般體格（健康）檢查及長期夜間工作健康檢查紀錄至少保存幾年？特殊體格（健康）檢查紀錄至少保存幾年？
a_zh: 十年；三十年
b_zh: 七年；十年
c_zh: 三年；五年
d_zh: 五年；七年
q_en: General and night-work health exam records are kept at least how long, and special exam records at least how long?
a_en: 10 years; 30 years
b_en: 7 years; 10 years
c_en: 3 years; 5 years
d_en: 5 years; 7 years
explain_zh: 第20條：附表九及附表十一之檢查紀錄至少保存七年；附表十之特殊檢查紀錄至少保存十年。第21條：游離輻射、粉塵、苯、石綿等特定作業之特殊檢查紀錄至少保存三十年。
explain_en: Article 20: 7 years for general and night-work exams; 10 years for special exams; Article 21: 30 years for certain agents.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 從事下列何種作業之特殊體格（健康）檢查紀錄，應至少保存三十年？
a_zh: 鉛、四烷基鉛、錳、汞、鈷及有機磷農藥作業等
b_zh: 高溫作業、噪音作業、異常氣壓、高架作業及重體力勞動
c_zh: 游離輻射、粉塵、苯、石綿、氯乙烯、甲醛、鎘等
d_zh: 有機溶劑、二硫化碳、正己烷、汽油、丙酮及甲苯等
q_en: Special exam records for which operations must be kept at least 30 years?
a_en: Lead, tetraalkyl lead, manganese, mercury, cobalt and organophosphate pesticide work
b_en: High-temperature work, noise, abnormal air pressure, work at height and heavy physical labor
c_en: Ionizing radiation, dust, benzene, asbestos, vinyl chloride, formaldehyde, cadmium and similar
d_en: Organic solvents, carbon disulfide, n-hexane, gasoline, acetone and toluene work
explain_zh: 第21條：游離輻射、粉塵、三氯乙烯及四氯乙烯、聯苯胺類、鈹、氯乙烯、苯、鉻酸及重鉻酸鹽、砷、鎳、1,3-丁二烯、甲醛、銦、石綿、鎘、苯乙烯等作業之特殊檢查紀錄至少保存三十年。
explain_en: Article 21: ionizing radiation, dust, tri/tetrachloroethylene, benzidine compounds, beryllium, vinyl chloride, benzene, chromates, arsenic, nickel, 1,3-butadiene, formaldehyde, indium, asbestos, cadmium, styrene.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 特殊健康檢查結果部分或全部項目異常，經職醫綜合判定為異常且與工作有關者，屬第幾級管理？
a_zh: 第三級管理
b_zh: 第一級管理
c_zh: 第二級管理
d_zh: 第四級管理
q_en: Abnormal special exam results judged by the occupational physician to be work-related fall under which management level?
a_en: Level 3
b_en: Level 1
c_en: Level 2
d_en: Level 4
explain_zh: 第22條：第一級全部正常或經職醫判定無異常；第二級異常但與工作無關；第三級異常而無法確定與工作相關性須進一步評估；第四級異常且與工作有關。第二級以上應註明不適宜作業，第三、四級並註明臨床診斷。
explain_en: Article 22: Level 1 normal; Level 2 abnormal but unrelated to work; Level 3 abnormal with undetermined work relation; Level 4 abnormal and work-related.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 特殊健康檢查屬第三級管理者，雇主應如何處理？
a_zh: 請職醫實施健康追蹤檢查，必要時會同職業安全衛生人員實施現場評估並重新分級，並通報分級結果及措施
b_zh: 由護理人員提供個人健康指導即可，無須請職醫實施健康追蹤檢查，亦不需通報分級結果及措施
c_zh: 由雇主自行認定與工作無關後歸檔，每三年複檢一次，並將結果公告於工作場所
d_zh: 應立即使勞工調離原作業並終止勞動契約，於三十日內函報中央主管機關核備
q_en: For workers at management Level 3, the employer shall:
a_en: Have the occupational physician conduct follow-up exams, with on-site evaluation jointly with OSH personnel if needed, re-grade and report
b_en: Have a nurse give individual health guidance only, with no follow-up exams and no reporting of the grading result
c_en: Let the employer declare it unrelated to work and file it, re-examine every three years and post the results on the workplace notice board
d_en: Immediately transfer the worker out of the job and terminate the contract, filing with the central authority within 30 days
explain_zh: 第22條第3項：第二級管理者應提供個人健康指導；第三級管理者應請職醫實施健康追蹤檢查，必要時會同職業安全衛生人員實施疑似工作相關疾病現場評估，依結果重新分級並通報；第四級經評估現場仍有暴露者應採取危害控制及管理措施。
explain_en: Article 22(3): Level 2 gets individual guidance; Level 3 gets follow-up exams and possible site evaluation with re-grading and reporting; Level 4 with ongoing exposure requires hazard control.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 勞工經健康檢查後，經醫師評估不能適應原有工作者，雇主應如何？
a_zh: 要求勞工繼續從事原有工作，並每三個月自費複檢一次直至檢查結果正常
b_zh: 依醫師建議按比例扣減工資，並將檢查結果公告於工作場所公布欄
c_zh: 參採醫師建議變更作業場所、更換工作或縮短工作時間，並採取健康管理措施
d_zh: 報請勞動檢查機構同意後終止勞動契約，並由勞工保險給付職業病補償
q_en: If a physician finds a worker unfit for the current job after a health exam, the employer shall:
a_en: Keep the worker in the same job and require a self-paid re-examination every three months until results are normal
b_en: Cut wages proportionally as the physician advises and post the exam results on the workplace notice board
c_en: Follow medical advice to change the workplace, reassign work or shorten hours, with health management measures
d_en: Terminate the contract with the labor inspection agency's approval and claim occupational disease benefits
explain_zh: 第24條：應參採醫師建議告知勞工並適當配置；異常者由醫護人員提供健康指導，不能適應原工作者變更作業場所、更換工作或縮短工作時間並採健康管理措施；將檢查結果發給勞工；彙整歷年紀錄；資料由僱用之醫護人員保存管理並遵守個資法。
explain_en: Article 24: inform and place workers per medical advice, give guidance for abnormalities, reassign or shorten hours if unfit, give results to workers, compile records, and protect personal data.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事高溫、異常氣壓、高架、精密或重體力勞動作業時，應如何配置工作及休息時間？
a_zh: 依勞工年資深淺及職務等級高低分別訂定休息時間
b_zh: 參採職業安全衛生管理人員之作業環境監測結果建議
c_zh: 參採勞工健康服務醫師綜合評估體格或健康檢查結果之建議
d_zh: 由勞工依自身體能狀況與工作負荷自行決定作息時間
q_en: For high-temperature, abnormal pressure, work at height, precision or heavy physical work, work and rest arrangements shall be based on:
a_en: The worker's seniority and job grade, with work and rest periods set accordingly by the employer
b_en: The OSH management personnel's recommendations based on environmental monitoring results
c_en: The labor health service physician's overall assessment of the worker's physical or health exam results
d_en: The worker's own judgment of their physical condition and the daily workload assigned to them
explain_zh: 第25條：從事職安法第19條之高溫度、異常氣壓、高架、精密或重體力勞動作業時，應參採從事勞工健康服務醫師綜合評估體格或健康檢查結果之建議，適當配置勞工之工作及休息時間；免僱用或特約醫師者得由辦理體格健康檢查之醫師為之。
explain_en: Article 25: the physician's assessment of exam results; where no physician is employed or contracted, the examining physician may advise.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 離職勞工要求提供其健康檢查有關資料時，雇主得否拒絕？
a_zh: 不得拒絕，但應由勞工負擔影印及郵寄費用
b_zh: 不得拒絕，但超過保存期限者不在此限
c_zh: 得拒絕，但經勞動檢查機構要求者不在此限
d_zh: 僅得提供檢查結果摘要，並以離職一年內者為限
q_en: May an employer refuse a former employee's request for their health exam records?
a_en: No, but the worker pays the copying and postage costs
b_en: No, unless the retention period has expired
c_en: Yes, unless the labor inspection agency requests it
d_en: Only a summary, and only within one year of leaving
explain_zh: 第26條：離職勞工要求提供其健康檢查有關資料時，雇主不得拒絕；但超過保存期限者不在此限。
explain_en: Article 26: must not refuse, except for records past their retention period.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 雇主實施勞工特殊健康檢查，應將辦理期程、作業類別與醫療機構等內容如何處理？
a_zh: 由檢查之醫療機構逕行代為登錄
b_zh: 以書面公告於工作場所之公布欄
c_zh: 登錄於中央主管機關公告之系統
d_zh: 登錄於地方主管機關指定之紙本簿冊
q_en: When conducting special health exams, the employer must record the schedule, job categories and medical institution:
a_en: By the examining medical institution registering on its behalf
b_en: By written notice posted on the workplace bulletin board
c_en: In the system announced by the central competent authority
d_en: In a paper register designated by the local competent authority
explain_zh: 第27條：雇主實施勞工特殊健康檢查，應將辦理期程、作業類別與辦理體格及健康檢查之醫療機構等內容，登錄於中央主管機關公告之系統。
explain_en: Article 27: register in the central authority's designated system.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 雇主於定期健康檢查時，對符合癌症篩檢條件之勞工，得如何辦理？其結果是否列入健康檢查紀錄表？
a_zh: 強制全體勞工進行癌症篩檢；一律列入
b_zh: 一律不得進行癌症篩檢；不列入
c_zh: 經勞工同意一併進行癌症篩檢；不列入
d_zh: 由雇主逕行決定是否篩檢；列入
q_en: During periodic exams, eligible workers may receive cancer screening under what condition, and is the result entered in the health exam record?
a_en: Mandatory for all workers; always entered
b_en: Screening is not permitted at all; not entered
c_en: With the worker's consent; not entered
d_en: The employer decides alone; entered
explain_zh: 第28條：得由醫療機構說明癌症篩檢規定，對符合條件之勞工經勞工同意一併進行癌症篩檢；檢查結果不列入健康檢查紀錄表；相關事項依中央衛生福利主管機關規定。
explain_en: Article 28: with worker consent, results kept out of the health exam record, per health ministry rules.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法係依何法規定訂定？
a_zh: 職業安全衛生法第十五條第三項
b_zh: 職業安全衛生法第六條第三項
c_zh: 勞動檢查法第二十八條第一項
d_zh: 勞動檢查法第二十六條第二項
q_en: The Regulations for Review and Inspection of Dangerous Workplaces are enacted under:
a_en: OSH Act Article 15, paragraph 3
b_en: OSH Act Article 6, paragraph 3
c_en: Labor Inspection Act Article 28(1)
d_en: Labor Inspection Act Article 26(2)
explain_zh: 第1條：本辦法依勞動檢查法第二十六條第二項規定訂定之。
explain_en: Article 1: under Article 26(2) of the Labor Inspection Act.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 從事石油產品之裂解反應以製造石化基本原料之工作場所，屬何類危險性工作場所？
a_zh: 丁類
b_zh: 乙類
c_zh: 甲類
d_zh: 丙類
q_en: A workplace cracking petroleum products to make basic petrochemicals is which class of dangerous workplace?
a_en: Class D (丁)
b_en: Class B (乙)
c_en: Class A (甲)
d_en: Class C (丙)
explain_zh: 第2條：甲類為石油裂解製造石化基本原料之工作場所，及製造處置使用危險物有害物達勞檢法施行細則附表一、二數量之工作場所。
explain_en: Article 2: Class A covers petroleum cracking and workplaces handling dangerous or harmful substances above the threshold quantities.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 使用異氰酸甲酯、氯化氫、氨、甲醛、過氧化氫或吡啶從事農藥原體合成之工作場所，屬何類？
a_zh: 丙類
b_zh: 甲類
c_zh: 丁類
d_zh: 乙類
q_en: A workplace synthesizing pesticide active ingredients using methyl isocyanate, hydrogen chloride, ammonia, formaldehyde, hydrogen peroxide or pyridine is:
a_en: Class C (丙)
b_en: Class A (甲)
c_en: Class D (丁)
d_en: Class B (乙)
explain_zh: 第2條第2款：乙類包括使用異氰酸甲酯、氯化氫、氨、甲醛、過氧化氫或吡啶從事農藥原體合成之工作場所；製造爆竹煙火類物品之工廠；以化學物質製造爆炸性物品之火藥類製造工作場所。
explain_en: Article 2(2): Class B also includes fireworks factories and explosives manufacturing workplaces.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 丙類危險性工作場所指蒸汽鍋爐之傳熱面積在多少平方公尺以上，或高壓氣體類壓力容器一日冷凍能力在多少公噸以上者？
a_zh: 一百平方公尺；五十公噸
b_zh: 二百平方公尺；一百公噸
c_zh: 一千平方公尺；三百公噸
d_zh: 五百平方公尺；一百五十公噸
q_en: Class C dangerous workplaces have steam boilers with heating surface of at least, or HP gas pressure vessels with daily refrigeration capacity of at least:
a_en: 100 m²; 50 tonnes
b_en: 200 m²; 100 tonnes
c_en: 1,000 m²; 300 tonnes
d_en: 500 m²; 150 tonnes
explain_zh: 第2條第3款：丙類指蒸汽鍋爐傳熱面積五百平方公尺以上，或高壓氣體類壓力容器一日冷凍能力一百五十公噸以上，或處理能力一千立方公尺以上之氧氣有毒性及可燃性高壓氣體、五千立方公尺以上之其他高壓氣體者。
explain_en: Article 2(3): 500 m² heating surface, 150 tonnes/day refrigeration, or processing capacity of 1,000 m³ (oxygen, toxic, flammable gases) or 5,000 m³ (other gases).

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 丙類危險性工作場所之高壓氣體處理能力，氧氣、有毒性及可燃性高壓氣體為多少立方公尺以上？其他高壓氣體為多少以上？
a_zh: 五千立方公尺；一萬立方公尺
b_zh: 一百立方公尺；五百立方公尺
c_zh: 五百立方公尺；一千立方公尺
d_zh: 一千立方公尺；五千立方公尺
q_en: Class C processing capacity thresholds are how much for oxygen, toxic and flammable HP gases, and for other HP gases?
explain_zh: 第2條第3款：一千立方公尺以上之氧氣、有毒性及可燃性高壓氣體；五千立方公尺以上之前款以外之高壓氣體。
explain_en: Article 2(3): 1,000 m³ for oxygen/toxic/flammable gases; 5,000 m³ for others.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 建築物高度在幾公尺以上之建築工程，屬丁類危險性工作場所？
a_zh: 五十公尺
b_zh: 三十公尺
c_zh: 八十公尺
d_zh: 一百公尺
q_en: Building projects of at least what height are Class D dangerous workplaces?
explain_zh: 第2條第4款：丁類營造工程包括建築物高度八十公尺以上、單跨橋墩跨距七十五公尺以上或多跨五十公尺以上之橋梁、壓氣施工、長度一千公尺以上或需開挖十五公尺以上豎坑之隧道、開挖深度十八公尺以上且面積五百平方公尺以上、模板支撐高度七公尺以上且面積三百三十平方公尺以上之工程。
explain_en: Article 2(4): buildings 80 m+, bridges with spans 75 m+ (single) or 50 m+ (multi), compressed-air work, tunnels 1,000 m+ or shafts 15 m+, excavations 18 m+ deep and 500 m²+, formwork 7 m+ high and 330 m²+.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 開挖深度達幾公尺以上且開挖面積達多少平方公尺以上之工程，屬丁類危險性工作場所？
a_zh: 十八公尺；五百平方公尺
b_zh: 二十公尺；二百平方公尺
c_zh: 十公尺；三百平方公尺
d_zh: 十五公尺；一千平方公尺
q_en: Excavation works of at least what depth and area are Class D dangerous workplaces?
explain_zh: 第2條第4款第5目：開挖深度達十八公尺以上，且開挖面積達五百平方公尺以上之工程。
explain_en: Article 2(4)(5): 18 m deep and 500 m² in area.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 工程中模板支撐高度幾公尺以上且面積達多少平方公尺以上者，屬丁類危險性工作場所？
a_zh: 三公尺；一百平方公尺
b_zh: 五公尺；二百平方公尺
c_zh: 七公尺；三百三十平方公尺
d_zh: 十公尺；五百平方公尺
q_en: Formwork shoring of at least what height and area makes a project a Class D dangerous workplace?
explain_zh: 第2條第4款第6目：工程中模板支撐高度七公尺以上，且面積達三百三十平方公尺以上者。
explain_en: Article 2(4)(6): 7 m high and 330 m² in area.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 長度幾公尺以上或需開挖幾公尺以上豎坑之隧道工程，屬丁類危險性工作場所？
a_zh: 二千公尺；二十公尺
b_zh: 一千公尺；十五公尺
c_zh: 三百公尺；五公尺
d_zh: 五百公尺；十公尺
q_en: Tunnel projects of at least what length, or requiring shafts of at least what depth, are Class D?
explain_zh: 第2條第4款第4目：長度一千公尺以上或需開挖十五公尺以上豎坑之隧道工程。第3目：採用壓氣施工作業之工程。
explain_en: Article 2(4)(4): 1,000 m long or 15 m shafts; compressed-air construction is also Class D.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法所稱「審查」與「檢查」有何不同？
a_zh: 審查為勞檢機構對資料之書面審查；檢查為對資料及設施之現場檢查
b_zh: 審查為勞檢機構對設施之現場檢查；檢查為對資料之書面審查
c_zh: 審查為中央主管機關對資料之審查；檢查為地方主管機關之現場檢查
d_zh: 審查與檢查均為事業單位自行辦理之書面查核，無須勞檢機構參與
q_en: What is the difference between 'review' and 'inspection' under the Regulations?
a_en: Review is the agency's documentary review; inspection is its on-site check of documents and facilities
b_en: Review is the agency's on-site check of facilities; inspection is its documentary review of submitted data
c_en: Review is done by the central competent authority; inspection is the on-site check made by the local authority
d_en: Both are documentary checks carried out by the enterprise itself, with no involvement of the inspection agency
explain_zh: 第3條：審查指勞動檢查機構對工作場所有關資料之書面審查；檢查指勞動檢查機構對工作場所有關資料及設施之現場檢查；製程修改指既有安全防護措施未能控制新潛在危害之製程化學品技術設備操作程序或規模之變更。
explain_en: Article 3: review = document review; inspection = on-site inspection of documents and facilities; 'process modification' = changes existing safeguards cannot control.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 事業單位應於甲類、丁類工作場所使勞工作業幾日前申請審查？乙類、丙類幾日前申請審查及檢查？
a_zh: 十五日前；三十日前
b_zh: 七日前；十四日前
c_zh: 六十日前；九十日前
d_zh: 三十日前；四十五日前
q_en: Applications for review of Class A/D workplaces must be filed how many days before workers start, and for review and inspection of Class B/C?
a_en: 15 days; 30 days
b_en: 7 days; 14 days
c_en: 60 days; 90 days
d_en: 30 days; 45 days
explain_zh: 第4條：甲類、丁類工作場所應於使勞工作業三十日前向當地勞動檢查機構申請審查；乙類、丙類應於四十五日前申請審查及檢查。
explain_en: Article 4: 30 days for Class A and D (review); 45 days for Class B and C (review and inspection).

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 申請審查甲類工作場所應檢附之資料為何？
a_zh: 公司登記證明文件及工廠登記證影本各三份，並副知當地消防主管機關備查
b_zh: 安全衛生管理基本資料及製程安全評估定期實施辦法附表一至十四各三份，並登錄於指定資訊網站
c_zh: 施工計畫書及施工安全評估報告書各三份，並經專任工程人員及開業建築師簽章
d_zh: 環境影響評估報告書及消防安全設備檢查表各二份，並登錄於指定資訊網站
q_en: What must accompany an application for review of a Class A workplace?
a_en: Company registration certificates and factory registration copies, three copies each, filed with the local fire authority for record
b_en: Basic OSH management data and Annexes 1–14 of the Periodic Process Safety Assessment Regulations, three copies each, registered online
c_en: The construction plan and construction safety assessment report, three copies each, signed by the full-time engineer and a licensed architect
d_en: An environmental impact assessment report and fire safety equipment checklists, two copies each, registered on the designated website
explain_zh: 第5條：應填具申請書並檢附安全衛生管理基本資料（附件一）及製程安全評估定期實施辦法第4條附表一至十四各三份；申請應登錄於中央主管機關指定之資訊網站。
explain_en: Article 5: application form, basic OSH management data (Attachment 1), and PSM Annexes 1–14, three copies, registered on the designated website.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 甲類工作場所之評估小組應由哪些人員組成？
a_zh: 雇主、董事長、財務主管、廠務經理、人力資源人員
b_zh: 工作場所負責人、製程安全評估人員、職業安全衛生人員、作業主管、熟悉作業之勞工
c_zh: 勞動檢查員、地方主管機關代表、工會理事、職業醫學科醫師、勞工代表
d_zh: 外部安全顧問、環境工程技師、保險公司代表、消防設備師、政府特聘專家
q_en: The assessment team for a Class A workplace consists of:
a_en: The employer, the chairman, the finance manager, the plant manager and the human resources staff
b_en: Workplace manager, process safety assessor, OSH personnel, operation supervisors and workers familiar with the operations
c_en: Labor inspectors, local competent authority delegates, union officers, occupational medicine physicians and worker representatives
d_en: External safety consultants, environmental engineers, insurance representatives, fire equipment specialists and government experts
explain_zh: 第6條：工作場所負責人、製程安全評估人員（受訓或具能力經認可）、依管理辦法設置之職業安全衛生人員、工作場所作業主管、熟悉該場所作業之勞工；未置評估人員者得以完成訓練之工業安全技師及化工／職業衛生／機械／電機技師之一任之；評估過程及結果應記錄。
explain_en: Article 6: the five listed; without an accredited assessor, trained industrial safety engineers together with chemical/hygiene/mechanical/electrical engineers may serve; records required.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 事業單位未置製程安全評估人員者，得以完成製程安全評估人員訓練之工業安全技師及下列何種技師之一任之？
a_zh: 冶金材料、造船工程、航空工程或核子工程技師
b_zh: 化學工程、職業衛生、機械工程或電機工程技師
c_zh: 食品科學、環境工程、農業工程或礦業工程技師
d_zh: 土木工程、結構工程、大地工程或水利工程技師
q_en: Without an accredited process safety assessor, a trained industrial safety engineer plus which other engineer may serve?
a_en: Metallurgical, naval architecture, aeronautical or nuclear engineer
b_en: Chemical, occupational hygiene, mechanical or electrical engineer
c_en: Food science, environmental, agricultural or mining engineer
d_en: Civil engineering, structural, geotechnical or hydraulic engineer
explain_zh: 第6條第2項：得以在國內完成製程安全評估人員訓練之工業安全技師及化學工程、職業衛生、機械工程、電機工程技師之一任之；兼具兩種資格者得為同一人。丁類則為工業安全技師及建築師土木結構大地水利技師之一。
explain_en: Article 6(2): chemical, hygiene, mechanical or electrical engineers (one person may hold both); Class D uses architects or civil/structural/geotechnical/hydraulic engineers.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 檢查機構對甲類工作場所之審查結果，應於受理申請後幾日內以書面通知事業單位？
a_zh: 十五日內
b_zh: 三十日內
c_zh: 六十日內
d_zh: 四十五日內
q_en: The inspection agency must notify the enterprise in writing of the Class A review result within how many days of receipt?
a_en: 15 days
b_en: 30 days
c_en: 60 days
d_en: 45 days
explain_zh: 第7條：檢查機構依檢附資料實施審查並得就職業安全衛生設施及管理實施檢查；審查結果應於受理申請後三十日內書面通知，但可歸責於事業單位者不在此限。第11條、第15條：乙類丙類為四十五日內。第19條：丁類三十日內。
explain_en: Article 7: 30 days (unless attributable to the enterprise); Articles 11 and 15: 45 days for Class B and C; Article 19: 30 days for Class D.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 經審查合格之甲類工作場所，應於何時重新評估檢附之資料並報請檢查機構備查？
a_zh: 僅於發生重大職業災害後
b_zh: 製程修改時或至少每一年
c_zh: 製程修改時或至少每五年
d_zh: 製程修改時或至少每十年
q_en: An approved Class A workplace must re-evaluate its submitted data:
a_en: Only after a major occupational accident, reporting to the local fire authority
b_en: On process modification or at least every year, reporting to the inspection agency
c_en: On process modification or at least every five years, reporting to the inspection agency
d_en: On process modification or at least every ten years, reporting to the central authority
explain_zh: 第8條：應於製程修改時或至少每五年重新評估第5條檢附之資料，為必要之更新及記錄，並報請檢查機構備查；重新評估準用第6條。第12條、第16條：乙類丙類亦於製程修改或至少每五年重新評估。
explain_en: Article 8: on process modification or at least every 5 years, updated, recorded and filed; Articles 12 and 16 apply the same to Class B and C.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 申請審查及檢查乙類工作場所應檢附之資料，不包括下列何者？
a_zh: 緊急應變計畫
b_zh: 施工安全評估報告書
c_zh: 製程修改安全計畫
d_zh: 製程安全評估報告書
q_en: Which is NOT required for a Class B workplace application?
a_en: Emergency response plan
b_en: Construction safety assessment report
c_en: Process modification safety plan
d_en: Process safety assessment report
explain_zh: 第9條：乙類應檢附安全衛生管理基本資料、製程安全評估報告書、製程修改安全計畫、緊急應變計畫、稽核管理計畫各三份。施工安全評估報告書為丁類（第17條）所需。
explain_en: Article 9: basic OSH data, process safety assessment report, process modification safety plan, emergency response plan and audit management plan; the construction safety report belongs to Class D.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 檢查機構對乙類工作場所審查後，應對何種設施實施檢查？
a_zh: 蒸汽鍋爐設施、第一種壓力容器及冷凍設施
b_zh: 施工架組配設施、模板支撐及開挖擋土設施
c_zh: 火災爆炸危害預防設施、有害物洩漏及中毒危害預防設施
d_zh: 一般高壓氣體製造設施、液化石油氣製造設施
q_en: After reviewing a Class B workplace, the inspection agency inspects which facilities?
a_en: Steam boiler facilities and first-category pressure vessel and refrigeration facilities
b_en: Scaffold erection facilities and formwork shoring and excavation earth-retaining facilities
c_en: Fire/explosion prevention facilities and harmful-substance leakage/poisoning prevention facilities
d_en: General high-pressure gas production facilities and liquefied petroleum gas production facilities
explain_zh: 第11條：審查後應對火災爆炸危害預防設施（附件七）及有害物洩漏及中毒危害預防設施（附件八）實施檢查；結果於受理後四十五日內書面通知。
explain_en: Article 11: fire and explosion prevention (Attachment 7) and leakage/poisoning prevention (Attachment 8); notice within 45 days.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 檢查機構對丙類工作場所審查後，應對下列何種設施實施檢查？
a_zh: 施工計畫書、施工安全評估報告書及專任工程人員簽章文件
b_zh: 一般高壓氣體、液化石油氣、冷凍用高壓氣體、加氣站製造設施及鍋爐設施
c_zh: 模板支撐、施工架、擋土支撐及露天開挖等營造安全設施
d_zh: 火災爆炸、有害物洩漏、中毒危害預防設施及緊急應變控制設施
q_en: After reviewing a Class C workplace, the inspection agency inspects:
a_en: Construction plan, construction safety assessment report and the full-time engineer's signed documents
b_en: General HP gas, LPG, refrigeration HP gas, gas filling station production facilities and boiler facilities
c_en: Formwork shoring, scaffolds, earth-retaining supports and open-cut excavation safety facilities
d_en: Fire and explosion, harmful-substance leakage and poisoning prevention facilities and emergency control facilities
explain_zh: 第15條：一般高壓氣體製造設施、液化石油氣製造設施、冷凍用高壓氣體製造設施、加氣站製造設施、鍋爐設施（附件九至十三）；結果於四十五日內書面通知。第13條：丙類申請檢附第9條各款資料。
explain_en: Article 15: the five facility types in Attachments 9–13; notice within 45 days.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 申請審查丁類工作場所應檢附何種資料？
a_zh: 施工安全評估人員及專任工程人員、執業技師或開業建築師之簽章文件，及施工計畫書、施工安全評估報告書各三份
b_zh: 製程安全評估報告書及製程修改安全計畫，經職業安全衛生人員簽章後，連同緊急應變計畫各三份
c_zh: 稽核管理計畫及安全衛生管理基本資料，經工作場所負責人簽章後，連同製程安全評估報告書各二份
d_zh: 製程修改安全計畫及環境影響評估報告書，經開業建築師簽章後，連同工廠登記證影本各三份
q_en: An application for review of a Class D workplace must include:
a_en: Signatures of the construction safety assessor and full-time engineer, licensed engineer or architect, plus the construction plan and construction safety assessment report in triplicate
b_en: A process safety assessment report and a process modification safety plan, signed by the OSH personnel, together with the emergency response plan, three copies of each document
c_en: An audit management plan and the basic occupational safety and health management data, signed by the workplace manager, together with the process safety assessment report, two copies each
d_en: A process modification safety plan and an environmental impact assessment report, signed by a licensed architect, together with a copy of the factory registration certificate, in triplicate
explain_zh: 第17條：應填具申請書並檢附施工安全評估人員及所僱專任工程人員、相關執業技師或開業建築師之簽章文件，及施工計畫書（附件十四）、施工安全評估報告書（附件十五）各三份；簽章以涉及專業技術部分為限；特殊狀況得報經同意分段申請審查。
explain_en: Article 17: signed documents, construction plan (Attachment 14) and construction safety assessment report (Attachment 15), three copies; phased review allowed for complex projects.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 丁類工作場所之評估小組，除工作場所負責人、施工安全評估人員、職業安全衛生人員外，尚包括何者？
a_zh: 保險公司代表、建築師事務所人員（含監造人員）
b_zh: 熟悉作業之勞工、緊急應變小組成員（含醫護人員）
c_zh: 勞動檢查員、當地主管機關代表（含消防人員）
d_zh: 專任工程人員、工作場所作業主管（含承攬人之人員）
q_en: Besides the workplace manager, construction safety assessor and OSH personnel, a Class D assessment team includes:
a_en: Insurance representatives and architectural firm staff (including site supervisors)
b_en: Workers familiar with the operation and emergency response team members (including nurses)
c_en: Labor inspectors and local competent authority delegates (including fire officers)
d_en: The full-time engineer and operation supervisors (including contractors' personnel)
explain_zh: 第18條：工作場所負責人、施工安全評估人員、專任工程人員、職業安全衛生人員、工作場所作業主管（含承攬人之人員）；未置評估人員者得以完成訓練之工業安全技師及建築師、土木、結構、大地、水利技師之一任之；評估過程及結果應記錄。
explain_en: Article 18: full-time engineer and operation supervisors including contractors'; alternative assessors are trained industrial safety engineers with an architect or civil/structural/geotechnical/hydraulic engineer.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 經審查合格之丁類工作場所，於施工過程中變更主要分項工程施工方法時，應如何？
a_zh: 就變更部分重新評估，採取預防措施後，報請勞動檢查機構重新審查合格始得施工
b_zh: 無須重新評估，僅需將變更情形口頭告知監造單位並登載於施工日誌
c_zh: 應立即停工三十日，並就變更部分重新申請丁類工作場所審查後始得復工
d_zh: 就變更部分重新評估，採取預防措施，更新施工計畫書及施工安全評估報告書並記錄
q_en: When an approved Class D worksite changes the construction method of a major sub-work item, the enterprise shall:
a_en: Re-assess the change, take precautions, and apply to the inspection agency for a fresh review before resuming work
b_en: No re-assessment is needed; simply inform the supervising firm verbally and note the change in the site diary
c_en: Stop work for thirty days and re-apply for Class D workplace review of the changed part before resuming work
d_en: Re-assess the change, take precautions, update the construction plan and safety assessment report, and record it
explain_zh: 第20條：變更主要分項工程施工方法時，應就變更部分重新評估後，就評估之危害採取必要預防措施，更新施工計畫書及施工安全評估報告書並記錄；重新評估準用第18條；施工方法變更情形如附件十六例示。
explain_en: Article 20: re-evaluate the changed part per Article 18, take preventive measures, update documents and record; Attachment 16 gives examples.

law: 危險性工作場所審查及檢查辦法
q_zh: 檢查機構實施危險性工作場所審查、檢查時，何人應列席說明？
a_zh: 承辦銀行代表、產物保險公司查勘人員
b_zh: 當地消防機關人員、環境保護主管機關人員
c_zh: 製程安全評估小組、施工安全評估小組成員
d_zh: 公司股東會代表、董事會監察人成員
q_en: Who must attend and explain during the agency's review or inspection of a dangerous workplace?
a_en: Representatives of the financing bank and the property insurance surveyors
b_en: Officers of the local fire authority and the environmental protection authority
c_en: Members of the process safety or construction safety assessment team
d_en: Representatives of the shareholders meeting and the board of supervisors
explain_zh: 第22條：檢查機構實施審查檢查時，製程安全評估小組、施工安全評估小組成員應列席說明。第21條：得邀請專家學者協助。第23條：應摘要記錄過程及決議。第23條之1：爆竹煙火工廠應檢附製造許可文件影本。
explain_en: Article 22: assessment team members; Article 21: experts may be invited; Article 23: proceedings summarized; Article 23-1: fireworks factories attach their manufacturing permit.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業（營造業以外）之事業單位勞工人數未滿三十人者，應置何種職業安全衛生人員？
a_zh: 乙種職業安全衛生業務主管
b_zh: 丙種職業安全衛生業務主管
c_zh: 職業安全衛生管理員
d_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管
q_en: A Category 1 (non-construction) enterprise with fewer than 30 workers must appoint:
a_en: A Class B OSH business supervisor
b_en: A Class C OSH business supervisor
c_en: An OSH administrator
d_en: A Class A OSH business supervisor
explain_zh: 附表二：各類事業未滿三十人者均置丙種職業安全衛生業務主管；三十人以上未滿一百人置乙種業務主管（第一類營造業另加管理員一人）；一百人以上置甲種業務主管。
explain_en: Annex 2: under 30 workers → Class C supervisor for all categories; 30–99 → Class B (construction Category 1 also adds an administrator); 100+ → Class A.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業之營造業事業單位勞工人數三十人以上未滿一百人者，依附表二應置何種人員？
a_zh: 乙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各二人
b_zh: 乙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各一人
c_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各二人
d_zh: 丙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各一人
q_en: A construction enterprise (Category 1) with 30 to under 100 workers must appoint, per Annex 2:
a_en: Two Class B OSH business supervisors and two management specialists
b_en: One Class B OSH business supervisor and one OSH administrator
c_en: Two Class A OSH business supervisors and two OSH administrators
d_en: One Class C OSH business supervisor and one management specialist
explain_zh: 附表二：營造業之事業單位三十人以上未滿一百人者，應置乙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各一人；營造業以外之第一類事業同規模僅置乙種業務主管。
explain_en: Annex 2: construction enterprises of 30–99 workers need a Class B supervisor plus an administrator; non-construction Category 1 of the same size needs only the Class B supervisor.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業之營造業事業單位勞工人數三百人以上未滿五百人者，依附表二應置何種人員？
a_zh: 甲種業務主管二人、職業安全（衛生）管理師二人及職業安全衛生管理員三人
b_zh: 丙種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師一人及職業安全衛生管理員四人
c_zh: 乙種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師二人及職業安全衛生管理員一人
d_zh: 甲種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師一人及職業安全衛生管理員二人
q_en: A construction enterprise (Category 1) with 300 to under 500 workers must appoint, per Annex 2:
a_en: Two Class A supervisors, two safety/hygiene management specialists and three OSH administrators
b_en: One Class C supervisor, one safety/hygiene management specialist and four OSH administrators
c_en: One Class B supervisor, two safety/hygiene management specialists and one OSH administrator
d_en: One Class A supervisor, one safety/hygiene management specialist and two OSH administrators
explain_zh: 附表二：營造業三百人以上未滿五百人者，置甲種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師一人及職業安全衛生管理員二人；五百人以上者甲種業務主管一人、管理師及管理員各二人以上。
explain_en: Annex 2: 300–499 workers → Class A supervisor + 1 specialist + 2 administrators; 500+ → Class A supervisor + at least 2 specialists and 2 administrators.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業（營造業以外）勞工人數五百人以上未滿一千人者，依附表二應置何種人員？
a_zh: 乙種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師一人及職業安全衛生管理員三人
b_zh: 甲種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師二人及職業安全衛生管理員一人
c_zh: 甲種業務主管二人、職業安全（衛生）管理師二人及職業安全衛生管理員二人
d_zh: 甲種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師一人及職業安全衛生管理員二人
q_en: A non-construction Category 1 enterprise with 500 to under 1,000 workers must appoint, per Annex 2:
a_en: One Class B supervisor, one management specialist and three administrators
b_en: One Class A supervisor, two management specialists and one administrator
c_en: Two Class A supervisors, two management specialists and two administrators
d_en: One Class A supervisor, one management specialist and two administrators
explain_zh: 附表二：營造業以外之第一類事業，一百人以上未滿三百人置甲種業務主管及管理員各一人；三百人以上未滿五百人置甲種業務主管一人、管理師及管理員各一人；五百人以上未滿一千人置甲種業務主管一人、管理師一人及管理員二人；一千人以上置甲種業務主管一人、管理師及管理員各二人以上。
explain_en: Annex 2 (non-construction Category 1): 100–299 → A + 1 admin; 300–499 → A + 1 specialist + 1 admin; 500–999 → A + 1 specialist + 2 admins; 1,000+ → A + at least 2 specialists and 2 admins.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第二類事業勞工人數三百人以上未滿五百人者，依附表二應置何種人員？
a_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各一人
b_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各二人
c_zh: 乙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各二人
d_zh: 丙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各一人
q_en: A Category 2 enterprise with 300 to under 500 workers must appoint, per Annex 2:
a_en: One Class A OSH business supervisor and one OSH administrator
b_en: Two Class A OSH business supervisors and two management specialists
c_en: One Class B OSH business supervisor and two OSH administrators
d_en: One Class C OSH business supervisor and one management specialist
explain_zh: 附表二：第二類事業一百人以上未滿三百人置甲種業務主管；三百人以上未滿五百人置甲種業務主管及管理員各一人；五百人以上置甲種業務主管、管理師及管理員各一人以上。
explain_en: Annex 2 (Category 2): 100–299 → Class A supervisor; 300–499 → A + 1 administrator; 500+ → A + at least 1 specialist and 1 administrator.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第三類事業勞工人數五百人以上者，依附表二應置何種人員？
a_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各一人以上
b_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各三人以上
c_zh: 丙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各一人以上
d_zh: 乙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各二人以上
q_en: A Category 3 enterprise with 500 or more workers must appoint, per Annex 2:
a_en: At least one Class A OSH business supervisor and one OSH administrator
b_en: At least three Class A OSH business supervisors and one management specialist
c_en: At least one Class C OSH business supervisor and one management specialist
d_en: At least two Class B OSH business supervisors and two OSH administrators
explain_zh: 附表二：第三類事業未滿三十人丙種、三十至九十九人乙種、一百至四百九十九人甲種業務主管；五百人以上置甲種業務主管及管理員各一人以上。
explain_en: Annex 2 (Category 3): under 30 → C; 30–99 → B; 100–499 → A; 500+ → A plus at least one administrator.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 依附表二附註，置職業安全（衛生）管理師二人以上者，其中至少一人應為何種資格？
a_zh: 職業安全衛生管理員
b_zh: 工業安全技師
c_zh: 職業衛生管理師
d_zh: 職業安全管理師
q_en: Per the note to Annex 2, when two or more management specialists are appointed, at least one must be:
a_en: An occupational safety and health administrator
b_en: An industrial safety professional engineer
c_en: An occupational hygiene management specialist
d_en: An occupational safety management specialist
explain_zh: 附表二附註1：置職業安全（衛生）管理師二人以上者，其中至少一人應為職業衛生管理師；但於103年7月3日前已置有職業安全衛生人員者不在此限。附註2：本表為至少人數，仍應依規模及危害風險增置。
explain_en: Annex 2 note 1: at least one hygiene specialist (grandfathered before 3 July 2014); note 2: the table is a minimum.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管安全衛生教育訓練之時數為幾小時？
a_zh: 三十五小時
b_zh: 四十二小時
c_zh: 六小時
d_zh: 二十一小時
q_en: The Class A OSH business supervisor training course lasts:
a_en: 35 hours
b_en: 42 hours
c_en: 6 hours
d_en: 21 hours
explain_zh: 附表一：甲種業務主管四十二小時；乙種三十五小時；丙種二十一小時；丁種六小時。
explain_en: Annex 1: Class A 42 h; Class B 35 h; Class C 21 h; Class D 6 h.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 乙種及丙種職業安全衛生業務主管教育訓練之時數各為幾小時？
a_zh: 二十一小時；六小時
b_zh: 三十五小時；二十一小時
c_zh: 三十小時；十八小時
d_zh: 四十二小時；三十五小時
q_en: Class B and Class C OSH business supervisor courses last respectively:
a_en: 21 hours; 6 hours
b_en: 35 hours; 21 hours
c_en: 30 hours; 18 hours
d_en: 42 hours; 35 hours
explain_zh: 附表一：乙種業務主管三十五小時，丙種二十一小時，丁種六小時。
explain_en: Annex 1: Class B 35 h, Class C 21 h, Class D 6 h.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 丁種職業安全衛生業務主管教育訓練之時數為幾小時？
a_zh: 六小時
b_zh: 三小時
c_zh: 十二小時
d_zh: 二十一小時
q_en: The Class D OSH business supervisor course lasts:
a_en: 6 hours
b_en: 3 hours
c_en: 12 hours
d_en: 21 hours
explain_zh: 附表一肆：丁種職業安全衛生業務主管安全衛生教育訓練課程及時數為六小時（第二、三類事業五人以下之雇主或代理人適用）。
explain_en: Annex 1 Part 4: 6 hours, for employers or representatives of Category 2/3 enterprises with 5 or fewer workers.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 擋土支撐、模板支撐、施工架組配、屋頂作業等營造作業主管之安全衛生教育訓練時數為幾小時？
a_zh: 十八小時
b_zh: 十二小時
c_zh: 二十四小時
d_zh: 三十六小時
q_en: Construction work supervisor courses (earth-retaining, formwork, scaffold assembly, roof work, etc.) last:
a_en: 18 hours
b_en: 12 hours
c_en: 24 hours
d_en: 36 hours
explain_zh: 附表八：擋土支撐、露天開挖、模板支撐、隧道等挖掘、隧道等襯砌、施工架組配、鋼構組配、屋頂作業主管之教育訓練均為十八小時。
explain_en: Annex 8: all eight construction work supervisor courses are 18 hours.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 有機溶劑、缺氧、特定化學物質等有害作業主管之教育訓練時數為幾小時？潛水作業主管為幾小時？
a_zh: 二十一小時；四十二小時
b_zh: 十八小時；三十六小時
c_zh: 十二小時；二十四小時
d_zh: 十八小時；十八小時
q_en: Harmful-operation supervisor courses (organic solvent, oxygen-deficiency, specified chemicals, etc.) last how long, and the diving supervisor course?
a_en: 21 hours; 42 hours
b_en: 18 hours; 36 hours
c_en: 12 hours; 24 hours
d_en: 18 hours; 18 hours
explain_zh: 附表九：有機溶劑、鉛、四烷基鉛、缺氧、特定化學物質、粉塵、高壓室內作業主管均為十八小時；潛水作業主管為三十六小時。
explain_en: Annex 9: 18 hours for the seven harmful-operation supervisors; 36 hours for diving supervisors.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 吊升荷重三公噸以上之固定式起重機、移動式起重機及人字臂起重桿操作人員之教育訓練時數為幾小時？
a_zh: 二十一小時
b_zh: 二十六小時
c_zh: 十八小時
d_zh: 三十八小時
q_en: Operator courses for overhead cranes, mobile cranes and derricks of 3 tonnes or more last:
a_en: 21 hours
b_en: 26 hours
c_en: 18 hours
d_en: 38 hours
explain_zh: 附表十：三公噸以上固定式起重機（含一公噸以上斯達卡式）、移動式起重機、人字臂起重桿操作人員均為三十八小時；營建用提升機操作人員二十一小時；吊籠操作人員二十六小時。
explain_en: Annex 10: 38 hours for the three crane types; construction hoists 21 hours; gondolas 26 hours.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 吊籠操作人員與營建用提升機操作人員之教育訓練時數各為幾小時？
a_zh: 二十一小時；二十六小時
b_zh: 十八小時；十八小時
c_zh: 三十八小時；三十八小時
d_zh: 二十六小時；二十一小時
q_en: Gondola operator and construction hoist operator courses last respectively:
a_en: 21 hours; 26 hours
b_en: 18 hours; 18 hours
c_en: 38 hours; 38 hours
d_en: 26 hours; 21 hours
explain_zh: 附表十：吊籠操作人員二十六小時；導軌或升降路高度二十公尺以上之營建用提升機操作人員二十一小時。
explain_en: Annex 10: gondolas 26 hours; construction hoists 21 hours.

law: 職業安全衛生教育訓練規則
q_zh: 高壓氣體製造安全主任之安全衛生教育訓練時數為幾小時？
a_zh: 三十八小時
b_zh: 十二小時
c_zh: 二十二小時
d_zh: 十八小時
q_en: The high-pressure gas production safety chief course lasts:
a_en: 38 hours
b_en: 12 hours
c_en: 22 hours
d_en: 18 hours
explain_zh: 附表七壹：高壓氣體製造安全主任安全衛生教育訓練課程、時數為二十二小時。

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 勞工噪音暴露工作日八小時日時量平均音壓級在多少分貝以上之噪音作業，屬特別危害健康作業？
a_zh: 七十五分貝
b_zh: 九十分貝
c_zh: 八十五分貝
d_zh: 八十分貝
q_en: Noise work counts as specially hazardous to health when the 8-hour time-weighted average exposure is at least:
a_en: 75 dB
b_en: 90 dB
c_en: 85 dB
d_en: 80 dB
explain_zh: 附表一第2項：勞工噪音暴露工作日八小時日時量平均音壓級在八十五分貝以上之噪音作業。附表一另包括高溫作業、游離輻射、異常氣壓、鉛、四烷基鉛、粉塵、特定有機溶劑、特定化學物質、黃磷、聯吡啶或巴拉刈製造、1-溴丙烷等作業。
explain_en: Annex 1 item 2: 85 dB(A) TWA; the annex also lists heat, ionizing radiation, abnormal pressure, lead, tetraalkyl lead, dust, specified organic solvents and chemicals, yellow phosphorus, paraquat manufacturing and 1-bromopropane.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 下列何種有機溶劑作業屬附表一所定之特別危害健康作業？
a_zh: 甲醇、乙醚、正庚烷、環己烷、松節油、礦油精等作業
b_zh: 水性塗料、乳膠漆、清潔劑、界面活性劑、水泥漆等作業
c_zh: 乙醇、丙酮、異丙醇、乙酸乙酯、丁酮、石油醚等作業
d_zh: 正己烷、甲苯、二甲苯、三氯乙烯、四氯乙烯、二硫化碳等作業
q_en: Which organic solvent operations are specially hazardous to health under Annex 1?
a_en: Methanol, diethyl ether, n-heptane, cyclohexane, turpentine and mineral spirits work
b_en: Water-based paint, latex paint, detergent, surfactant and cement paint work
c_en: Ethanol, acetone, isopropanol, ethyl acetate, methyl ethyl ketone and petroleum ether work
d_en: n-Hexane, toluene, xylene, trichloroethylene, tetrachloroethylene, carbon disulfide and similar
explain_zh: 附表一第8項：有機溶劑中毒預防規則所稱之1,1,2,2-四氯乙烷、四氯化碳、二硫化碳、三氯乙烯、四氯乙烯、二甲基甲醯胺、正己烷、苯乙烯、甲苯、二甲苯作業。
explain_en: Annex 1 item 8: 1,1,2,2-tetrachloroethane, carbon tetrachloride, carbon disulfide, trichloroethylene, tetrachloroethylene, dimethylformamide, n-hexane, styrene, toluene and xylene.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 製造、處置或使用特定化學物質之作業屬特別危害健康作業者，其混合物之重量比須超過百分之多少（苯為體積比）？
a_zh: 百分之五
b_zh: 百分之十
c_zh: 百分之一
d_zh: 百分之零點一
q_en: Handling specified chemicals is specially hazardous when a mixture contains them above what proportion by weight (benzene by volume)?
explain_zh: 附表一第9項：製造處置使用聯苯胺、氯乙烯、苯、石綿、鉻酸、砷、鎘、錳、汞、鎳、甲醛、1,3-丁二烯、銦等特定化學物質或其重量比（苯為體積比）超過百分之一之混合物之作業；第12項1-溴丙烷則為超過百分之五。
explain_en: Annex 1 item 9: over 1% (benzene by volume); item 12: 1-bromopropane over 5%.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 第一類事業勞工人數三百人至九百九十九人者，從事勞工健康服務之醫師臨場服務頻率為何？每次臨場服務至少幾小時？
a_zh: 每週一次；四小時
b_zh: 每月一次；三小時
c_zh: 每三個月一次；一小時
d_zh: 每二個月一次；二小時
q_en: For a Category 1 enterprise with 300–999 workers, the physician's on-site service frequency is, and each visit lasts at least:
a_en: Once a week; 4 hours
b_en: Once a month; 3 hours
c_en: Once every 3 months; 1 hour
d_en: Once every 2 months; 2 hours
explain_zh: 附表二：第一類事業300–999人每月1次、1000–1999人每月3次、2000–2999人每月6次…6000人以上專任職醫一人或每月18次；第二類300–999人每2個月1次；第三類300–999人每3個月1次；每次臨場服務至少3小時。
explain_en: Annex 2: Category 1 300–999 → monthly; 1,000–1,999 → 3/month; 2,000–2,999 → 6/month; 6,000+ → a full-time physician or 18/month; Category 2 300–999 → every 2 months; Category 3 → every 3 months; each visit at least 3 hours.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 從事特別危害健康作業勞工人數在一百人以上者，職業醫學科專科醫師臨場服務頻率為何？五十至九十九人者為何？
a_zh: 每週一次；每月一次
b_zh: 每年一次；每二年一次
c_zh: 每月一次；每四個月一次
d_zh: 每二個月一次；每六個月一次
q_en: Where 100+ workers do specially hazardous work, the occupational medicine specialist visits how often, and for 50–99 such workers?
a_en: Weekly; monthly
b_en: Yearly; every 2 years
c_en: Monthly; once every 4 months
d_en: Every 2 months; every 6 months
explain_zh: 附表二：特別危害健康作業50–99人，職業醫學科專科醫師每4個月1次；100人以上每月1次。
explain_en: Annex 2: 50–99 specially hazardous workers → every 4 months; 100+ → monthly.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 事業單位勞工人數三百人至九百九十九人且特別危害健康作業勞工未達一百人者，應僱用護理人員幾人？勞工三千人至五千九百九十九人者幾人？
a_zh: 一人；二人
b_zh: 三人；六人
c_zh: 二人；四人
d_zh: 一人；三人
q_en: An enterprise with 300–999 workers (under 100 in specially hazardous work) must employ how many nurses, and one with 3,000–5,999 workers?
explain_zh: 附表三：300–999人置護理人員1人（特別危害作業勞工300人以上則2人）；1000–2999人2人；3000–5999人3人（特別危害300人以上4人）；6000人以上4人，每增加6000人至少增1人；護理人員3人以上得置護理主管1人。
explain_en: Annex 3: 300–999 → 1 (2 if 300+ specially hazardous workers); 1,000–2,999 → 2; 3,000–5,999 → 3 (4 if 300+ hazardous); 6,000+ → 4, plus 1 per additional 6,000; 3+ nurses may have a nursing supervisor.

law: 勞工健康保護規則
q_zh: 依附表三，事業單位設置護理人員數達幾人以上者，得置護理主管一人？勞工人數超過六千人者，每增加幾人應增加護理人員至少一人？
a_zh: 二人；三千人
b_zh: 五人；一萬人
c_zh: 三人；六千人
d_zh: 四人；五千人
q_en: Per Annex 3, with how many nurses may a nursing supervisor be appointed, and above 6,000 workers one more nurse is required per how many additional workers?
explain_zh: 附表三備註：勞工人數超過6000人者，每增加6000人應增加護理人員至少1人；設置護理人員數達3人以上者，得置護理主管1人。
explain_en: Annex 3 notes: 3+ nurses → optional nursing supervisor; one additional nurse per additional 6,000 workers.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 勞動檢查法所稱「代行檢查機構」係指何者？
a_zh: 由中央主管機關指定辦理危險性機械或設備檢查之行政機關、學術機構或非營利法人
b_zh: 由目的事業主管機關核准辦理危險性作業環境監測之財團法人或民間顧問公司
c_zh: 由地方主管機關委託辦理勞動條件檢查業務之工會、職業訓練機構或營利事業公司
d_zh: 由中央主管機關設置辦理勞動檢查業務之專責檢查機構、代行檢查員及勞動檢查員
q_en: Under the Labor Inspection Act, a 'delegated inspection agency' is:
a_en: An administrative agency, academic institution or non-profit legal person designated by the central authority to inspect dangerous machinery or equipment
b_en: A foundation or private consulting firm approved by the competent industry authority to carry out the periodic monitoring of dangerous working environments
c_en: A trade union, vocational training institution or for-profit company commissioned by the local authority to inspect working conditions at enterprises
d_en: A dedicated inspection body, delegated inspector and labor inspector established by the central authority to carry out the labor inspection business
explain_zh: 第3條：勞動檢查機構指中央或直轄市主管機關或有關機關為辦理勞動檢查業務所設置之專責檢查機構；代行檢查機構指由中央主管機關指定為辦理危險性機械或設備檢查之行政機關、學術機構或非營利法人；勞動檢查員與代行檢查員分別領有勞動檢查證與代行檢查證。
explain_en: Article 3: labor inspection agencies are dedicated bodies of the central or municipal authorities; delegated inspection agencies are designated agencies, academic institutions or non-profits for dangerous machinery/equipment inspection.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 下列何者屬勞動檢查事項範圍？
a_zh: 公司稅務申報法令、商業登記法令及其他依公司法令應辦理之事項
b_zh: 勞動基準法令、職業安全衛生法令及其他依勞動法令應辦理之事項
c_zh: 消防安全設備法令、食品衛生管理法令及其他依醫療法令應辦理之事項
d_zh: 環境保護法令、建築管理法令及其他依都市計畫法令應辦理之事項
q_en: Which falls within the scope of labor inspection?
a_en: Tax laws, business registration laws and other matters required by company laws
b_en: Labor Standards laws, OSH laws and other matters required by labor laws
c_en: Fire safety laws, food hygiene laws and other matters required by medical laws
d_en: Environmental laws, building laws and other matters required by planning laws
explain_zh: 第4條：依本法規定應執行檢查之事項、勞動基準法令規定之事項、職業安全衛生法令規定之事項、其他依勞動法令應辦理之事項。細則第3條：勞動法令指勞工保險、勞工福利、就業服務及其他相關法令。
explain_en: Article 4: matters under this Act, the Labor Standards Act, OSH laws and other labor laws; Enforcement Rules Article 3 defines other labor laws as labor insurance, welfare, employment services etc.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 中央主管機關應於年度開始前幾個月公告並宣導勞動檢查方針？勞動檢查機構應於公告後幾個月內擬定監督檢查計畫？
a_zh: 一年；六個月
b_zh: 三個月；一個月
c_zh: 六個月；三個月
d_zh: 一個月；一個月
q_en: The central authority must announce the labor inspection policy how many months before the year begins, and inspection agencies must draw up their plans within how long after?
a_en: 1 year; 6 months
b_en: 3 months; 1 month
c_en: 6 months; 3 months
d_en: 1 month; 1 month
explain_zh: 第6條：中央主管機關應參酌勞動條件、安全衛生條件、職業災害嚴重率及傷害頻率，於年度開始前六個月公告勞動檢查方針（優先受檢事業單位選擇原則、監督檢查重點、檢查及處理原則等）；勞動檢查機構應於公告後三個月內擬定勞動監督檢查計畫報請核備。
explain_en: Article 6: policy announced 6 months before the year starts (priority targets, focus, handling principles); agencies draft supervision and inspection plans within 3 months.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 中央主管機關應多久定期公布勞動檢查年報？依施行細則應於何時公布前一年之年報？
a_zh: 每季；每季次月底
b_zh: 每年；每年第三季
c_zh: 每二年；每年年底
d_zh: 每半年；每年第一季
q_en: How often is the labor inspection annual report published, and when per the Enforcement Rules?
a_en: Quarterly; by the end of the following month
b_en: Yearly; in the third quarter each year
c_en: Every two years; at the end of each year
d_en: Every six months; in the first quarter each year
explain_zh: 第7條第3項：中央主管機關應每年定期公布勞動檢查年報。細則第7條第2項：應於每年第三季公布前一年之勞動檢查年報。
explain_en: Article 7(3): published annually; Enforcement Rules Article 7(2): in the third quarter for the previous year.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 下列何者為勞動檢查員不得有之行為？
a_zh: 於檢查前告知檢查目的並請事業單位派員陪同檢查（依施行細則辦理）
b_zh: 依規定通知事業單位提出必要之報告紀錄及工資清冊等文件（依第十五條）
c_zh: 進入事業單位檢查時主動出示勞動檢查證並告知雇主及工會（依第二十二條）
d_zh: 洩漏受檢查事業單位之生產技術、設備及經營財務等秘密（離職後亦同）
q_en: Which is prohibited for labor inspectors?
a_en: Informing the enterprise of the purpose of the inspection and asking it to send staff to accompany them
b_en: Requiring the enterprise to produce necessary reports, records and wage ledgers for examination and copying
c_en: Presenting the labor inspector's certificate and notifying the employer and the union on entering the site
d_en: Disclosing the inspected enterprise's technical, equipment or financial secrets, even after leaving office
explain_zh: 第11條：不得為變更隱匿或捏造事實之陳報；不得洩漏受檢事業單位之生產技術設備及經營財務等秘密，離職後亦同；處理秘密申訴案件不得洩漏申訴來源；不得與受檢事業單位發生不當財務關係。任何人得根據事實舉發違法失職。第12條：有利害關係者應自行迴避。
explain_en: Article 11: no false reports, no disclosure of enterprise secrets (also after leaving), no revealing complaint sources, no improper financial relations; Article 12: recusal for conflicts of interest.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 勞動檢查員執行職務，原則上不得事先通知事業單位，但下列何者除外？
a_zh: 營造工程開工檢查、鍋爐定期檢查、職業災害統計查核及其他經事先報備核備者
b_zh: 危險性工作場所審查或檢查、危險性機械或設備檢查、職業災害檢查及其他經核准者
c_zh: 一般安全衛生檢查、勞動條件檢查、勞工申訴案件檢查及其他經工會事先同意者
d_zh: 危險性工作場所定期檢查、機械設備型式驗證、職業病調查及其他經雇主同意者
q_en: Labor inspectors generally must not give advance notice, except for:
a_en: Construction commencement checks, periodic boiler inspections, accident statistics audits and other cases reported to the agency in advance
b_en: Dangerous workplace review/inspection, dangerous machinery/equipment inspection, occupational accident inspection and other approved cases
c_en: General occupational safety inspections, labor condition inspections, worker complaint inspections and other cases agreed by the union
d_en: Periodic dangerous workplace checks, type verification of machinery and equipment, occupational disease surveys and cases agreed by the employer
explain_zh: 第13條：勞動檢查員執行職務除第26條之審查或檢查、危險性機械或設備檢查、職業災害檢查及其他經勞動檢查機構或主管機關核准者外，不得事先通知事業單位。
explain_en: Article 13: the exceptions are Article 26 reviews/inspections, dangerous machinery or equipment inspections, accident inspections and other approved cases.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 勞動檢查員為執行檢查職務得隨時進入事業單位，雇主或有關人員無故拒絕、規避或妨礙者，處罰為何？
a_zh: 新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰，但不得按次處罰
b_zh: 新臺幣三萬元以上六萬元以下罰鍰，並得按次處罰
c_zh: 新臺幣三萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰，並得按次處罰
d_zh: 新臺幣二萬元以上二十萬元以下罰鍰，並得停止其營業
q_en: If an employer or related persons refuse, evade or obstruct a labor inspector's entry without cause, the penalty is:
a_en: A fine of NT$60,000 to NT$300,000, which may not be imposed repeatedly
b_en: A fine of NT$30,000 to NT$60,000, which may be imposed repeatedly
c_en: A fine of NT$30,000 to NT$150,000, which may be imposed repeatedly
d_en: A fine of NT$20,000 to NT$200,000, together with suspension of business
explain_zh: 第14條：勞動檢查員得隨時進入事業單位，雇主、代理人、勞工及有關人員不得無故拒絕、規避或妨礙，非警察協助不足以排除時得要求警察協助。第35條：違反第14條第1項或第15條第2項者處三萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰，並得按次處罰。
explain_en: Article 14 grants entry at any time, with police assistance if needed; Article 35: NT$30,000–150,000 per instance for violating Article 14(1) or 15(2).

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 勞動檢查員執行職務時，得對事業單位有關人員為下列何種行為？
a_zh: 詢問並製作談話紀錄或錄音、通知提出報告紀錄工資清冊、檢查文件資料並影印拍照錄影測量、封存或掣給收據後抽取物料樣品
b_zh: 逮捕違規雇主並解送法院偵辦、命令事業單位停止營業、沒入違規之機械設備器材、逕行處分罰鍰並移送強制執行
c_zh: 解散事業單位之工會組織、撤銷公司登記營業證照、註銷勞工保險投保單位、命令雇主重新申請設立許可並補繳費用
d_zh: 扣押事業單位之帳冊及財產、查封廠房土地並公告拍賣、凍結其銀行存款帳戶、命令其負責人限期出境並接受訊問
q_en: During inspection, labor inspectors may:
a_en: Question personnel (with records or recordings), require reports and wage ledgers, examine and copy/photograph documents, and seal or take samples against receipt
b_en: Arrest the offending employer and send him to court, order the business to close down, confiscate the offending machinery, and impose fines for compulsory enforcement
c_en: Dissolve the enterprise's trade union, revoke its company registration certificate, cancel its labor insurance unit, and order the employer to reapply for a set-up permit
d_en: Seize the enterprise's account books and assets, attach and auction its plant and land, freeze its bank accounts, and order the responsible person not to leave the country
explain_zh: 第15條：詢問有關人員（必要時製作談話紀錄或錄音）、通知提出必要報告紀錄工資清冊文件、檢查應備置之文件資料物品（得影印拍照錄影測量）、封存或掣給收據後抽取物料樣品器材工具以憑檢驗；事業單位不得拒絕；事業單位得申請檢視或複製錄影照片，勞檢機構不得拒絕。
explain_en: Article 15: questioning, requiring documents, examining and copying/photographing/measuring, sealing or sampling against receipt; the enterprise may request to view or copy recordings and the agency must not refuse.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 勞動檢查員對違反勞動法律規定之犯罪嫌疑者，必要時得如何？
a_zh: 報請勞動檢查機構首長核發搜索票執行搜索、扣押
b_zh: 聲請檢察官簽發搜索票執行搜索、扣押
c_zh: 會同當地警察機關逕行執行搜索、扣押相關物件
d_zh: 由勞動檢查員自行簽發封存單執行搜索、扣押
q_en: For suspected crimes under labor laws, labor inspectors may if necessary:
a_en: Ask the head of the inspection agency to issue a search warrant to search and seize the premises
b_en: Apply to a prosecutor for a search warrant to search and seize related objects and premises
c_en: Search and seize the related objects and premises directly together with the local police authority
d_en: Issue a sealing order on their own authority in order to search and seize the objects concerned
explain_zh: 第16條：勞動檢查員對違反勞動法律規定之犯罪嫌疑者，必要時得聲請檢察官簽發搜索票，就其相關物件、處所執行搜索、扣押。細則第16條：應依刑事訴訟法相關規定。
explain_en: Article 16: apply to a prosecutor for a search warrant; Enforcement Rules Article 16: per the Code of Criminal Procedure.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 危險性機械或設備之檢查，除由勞動檢查員實施外，必要時得由何者實施？
a_zh: 中央主管機關指定之代行檢查機構派代行檢查員
b_zh: 產物保險公司指定之查勘機構派特約鑑定人
c_zh: 事業單位委託之檢驗機構派其僱用之技術人員
d_zh: 製造廠商登記之品管單位派其原設計之技師
q_en: Besides labor inspectors, inspections of dangerous machinery or equipment may be carried out by:
a_en: Delegated inspectors from agencies designated by the central authority
b_en: Loss adjusters from survey firms appointed by a property insurance company
c_en: Testing technicians from laboratories commissioned by the enterprise itself
d_en: Licensed engineers from quality units registered by the original manufacturer
explain_zh: 第17條：危險性機械或設備之檢查除由勞動檢查機構派勞動檢查員實施外，必要時亦得指定代行檢查機構派代行檢查員實施。第19條：代行檢查業務為非營利性質，收費以收支平衡為原則。細則第17條：代行檢查指定期檢查及其他指定公告之檢查。
explain_en: Article 17: designated delegated inspection agencies; Article 19: non-profit, fees on a break-even basis; Enforcement Rules Article 17: periodic and other designated inspections.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 勞動檢查員進入事業單位檢查時應如何？事業單位對未持勞動檢查證者得如何？
a_zh: 檢查後補行出示勞動檢查證並告知工會；不得拒絕檢查
b_zh: 事先以書面通知雇主及工會到場；應報請主管機關核准
c_zh: 僅出示國民身分證並告知當地主管機關；不得拒絕檢查
d_zh: 主動出示勞動檢查證並告知雇主及工會；得拒絕檢查
q_en: On entering an enterprise, inspectors must do what, and what may the enterprise do if no certificate is shown?
a_en: Show the inspector's certificate only after the inspection ends; may not refuse the inspection
b_en: Notify the employer and the union in writing beforehand to attend; must report to the authority
c_en: Show only a national identity card and notify the local competent authority; may not refuse
d_en: Present the labor inspector's certificate and notify the employer and union; refuse the inspection
explain_zh: 第22條：勞動檢查員進入事業單位進行檢查時應主動出示勞動檢查證並告知雇主及工會，事業單位對未持勞動檢查證者得拒絕檢查；檢查後應作成紀錄並告知違反事項及提供遵守法令意見。細則第19條：檢查前應告知檢查目的並請派員陪同。細則第20條：勞動檢查證每二年換發一次。
explain_en: Article 22: present the certificate and notify employer and union; enterprises may refuse inspectors without a certificate; Enforcement Rules Article 20: certificates reissued every two years.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 勞動檢查機構對違反勞動法令事項應於幾日內書面通知事業單位改正或限期改善？事業單位應將檢查結果公告幾日以上？
a_zh: 十日內；七日以上
b_zh: 三日內；三日以上
c_zh: 七日內；十四日以上
d_zh: 三十日內；三十日以上
q_en: The inspection agency must notify the enterprise in writing of violations within how many days, and the enterprise must post the results for at least how long?
a_en: 10 days; 7 days
b_en: 3 days; 3 days
c_en: 7 days; 14 days
d_en: 30 days; 30 days
explain_zh: 第25條：有違反勞動法令規定事項者，勞動檢查機構應於十日內以書面通知事業單位立即改正或限期改善，並副知地方主管機關；公營事業另副知目的事業主管機關；事業單位應於違規場所顯明易見處公告七日以上。第36條：未公告者處三萬元以上六萬元以下罰鍰。
explain_en: Article 25: written notice within 10 days, copied to the local authority; results posted conspicuously for at least 7 days; Article 36: failure to post → NT$30,000–60,000.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 下列何種危險性工作場所非經勞動檢查機構審查或檢查合格，事業單位不得使勞工作業？
a_zh: 從事金屬表面處理之電鍍工廠、飼料製造、玻璃纖維及橡膠類製造、達規定噸數之堆高機吊車、易燃物品達規定重量、一般裝修工程等
b_zh: 從事紡織染整之漂白工作場所、水泥製造、磁磚陶瓷及玻璃器皿類製造、達規定功率之發電機組、廢棄物達規定重量、室內裝潢工程等
c_zh: 從事石油裂解之石化工業工作場所、農藥製造、爆竹煙火及火藥類製造、達規定壓力容量之鍋爐壓力容器、危險物有害物達規定數量、指定營造工程等
d_zh: 從事食品加工之冷凍冷藏工作場所、造紙製造、印刷電路板及油墨類製造、達規定容量之空調冷卻水塔、清潔劑達規定數量、道路挖掘工程等
q_en: Which dangerous workplaces may not be operated until reviewed or inspected and approved by the labor inspection agency?
a_en: Metal electroplating, animal feed manufacturing, glass fibre and rubber products, forklifts/cranes above tonnage thresholds, flammable goods above weight limits, general fit-out works, etc.
b_en: Textile bleaching and dyeing, cement manufacturing, tiles, ceramics and glassware, generator sets above rated power thresholds, waste above weight thresholds, interior decoration works, etc.
c_en: Petroleum cracking, pesticide manufacturing, fireworks and explosives, boilers/pressure vessels above thresholds, dangerous/harmful substances above thresholds, designated construction works, etc.
d_en: Frozen food processing, paper manufacturing, printed circuit boards and printing inks, cooling towers above capacity thresholds, detergents above quantity limits, road excavation works, etc.
explain_zh: 第26條：石油裂解之石化工業、農藥製造、爆竹煙火工廠及火藥類製造、設置達規定壓力或容量之高壓氣體類壓力容器或蒸汽鍋爐、製造處置使用危險物有害物達規定數量、中央主管機關會商指定之營造工程、其他指定之工作場所。第34條：違反者處三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科十五萬元以下罰金。
explain_en: Article 26 lists seven categories; Article 34: violation → up to 3 years' imprisonment, detention and/or a fine up to NT$150,000.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 事業單位發生重大職業災害時，勞動檢查機構應如何？
a_zh: 通知地方主管機關派員前往檢查，認定災害等級；非撤銷登記不足以避免擴大者移送法院裁定歇業
b_zh: 先函請事業單位自行調查災害原因及責任；經審核其報告認有必要者再以書面通知部分或全部停工
c_zh: 於接獲通知三日內指派檢查員前往勘查，統計罹災人數；非全部停工不足以究責者以口頭通知停工
d_zh: 立即指派勞動檢查員前往檢查，調查原因及責任；非立即停工不足以避免擴大者以書面通知部分或全部停工
q_en: When a major occupational accident occurs, the labor inspection agency shall:
a_en: Notify the local competent authority to send staff to grade the accident, and apply to a court to close the business if that is needed to stop escalation
b_en: Ask the enterprise to investigate the causes and responsibility itself, and order partial or full stoppage in writing only after reviewing its report
c_en: Dispatch inspectors within three days to survey the site and count the victims, and order a stoppage verbally where full stoppage is needed to fix liability
d_en: Immediately dispatch inspectors to investigate causes and responsibility, and order partial or full stoppage in writing if needed to prevent escalation
explain_zh: 第27條：勞動檢查機構對事業單位工作場所發生重大職業災害時應立即指派勞動檢查員前往實施檢查，調查職業災害原因及責任；發現非立即停工不足以避免職業災害擴大者，應就發生災害場所以書面通知事業單位部分或全部停工。
explain_en: Article 27: immediate dispatch and investigation, with written stop-work orders where necessary to prevent the accident from spreading.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 勞動檢查員實施安全衛生檢查時發現勞工有立即發生危險之虞，勞動檢查機構得如何？
a_zh: 先處以罰鍰並通知事業單位繼續作業
b_zh: 以書面通知事業單位逕予先行停工
c_zh: 報請中央主管機關核定後始得停工
d_zh: 以口頭警告事業單位限期改善後複查
q_en: If an inspection finds workers in imminent danger, the inspection agency may:
a_en: Impose a fine first and let the work at that place continue
b_en: Order an immediate stoppage of that workplace in writing
c_en: Order the stoppage only after the central authority approves
d_en: Give a verbal warning and recheck after a set deadline
explain_zh: 第28條：發現勞工有立即發生危險之虞，得就該場所以書面通知事業單位逕予先行停工；有立即發生危險之虞之情事由中央主管機關定之（勞動檢查法第二十八條所定勞工有立即發生危險之虞認定標準）。第30條：停工原因消滅後得申請復工。
explain_en: Article 28: immediate written stop-work order; the criteria for imminent danger are set by the central authority; Article 30: resumption may be applied for once the cause is removed.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 事業單位未依勞動檢查機構通知限期改善事項辦理而有發生職業災害之虞時，勞動檢查機構得如何？
a_zh: 僅得再次通知限期改善而不得通知其停工
b_zh: 應即移送地方法院檢察署偵辦並公布名稱
c_zh: 於認有必要時以書面通知部分或全部停工
d_zh: 得逕行撤銷其工廠登記及營業許可證照
q_en: If an enterprise fails to make required improvements by the deadline and an accident is likely, the inspection agency may:
a_en: Only set another improvement deadline and never order a stoppage
b_en: Refer the case to the district prosecutor and publish the name
c_en: Order partial or full stoppage in writing when deemed necessary
d_en: Revoke the factory registration and the business licence directly
explain_zh: 第29條：勞動檢查員對事業單位未依通知限期改善事項辦理而有發生職業災害之虞時應陳報所屬勞動檢查機構；勞動檢查機構於認有必要時得以書面通知事業單位部分或全部停工。細則第33條：全部停工日數超過七日者應陳報中央主管機關核定。
explain_en: Article 29: written stop-work order when necessary; Enforcement Rules Article 33: full stoppages over 7 days require central approval.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 事業單位應於顯明易見處公告哪些勞工申訴相關事項？
a_zh: 受理檢舉之檢察機關、雇主得抗辯之範圍、答辯書格式、訴願程序
b_zh: 辦理職災補償之保險機構、勞工得請領之給付、申請書格式、核定程序
c_zh: 調解勞資爭議之委員會、工會得協商之事項、協議書格式、仲裁程序
d_zh: 受理申訴之機構或人員、勞工得申訴之範圍、申訴書格式、申訴程序
q_en: Enterprises must conspicuously post which complaint-related items?
a_en: The prosecutor's office receiving reports, the scope of defence, the defence form and the appeal steps
b_en: The insurer paying accident compensation, the benefits claimable, the claim form and the approval steps
c_en: The committee mediating labor disputes, the matters for bargaining, the agreement form and arbitration
d_en: The body or person receiving complaints, the scope of complaints, the complaint form and the procedure
explain_zh: 第32條：受理勞工申訴之機構或人員、勞工得申訴之範圍、勞工申訴書格式、申訴程序，公告書由中央主管機關定之。第36條：未公告者處三萬元以上六萬元以下罰鍰。
explain_en: Article 32: the four items, using the format set by the central authority; Article 36: failure → NT$30,000–60,000.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 勞動檢查機構受理勞工申訴後，應於幾日內將檢查結果通知申訴人？事業單位得否對申訴人不利處分？
a_zh: 三十日內；得調整職務或減發工資獎金
b_zh: 十四日內；不得終止契約或為其他不利處分
c_zh: 七日內；得終止契約或為其他不利處分
d_zh: 六十日內；應先報請主管機關核准後處分
q_en: After receiving a worker's complaint, the agency must notify the complainant of results within how long, and may the enterprise penalize the complainant?
a_en: 30 days; reassignment or a pay cut is allowed as a penalty
b_en: 14 days; no termination or other adverse treatment allowed
c_en: 7 days; termination and other adverse treatment are allowed
d_en: 60 days; adverse treatment allowed with prior official approval
explain_zh: 第33條：受理申訴後應儘速派員檢查並於十四日內將檢查結果通知申訴人；勞工向工會申訴者由工會查證後提出書面改善建議；事業單位不得對申訴人終止勞動契約或為其他不利處分；勞動檢查機構應保密不得洩漏申訴人身分。
explain_en: Article 33: results within 14 days; unions may propose improvements; no adverse treatment of complainants; complainant identity kept confidential.

law: 勞動檢查法
q_zh: 違反停工通知或使勞工在未經審查檢查合格之危險性工作場所作業者，處罰為何？
a_zh: 新臺幣三萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰，並得按次連續處罰
b_zh: 一年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣三萬元以下罰金
c_zh: 五年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣三十萬元以下罰金
d_zh: 三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣十五萬元以下罰金
q_en: Violating a stop-work order or operating an unapproved dangerous workplace is punishable by:
a_en: A fine of NT$30,000 to NT$150,000, imposed repeatedly for each violation
b_en: Up to 1 year's imprisonment, detention and/or a fine up to NT$30,000
c_en: Up to 5 years' imprisonment, detention and/or a fine up to NT$300,000
d_en: Up to 3 years' imprisonment, detention and/or a fine up to NT$150,000
explain_zh: 第34條：違反第26條使勞工在未經審查或檢查合格之工作場所作業者，或違反第27條至第29條停工通知者，處三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科十五萬元以下罰金；法人代表人代理人受僱人因執行業務犯者，對該法人或自然人亦科以罰金。
explain_en: Article 34: criminal penalty up to 3 years plus fine up to NT$150,000, also imposed on the legal person or natural person employer.

law: 勞動檢查法施行細則
q_zh: 勞動檢查法施行細則所稱「職業災害嚴重率」及「傷害頻率」之定義為何？
a_zh: 每萬工時之失能傷害總損失日數；每萬工時之失能傷害次數
b_zh: 每千人之職業災害死亡人數；每千人之職業災害受傷人數
c_zh: 每年之職業災害總發生件數；每月之職業災害總發生件數
d_zh: 每百萬工時之失能傷害總損失日數；每百萬工時之失能傷害次數
q_en: Under the Enforcement Rules, 'severity rate' and 'frequency rate' mean:
a_en: Total lost days from disabling injuries per 10,000 work hours; number of disabling injuries per 10,000 work hours
b_en: Total number of occupational fatalities per 1,000 workers; total number of occupational injuries per 1,000 workers
c_en: Total number of occupational accident cases each year; total number of occupational accident cases each month
d_en: Total lost days from disabling injuries per million work hours; number of disabling injuries per million work hours
explain_zh: 細則第6條：職業災害嚴重率指每百萬工時之失能傷害總損失日數；傷害頻率指每百萬工時之失能傷害次數。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 6: severity rate = disabling-injury lost days per million hours; frequency rate = disabling injuries per million hours.

law: 勞動檢查法施行細則
q_zh: 新進勞動檢查員未經職前訓練合格前，勞動檢查機構得否指派其單獨執行檢查職務？
a_zh: 得，但應由資深檢查員陪同並於三個月內完成訓練
b_zh: 不得，但經事業單位書面同意並報請工會備查者不在此限
c_zh: 得，但以一般安全衛生檢查及勞動條件檢查案件為限
d_zh: 不得，但特殊情況經陳報中央主管機關核准者不在此限
q_en: May a new labor inspector be assigned to inspect alone before passing pre-service training?
a_en: Yes, if accompanied by a senior inspector for three months
b_en: No, except with the written consent of the enterprise and union
c_en: Yes, but only for general OSH and labor condition inspections
d_en: No, except in special cases approved by the central authority
explain_zh: 細則第8條：專業訓練指新進人員之職前訓練、現職人員之在職訓練及進修。第9條：新進勞動檢查員未經職前訓練合格前不得指派其單獨執行檢查職務，但特殊情況經敘明理由陳報中央主管機關核准者不在此限。
explain_en: Article 8 defines professional training; Article 9 bars solo assignments before pre-service training passes, except with central approval.

law: 勞動檢查法施行細則
q_zh: 勞動檢查員實施封存，以下列何種情事為限？
a_zh: 違反消防法令所禁止使用者、違反環保法令者、火災原因調查所必須者、其他經地方政府核准者
b_zh: 違反職安法令所禁止使用者、違反勞動法令者、職災原因鑑定所必須者、其他經勞檢機構核准者
c_zh: 經雇主書面同意封存者、經勞工申訴指明者、經工會決議請求者、其他經檢查員認為適當者
d_zh: 違反建築法令所禁止使用者、違反稅務法令者、產品品質檢驗所必須者、其他經法院裁定者
q_en: Sealing by labor inspectors is limited to:
a_en: Items banned under fire laws, items violating environmental laws, items needed for fire cause investigation, and other cases approved by the government
b_en: Items banned under OSH laws, items violating labor laws, items needed for accident cause identification, and other cases approved by the agency
c_en: Items sealed with the employer's consent, items named in a worker's complaint, items requested by union resolution, and other cases the inspector allows
d_en: Items banned under building laws, items violating tax laws, items needed for product quality testing, and other cases ordered by a court of law
explain_zh: 細則第13條：封存以有違反職業安全衛生法令所禁止使用者、有違反勞動法令者、有職業災害原因鑑定所必須者、其他經勞動檢查機構核准者為限；原因消滅或經許可得啟封。第14條：應開列封存物件清單及貼封條，封條加蓋印信並載明機構名稱、物件名稱、封存日期、法令依據。
explain_en: Article 13: the four situations; unsealing when the cause ends or on approved application; Article 14: inventory list and stamped seal stating agency, item, date and legal basis.

law: 勞動檢查法施行細則
q_zh: 事業單位向勞動檢查機構申請檢視或複製檢查時之錄影照片，應於受檢之次日起幾日內書面提出？機構應於接獲後幾日內提供？
a_zh: 七日；十四日
b_zh: 三十日；三十日
c_zh: 十日；二十日
d_zh: 六十日；三十日
q_en: An enterprise must request in writing to view or copy inspection recordings within how many days after inspection, and the agency must provide them within:
a_en: 7 days; 14 days
b_en: 30 days; 30 days
c_en: 10 days; 20 days
d_en: 60 days; 30 days
explain_zh: 細則第15條：事業單位依本法第15條第3項申請檢視或複製時，應於受檢之次日起三十日內以書面提出；勞動檢查機構應於接獲申請書之次日起三十日內提供。
